articleTitle: Indoor Soft Decoration System Using Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the information period, virtual reality technology has grown in popularity, especially in interior design. Users can engage with virtual exhibition halls without physically being in the scene, providing a unique and immersive experience. In this paper, a Virtual Reality (VR)-based virtual interior design system that divides into two categories including hardware- and software-based is presented. Preprocessing, model transformation, image fusion, and registration are the four stages of the system that are tested through simulation research. The suggested algorithm will determine when the region is constantly separated in advance time enhancing customer satisfaction, speeding up the display of interior design effects, and increasing coding efficiency. The objective is to provide target customers an immersive experience that enables them experience reality as close and real as possible at any time or location. This research presents the use of virtual reality technology in interior design for effect exhibition and system application analysis. This implemented algorithm has achieved 97 % of average similarity.

articleTitle: English Listening and Speaking Learning System Using LINE ChatBot in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Cloud Computing (CC) in a student learning system generates seamless access to educational resources and transfers their data to an offsite cloud server that is handled by a third-party provider. However, need to enhance the listening and speaking abilities of learners which maximizes the communication skills for professional, academic, and social success. Therefore, integrating listening and speaking development models with cloud-based learning systems is significant for comprehensive skill enhancement among students. In this research, the English listening and speaking learning system using LINE ChatBot in CC is analyzed to enhance students' abilities. Initially, 75 students are considered for participating in learning activities containing a four-week conversation exercise in English in both listening and speaking. To examine the competition's influence on language acquisition, competition characteristics are added to learning activities in a group of experiments to increase learning outcomes and motivation. With the help of LINE ChatBot environment of contextual learning, both student groups' performances are improved. Furthermore, extrinsic motivation in both control and experimental groups enhanced the learner's ability of English listening and speaking.

articleTitle: Novel Shunt Capacitor Based Industrial Power Management Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The aim of proposed work is to minimize the real-time power consumption and thus reduce the power cost in industries and establishments by making utilize of shunt capacitors. Reactive Power represents the electrical power that transmits back and forth between the phase conductors and the neutral conductor of a 3 - Φ network, but does not perform any mechanical work. A greater than of a reactive power, the device consumes the more apparent power, thus decreases. Power factor means that the ratio of working power in the circuit to apparent power to the load or k W /kVAR. All industrial loads, including the induction motors, have reasonably minimum power factors. Motors account for roughly 60 % of utility loads, resulting in a low power factor for the system. These motors have a low power factor based on load level. These motors power factor range from 0.30 to 0.95, depending on their working conditions and size. The power factor (PF) is the key for deal with industrial power systems, utilities and end users. Our proposed works is control the industrial loads using Microcontroller based controller by feeding the time lagging between zero voltage pulses (ZVP) and zero current pulses (ZCP) produced by proper operation amplifier circuit working. The proposed model achieves significantly 20 % to 22 % improvement in energy minimization against the existing model subject to different types of loads.

articleTitle: Analysis of Daily Behaviors of College Students Based on Optimized Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Presently, the mental illness of the college students is becoming more as well as more serious, as well as the deviation of the college student's behavior are also enhancing day by day. Hence, the mental illness of the college students has increasingly attracted the extensive attention in the world. In this research, an Optimized Apriori Algorithm (OAA) is proposed for the Daily Behaviors of College Students. An OAA is utilized for the determination of the relationship among consumption behavior as well as academic performance. The developed approach effectively provided the management decision support for student as well as enhanced the efficacy of the management. Initially, the data is collected from course scores of 134 students in industrial engineering in 2018–2020 classes at university in the university's academic concerns management system. In this research, the min-max normalization technique is utilized for normalizing the input data. Then, OAA is used for the analysis of the student's behavior. The results shows that the proposed OAA approach achieves the accuracy of 0.98, precision of 0.96, recall of 0.97 and F1-score of 0.98 respectively.

Author Keywords: Min-max normalization and Optimized Apriori Algorithm

articleTitle: Development and Application of Online Learning System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of subject knowledge such as Internet and computer technology, as well as the update and improvement of educational models and methods, people's cognition of the concept of artificial intelligence is getting deeper and deeper. Based on the current intelligent background, aiming at various types of problems involved in virtual reality, this paper uses machine automation algorithm to apply online learning system to real life, and studies the optimization of online learning system by artificial intelligence algorithm. After that, this paper also conducts related tests on the performance of the learning system, and the test results show that the resource utilization rate of the system is above 0.7, the data throughput is large, the stability is relatively good, and it is safe enough to run and meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Optimizing Metal 3D Printing using Artificial Neural Network based Seagull Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The infill parameters are important according to overall saving and cost material when printing metal 3D model. The Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) is applied in different industries to formed functional regions through polymers and metal reinforced polymer mixtures to obtain chosen properties. The Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) is complex to complete as surface roughness which is based on orientation. Hence, this research explored the finishing effects SS 316L LPBF components in different parts. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based Seagull Optimization Algorithm (SOA) is proposed for optimizing metal 3D printing. Moreover, the impact of critical speed at milling procedure on surface roughness SS 316L LPBF is analyzed with layer thickness and orientations of LPBF components. The printing temperature, layer height, compressive, flexural and tensile strength are considered as input and output parameters. The result exposed that machined surface suffers important orientation and layer thickness variations. The ANN-SOA achieved <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.21\mu \mathrm{m}, 0.47\mu \mathrm{m},0.19\mu \mathrm{m}, 0.38\mu \mathrm{m}, 0.15\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.56\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> for 1–6 experiments respectively.

articleTitle: Exploring Adaptive Data Acquisition Technology for Chip-based Communication Transmission Link
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of applications such as mobile internet and the Internet of Things, the amount and speed of data transmission have been continuously increasing, which has also brought about a higher demand for signal quality. Due to the complex working environment in which the communication system operates, there are many uncertain factors and interference sources. Therefore, how to adapt and optimize the transmission link in a dynamic and ever-changing working environment, thereby improving transmission quality and data transmission rate, is a key issue that urgently needs to be solved in the field of communication. This paper proposes a chip based adaptive data acquisition technology scheme to address the issues of traditional data acquisition methods being unable to adapt to different communication links for data acquisition speed and system real-time performance. By analyzing the communication quality of different communication transmission links and ensuring the data acquisition rate, the sampling rate is adaptively adjusted according to different communication transmission links. The experimental results show that this scheme can adaptively adjust the acquisition rate according to the amount of data while meeting the real-time requirements of the system. This method can effectively prevent data distortion and has higher energy efficiency.

articleTitle: A Method for PCB Localization Based on Improved Cramer-Rao Lower Bound Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The precise positioning for the round mark point with high-speed and high-precision SMD was studied in this study. The standard circle, 3/4 circle, semicircle and several partial missing circle were fitted. In addition, a lot of noise and interference information were added in mark image to prove the strong robustness of this algorithm. Through the analysis of the fitting precisions of multiple information missing circles, it can be proved that the proposed algorithm has high fitting precision. Compared with the LSF algorithm and AF algorithm, this algorithm has higher precision in a low SNR circumstance. The algorithm detection speed is 2.6 times that of hough algorithm and 1.3 times that of the square method. The research results show that the precise and fast positioning of mark points in high-speed and high-precision surface mounting production can be achieved by using this algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Minkowski PIFA Antenna with Different Feed Positions for 5G Femtocells
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper deals with the performance analysis of a Minkowski PIFA antenna with different feed positions for 5G femtocell applications. The antenna is designed on a Rogers RT Duriod 5880 substrate with a thickness of (0.02”) 0.508mm and a dielectric constant of 2.33. With this substrate, a high gain for the antenna is achieved with good return loss and efficiency. The proposed patch with a Minkowski fractal structure is placed 0.506mm above the substrate, which works as a Planar Inverted F-shaped Antenna. According to the values obtained at various feed positions, the port3 feed position is the best for this type of antenna. The 28GHz port3 input position resonates at a gain of 8.17dB and a return loss of -21.08dB, resulting in an efficiency of 100%. For 5G bands, femtocell base stations are often compact. This characteristic qualifies it as a millimeter wave band suitable for implementation in 5G Femtocells.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring and Diagnostics for Fault Detection in Power Plant Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, Fault Diagnosis and Identification (FDI) has grown significantly. Generally used methodology in these types of frameworks include model-based approaches, fault approaches, and pattern recognition techniques. However, it was essential to society's energy supply, therefore maintaining its safe and effective functioning is of utmost importance. This research used sophisticated Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) methods to diagnose the problems in contemporary power plants in order to decrease maintenance shutdowns and expenses. Therefore, this research applied deep learning to image processing using efficient Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)-based methods for object recognition and categorization. Using the observed frequency as input, the trained LSTM is utilized to detect power variations in real time. Control devices, such as synchronous generators and Energy Storage Systems (ESSs), was maintain a steady frequency by using the detected power variations. According to the results, the suggested approach demonstrated superior performance in terms of LG faults, with 0.427%, LLG faults of 0.800%, LGG faults of 0.186 %, and LL faults of 0.741%. Compared with existing methods namely Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) and Deep Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) it shows that suggested methods are achieved better performances with less faults respectively.

Author Keywords: fault detection and diagnosis long short-term memory

articleTitle: Language System Path of Intelligent Machine Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In some scenarios of today's society, traditional manual translation or inefficient translation methods can no longer meet people's translation needs, so people have begun to research intelligent machine translation language systems. In the long process of research, the accuracy of machine translation systems has also made a qualitative leap and is increasingly approaching the level of human translation. However, there are still some issues with machine translation systems, such as relying on large-scale parallel corpora for training or lacking robustness when encountering spelling and grammar errors, resulting in inaccurate translation results. This article was dedicated to studying the language system path of intelligent machine translation in a neural network environment and successfully implementing relevant solutions. Through experimental analysis, it can be concluded that optimizing the neural network has successfully improved translation quality under low resource conditions. This fully demonstrates the excellent performance of neural network translation in resource limited situations, demonstrating its broad application potential.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Music Intelligent Education System Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In traditional teaching, students may find it difficult to receive timely and personalized feedback, and some students may lose interest in music learning due to the monotony of traditional learning methods. This article aimed to design a music intelligent education system based on artificial intelligence (AI), providing rich learning content and personalized guidance to enhance students' interest in learning. The artificial intelligence based music intelligent education system designed in this article was divided into basic information management module, student music task management module, personalized recommendation module, interactive community module, and artificial intelligence algorithm module. It can monitor student performance, provide personalized feedback and guidance, help students improve, and provide a richer and more interesting learning experience. The experimental results of this article showed that under traditional music education, only 21 students were very interested in music, while under the music intelligent education system, there were 120 students who were very interested in music. The music intelligent education system based on artificial intelligence can not only compensate for the shortcomings of traditional music education, but also provide students with more personalized, efficient, and interesting learning experiences.

articleTitle: An AHP grading approach for risks in the process of software development in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The concept of risk management is habitually left unnoticed in agile software organizations, thus negatively af-fecting the project and disappointing the customer. Thus, it is mandatory to discern and rank the risks for mitigation. With this motive, this contribution has applied the Analytic Hierarchy Process decision-making technique in order to grade a list of 16 software risks discerned at the time of the risk management experiments in software enterprises. Amidst the 16 unique risks classified into distinct ‘risk nature’ categories entitled ‘difficulties’, ‘changes’, ‘mistakes’, and ‘challenges’, it is found that the ‘challenges' is the most important one to be treated first, trailed by the ‘difficulties’, ‘mistakes’, and ‘changes' categories. As per the outcome, it is acknowledged that ‘right way of budget utilization’, ‘difficult assignments’, and ‘convincing clients with other alternatives' can be considered as the ultimate risks. In addition, the attempt provides a comprehension of the potential threats under the software domain and their estimated magnitude.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Financial Risk Assessment of Commercial Banks Based on GA-BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to prevent supply chain financial risks (SCFR), commercial banks should establish a risk assessment index system and introduce the BPNN (Back Propagation Neural Network) model into SCFR assessment to achieve prediction of SCFR. This article constructs a BPNN model, builds a SCFR evaluation index system, and uses genetic algorithm (Genetic Algorithm, GA) to optimize the weights and thresholds of the BPNN, then applies the BPNN model optimized by genetic algorithm to the SCFR assessment of commercial banks. The article finally verifies the effectiveness of the GA-BPNN model. The results show that the GA-BPNN model can increase the accuracy of risk assessment to a maximum of 95.7%, which will be of great help to future risk assessment research.

articleTitle: Myocardial Infarction Diagnosis: Pattern Analysis of ECG Report Images Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The ECG machine data is utilized to diagnose cardiac conditions, specifically focusing on identifying myocardial infarction rates by analyzing pattern variations within ECG report images. Variations in the output of electrodes 2 and 3 are noted as indicative of a heart attack. The authors employ various image processing techniques like thresholding, contrast enhancement and machine learning methods like SVM, GBC, k-neighbors to process these patterns, aiming to enhance accuracy. After extracting four features, the most effective classifiers are employed, with the Gradient Boosting Classifier (GBC) with set of features exhibiting the highest accuracy at 76.60%. This paper emphasizes effective preprocessing methods crucial for obtaining structured and refined data, facilitating better feature selection and extraction from ECG graph images. It underscores the extraction of distinctive features to aid in myocardial infarction rate prediction. The paper evaluates several machines learning classifiers, highlighting their efficiency in simplifying and expediting the diagnosis process. Furthermore, the research suggests that incorporating additional features could potentially improve accuracy.

articleTitle: Edge Detection Algorithm for Urban Road Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Conventional algorithms demonstrate poor performance in complex urban road settings. Factors like noise, shadows, and changes in the composition of the road surface in photos can erode the accuracy of traditional algorithms, making them less reliable in actual city settings. The accuracy of edge detection in photographs of urban roads is improved by the incorporation of an effective neural network. This enhancement makes it possible for the algorithm to more accurately capture the intricate details and geometric structure of highways. In order to preserve the original image quality, this study preprocesses a sizable amount of urban road image data. The establishment of an efficient neural network involves constructing a network with an Encoder for image downsampling. The bottleneck comprises multiple residual blocks, and an Encoder is employed for image upsampling.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control Technology in Rural Landscape Environment Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional rural landscape environment design is often based on static concepts, ignoring the dynamic changes of the environment. This makes it difficult for designs to cope with constantly changing climate, human flow, and ecological conditions. This article utilizes intelligent control technology to achieve dynamic design of rural landscape environment, adapting to changes in seasons, weather, and pedestrian flow, and providing more intelligent, sustainable, and user-friendly solutions for rural landscape environment design. It collects data information related to rural landscape environment through sensors and preprocesses the collected data. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of LSTM model for climate and human flow prediction is 95.3 % and 93.2%, respectively. Therefore, using LSTM can accurately predict the rural environment and improve the user's experience of rural landscape environment design.

articleTitle: Fault Detection and Classification in Power Transmission Lines Using Discrete Wavelet Transform-Based Swish Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Transmission lines are an essential power grid component that is responsible for managing electricity from a production station to consumers and substations. The power network's transmission lines are primarily met with various faults. However, to maintain normal operation and minimize damage because of transmission line faults, it requires detecting and classifying faults. In this research, the Discrete Wavelet Transform-based Swish Recurrent Neural Network (DWT-SRNN) is proposed to detect and classify faults in power transmission lines using Deep Learning (DL). Initially, the data is acquired from the transmission line workspace by monitoring devices and sensors. Then, the Butterworth filtering is employed to increase the data quality. The DWT is performed to extract the features that transfer the time domain signal to the time-frequency signal during faulty and non-faulty conditions by decomposition. Finally, the SRNN is established to detect and classify faults in power transmission lines effectively. The existing techniques like Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCNN), Machine Learning (ML), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) are compared with DWT-SRNN. The proposed DWT-SRNN achieves a better accuracy of 99.89% compared to GCNN, ML, and LSTM respectively.

articleTitle: Optimization of Electrical Equipment in Intelligent Transmission Engineering Under Fuzzy Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional optimization analysis of electrical equipment in transmission engineering is often based on experience and rules, lacking intelligent methods. This leads to limitations in the adaptability and effectiveness of traditional methods when facing complex and variable power system conditions. By introducing the fuzzy neural network (FNN) algorithm, this paper fully utilizes its adaptability to nonlinear and complex correlations, thereby improving the intelligence level of optimization analysis of electrical equipment in transmission engineering. It collects actual power system operation data information and preprocesses the data to ensure the quality of the data. This article constructs a FNN model to effectively handle fuzzy and uncertain information, and applies it to the complex environment of power systems. The experimental results show that the average RMSE of the FNN for electrical equipment optimization prediction is 0.07, and the optimized voltage is very stable. The application of FNN algorithm can effectively improve the optimization effect of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: A Spatio- Temporl Deepfake Video Detection Method Based on TimeSformer-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of real-time deepFake video detection, this paper proposes a method based on the EfficientNet-TimeSformer model. Firstly, we use the transfer Xi method to use a pre-trained convolutional network for spatial feature extraction, and introduce a lightweight network for exploration, with an accuracy of 95.26% and an AUC of 95.52, which is very impressive. At the same time, the trainable parameters of the model are only 5,234,124, which is significantly higher than that of other models. Then, we optimize the model through data augmentation such as pre-training and dataset sizing to accommodate larger image sizes and longer video input sequences, so as to enhance the model's ability to process complex video data. The empirical results show that our model performs well in high-resolution videos and longer video sequences, significantly outperforming the performance of traditional convolutional neural networks, taking into account GPU memory limitations. At the same time, some limitations in the study are noted, such as the failure to test video clips longer than 96 frames and some limitations on the Celeb-DF dataset. Future research directions include in-depth research on the interpretability and generalizability of the model, as well as verifying its performance in a wider range of application scenarios.

articleTitle: Neural Network Algorithms and Big Data Technology in the Construction of Intelligent Data Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: It is a very difficult question to process and store large-scale data. The purpose of this article is to explore the application of neural network algorithms and big data technologies in the construction of intelligent data models. The LSTM model used in the article extracts features from the input data through learning, and classifies, predicts, and makes decisions based on these features; secondly, data mining techniques are selected to discover potential patterns and correlation laws, and provide more comprehensive information support for the construction of intelligent data models. The article summarizes the application fields of neural network algorithms and big data technologies in the construction of intelligent data models, and shows the great potential of neural network algorithms and big data technologies in improving data analysis and decision-making capabilities. The research results show that the F1 value of the method in this paper is between O. 85–0. 95, and the combination of neural network algorithm and big data technology has achieved remarkable results in the construction of intelligent data models.

articleTitle: Application Research of Quantitative Economic Decision System Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence and machine learning, the old economic system can no longer keep up with the times. In order to improve the stability of the system, this paper proposes a new system based on neural network algorithm. The article outlines the basic framework and elements of the quantitative economic decision-making system, covering data collection and preprocessing, model construction and training, decision generation and evaluation. At the same time, the application of neural network algorithms in quantitative economic decision-making systems is expounded in detail, including market forecasting, stock trading, risk assessment, and economic policy formulation. Through case studies and empirical analysis, the advantages and effectiveness of neural network algorithms in these fields are demonstrated. The experimental results show that the accuracy rate of the system in this paper is between 91 % and 98%, which solves the problems of the current system well and improves the efficiency of the system in decision-making.

articleTitle: Residual Attention Based Long Short-Term Memory Based Text Attributes of Intangible Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The significant National cultural treasure is Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) which has some issues in sustainability and inheritance. With the growth of digital technique, maximizing application and research of digital technique in ICH is represented. In this research, the standardized and scientific audio data dedicated for Cantonese Open is employed and classification technique for Cantonese open singing genres dependent on Residual Attention based Long Short-Term memory (Residual based LSTM) method is proposed. Proposed method provides resemblance of rhythm features of various Cantonese opera singing genres. Actual signal is pre-processed for obtaining a Mel-Frequency Cepstrum as method's input. Cascade combination integrated every shallow segment and deep features. The residual based LSTM method is a hybridization network that improves contextual relevance among signals. The proposed method attained intelligence classification of Cantonese opera information, while efficiently resolve the issue which previous techniques are challenging for classification. The proposed method attained a precision of 93.61%, recall of 92.74% and F1-measure of 92.95% which is more efficient than other existing methods.

articleTitle: Bird Species Classification: Using CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This research employs Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to identify bird species. A dataset of 1701 curated images, featuring Abbotts booby, Abbotts babbler, Abyssinian ground hornbill, African crowned crane, African firefinch, African oyster catcher, African pied hornbill, African pygmy goose, and albatross forms a comprehensive image library. Utilizing deep learning architectures (ResNet, VGG16, VGG19, AlexNet, GoogleNet, LeNet), the trained neural networks achieved remarkable accuracies, with some models exceeding 99%, demonstrating robust bird species classification. The study's 91% to over 99% accuracy rate in identifying different bird species emphasizes its usefulness in real-world situations. The fields of computer vision and ornithology benefit from this research, which helps classify bird species. Offering a thorough description of the model's efficacy and possible implications for conservation monitoring tools or apps for identifying bird species, the study describes the experimental design, evaluation measures, dataset characteristics, and concluding thoughts

articleTitle: Gated Recurrent Unit with Self Attention Mechanism for Optimizing Wastewater Treatment Process
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Wastewater Treatment Process (WWTP) is utilized to avoid water source pollution which is reused for agricultural and enhances the sanitation conditions. The main aim of WWTP is eliminate the nutrients like nitrogen that occurs in ammonia form in waste. Artificial intelligence technology has been widely applied in the sewage treatment process, especially the application of some intelligent algorithms to improve the efficiency and accuracy of sewage treatment. The Gated Recurrent Unit with Self-Attention Mechanism (GRU-SAM) is proposed in this work which is used to enhance the WWTP by using climate dataset. The dataset is preprocessed by min-max normalization which is used to reduce the relative connection among quantities and remove the dimension influence among indicators. Then, Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) is used for feature extraction and GRU-SAM is used for classification. The performance is estimated by Mean Square Error (MSE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). The GRU-SAM attains MSE 0.005, RMSE 0.0647, MAE 0.009 and MAPE 16.58 which is better compared to existing techniques such as Deep Learning-based Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory-Water Quality Assessment (DLBL-WQA) and Artificial Neural Network-WT-Long Short-Term Memory (ANN-WT-LSTM).

articleTitle: Research and Application Exploration of Image Processing and Visual Communication Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In many fields, such as medical imaging, electronic games, and security monitoring, it is very necessary to perform target image recognition and processing on computers. Through image processing and visual communication technology, managers or users can obtain target information more intuitively and clearly, thereby issuing more correct instructions and completing target work. In order to make this technology more mature and efficient, this article proposes to use artificial intelligence technology for assistance, and finally demonstrates it through comparative experiments. In the control experiment of recognition accuracy, the average accuracy of the recognition detection system based on artificial intelligence technology was 93.65%, while the average recognition accuracy of the conventional system was 90.66%. The obvious experimental gap fully demonstrates that artificial intelligence technology can be well used in image processing and visual communication technology.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Algorithm for VM Scheduling for Prioritized Cloudlets
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Users submit their requests to cloud service providers, and cloud computing delivers services over networks. With the influx of a large number of requests to the cloud, effective scheduling of cloudlets is imperative for optimal performance. This paper focuses on assigning priorities to cloudlets and scheduling them accordingly. Dynamic updating of priorities is implemented to prevent starvation. Cloudlets are allocated to VMs considering the current load of the VMs, further reducing execution time. The CloudSim simulation environment is used for assigning priorities to cloudlets, scheduling the cloudlets, and selecting the least loaded virtual machine for execution of the cloudlets. By prioritizing tasks and considering VM load, this approach aims to optimize system performance and ensure efficient resource utilization in cloud computing environments. It was found that the proposed method performs better in terms of total Turnaround Time and number of context switches than the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Malicious Documents Detection and Classification Using Hybrid Boosted-Support Vector Machine with High Dimensional Features
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Nowadays, the number of network attacks by malicious documents are enhanced intensely in which the Portable Document Format (PDF) malware remains as main hacking technique. To discriminate PDF malicious from numerous files are challenging techniques for legal analysis. The Machine Learning (ML) is main technology for detecting malicious PDF documents. Hence, the hybrid Boosted- Support Vector Machine (SVM) is proposed in this work which is used to detect and classify malicious PDF documents. The PDF of 1200 samples are considered as dataset that contains both safe and malicious files which preprocessed by normalization technique. Then, its features are extracted by Principle Component Analysis (PCA) and classified by hybrid boosted-SVM. The accuracy, recall, f1-score and Area Under Curve (AUC) are employed to estimate the hybris boosted-SVM performance. The hybrid boosted-SVM attains accuracy 0.9968, recall 0.99975, f1-score 0.9871 and AUC 0.9984 which is better than existing techniques such as SVM, Random Forest (RF) and Double layer detection model.

articleTitle: Machinery Fault Diagnoses in High-Voltage Circuit Breakers Using Empirical Mode Decomposition-Support Vector Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The circuit breakers have a flaw in their trip mechanism. Early mechanical faults like coil-plunger jam are hard to report using traditional fault diagnosis based on the coil current. However, users still have difficulty understanding and trusting the diagnosis results since the standard EMD is opaque in terms of interpretability. In this work, an Empirical Mode Decomposition with Support Vector Machine (EMP-SVM) proposed for machinery fault diagnosis. This work uses the vibration signal recovered from the trip process as an intrinsic time series of the data. At first, The Improved EMD is a data-adaptive multiresolution approach that breaks down signals into physically relevant components based on vibration and coil current signals. Lastly, utilizing the characteristics that were retrieved, the SVM is used to diagnose the defect. The implemented improved EMP-SVM model demonstrates superior performance, achieving Precision of (98.37<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), recall of (91.03%) and F1-Score of (96.34%). When compared to previous models like Improved Dempster-Shafer Evidence Theory-Echo State Neural Network (IDSET-ESNN) and Phase Space Reconstruction with Support Vector Machine (PSR-SVM).

articleTitle: Construction of Enterprise Financial Information Management System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As a software system used to manage and process enterprise financial data, the enterprise financial information management system covers many aspects including financial accounting, cost management, budgeting and personnel management. It can be said that it can effectively manage many financial activities within the enterprise and make decisions to a certain extent. In order to improve the performance of the enterprise financial information management system and ensure its security and privacy, this paper believes that it is necessary to use blockchain technology to optimize the enterprise financial information management system from these two perspectives. In the security experiment, the experimental group based on the proposed method and the comparison group based on other mainstream methods was compared. The average recognition rate of the experimental group for malicious attacks was 98.10%, while the average recognition rate of the control group was only 95.38%. Through the difference of experimental results between the two groups, it can be said that the method in this paper has excellent performance in improving the security of enterprise financial information management system.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction and Management for Effective Cyber Security Using Weighted Fuzzy C Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The necessity of the continuous risk assessment as well as management is attracting the people due to the requirement of protecting the risk. The management of the risk plays a significant part in solving the cyber threats within Cyber-Physical System (CPS). However, because of the enhanced complexity of CPS, the cyber-attacks are the most urbane as well as low predictable, which made the risk management tasks more challenging. This research proposes the efficient Cyber Security Risk Management (CSRM) repetition by the utilization of the Weighted Fuzzy C Means (WFCM) clustering for the prediction and management of the cyber risk. Initially, VCDB dataset is collected to estimate the effectiveness of the model and Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) approach is utilized for the extraction of feature from the collected data. Then, feature selection is performed by using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and prediction is performed by the utilization of the WFCM. The effectiveness of the WFCM is estimated by using various performance metrices and it achieves the accuracy of 84.2% and precision of 0.746 when compared to the existing methods such as fuzzy and DeepSpamPhisNet (DSPN).

articleTitle: Neural Network Algorithms in the Construction of Intelligent Financial Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The current financial sharing platform has no advantages when dealing with nonlinear relationships. The purpose of this research is to apply neural network algorithms to build an intelligent financial sharing platform to improve the accuracy of financial data processing and forecasting. In this study, a multi-layer perceptron is used as the main neural network algorithm, and a financial data set is used for model training and verification. It performed preprocessing and feature engineering of financial data, and then divided the data into training sets and test sets. After the division is completed, the paper continued to build the multilayer perceptron model, added cross-verification and parameter adjustment techniques to optimize the performance and generalization capabilities of the model, and then evaluated the accuracy of the model after the platform was built. The experimental results show that the accuracy rate of the multilayer perceptron algorithm is between 92% and 98%, and the intelligent financial sharing platform built on the multilayer perceptron algorithm has achieved significant improvements in financial data classification and prediction tasks.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Teaching Capability of Teachers Based on Two-Class Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Globally, teaching of Machine Learning (ML) is significant as well as relevant in schools. In spite of that, current dissertation as well as enhanced research in a developing area, teachers' commencements of the ML for the teachers remain under-researched. In this research, the supervised ML approach of Two-class Support Vector Machine (SVM) for the evaluation of the Teacher's capability. In this approach, various categories were appeared from determination of semi-structured meetings such as support the student for technical understanding, focused on professional development engineering, contextualizing the teaching resources as well as progress areas sustainability. The teachers must be included in the co-designing procedure of the resources examining the contextual factors as well as crucially, the course to combine the ML into conventional education. Concerning teachers in an innovation procedure will support contextualize ML and offering to actual influence as well as social changes. The experimental results shows that the proposed two-class SVM approach achieves the superior accuracy result of 98.5% and minimum errors such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.363, Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 0.346, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.573, and R-Squared (R2) of 0.763 respectively.

Author Keywords: Semi-structured interviews and Two-class Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: Integrated PON-VLC System for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Healthcare is one of the vital and well-known application fields of internet of things (IoT) technology, which is being extensively accepted worldwide. In modern healthcare systems, the IoT -eHealth is playing a prominent role in healthcare fields by spreading the devices and proficient people interaction. This system can minimise the span of hospital accommodation as well as healthcare costs, upgrade results and precludes re-admission of patients to the hospitals. The performance of these systems, especially transmission distance, security and information rate of medical data, could be affected highly by high power consumption and cost with the increase in number of patients. This motivates towards passive optical network and visible light communication (PON-VLC) system using sensors for IoT -eHealth services. The results show that the proposed system utilizing multi-diagonal code offers faithful 50km fiber and 10m VLC distance at 130Gbps per channel transmission rate for simultaneously 53 patients.

articleTitle: Optimization of Heat Dissipation Performance of Electronic Device Integration Modules Based on Intelligent Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The integration of electronic devices is an important direction in the development of science and technology today. However, with the continuous improvement of integration, the power of devices is increasing, and the problem of heat dissipation is also becoming more prominent. Traditional heat dissipation design is no longer suitable for the increasing heat dissipation requirements, and there is an urgent need to find more effective heat dissipation methods. This article optimized the heat dissipation characteristics of current electronic device integration modules and proposed a heat dissipation method based on an improved ant colony algorithm. Through experiments, it was found that the improved ant colony algorithm had a fast convergence speed and high effectiveness, which can effectively optimize the heat dissipation effect of electronic devices.

articleTitle: Computer Vision and Image Processing Under Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Currently, cutting-edge technologies such as computer technology and network technology are rapidly developing, and they have been widely applied in various industries and fields. At the same time, a large amount of data information is constantly being generated. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen, optimize and analyze various disorderly and fragmented information to ensure that these disorderly information can be effectively removed, thereby improving the reliability and accuracy of information data. Compared to traditional BP neural networks, this paper proposes a new image processing method based on CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks). The article combines the concepts and technical points of computer image processing technology and big data analysis and recognition technology, analyzes their advantages and principles, and discusses the specific application strategies of this technology. In such a large environment, utilizing computer image processing and recognition technology can better utilize its flexibility and processing capabilities, and enhance its application in various industries. Finally, this paper verifies the progressiveness of the tennis error action recognition model based on CNN algorithm through experiments (with the increase of the number of tennis error techniques, the recall rate of the tennis action recognition model based on CNN algorithm continues to increase to 89%, higher than other algorithms).

articleTitle: Intelligence Evaluation System of Chinese Composition Using Optimal Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of advanced computer technology, educational technology has impressed not only on evaluation of English, but also for Chinese composition. In China, an automatic composition evaluation system has utilized for foreign language writing teaching. Writing is significant comprehensive expertise for language learners. An automatic grading of Chinese composition consists of using Natural Language Processing (NLP) as well as Artificial Intelligence (AI) to estimate as well as score compositions. In this research, an Optimal Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is proposed for the intelligence evaluation system for the Chinese composition. In this research, the data is collected from the Chinese characters to evaluate the performance. Initially, the data is pre-processed by utilizing the stemming and stop word removal techniques. Then, Chinese word segmentation and feature extraction using Term Frequency and Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) is utilized. Finally, an optimal CNN is utilized for the evaluation and scoring of the Chinese composition. The effectiveness of the proposed optimal CNN is evaluated by using an accuracy and it achieves the 79.2 % in rhetorical approaches of Chinese composition.

Author Keywords: Stop word removal and Term Frequency and Inverse Document Frequency

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Blockchain Fragmentation by the Revenue Incentive Algorithm for Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The optimization analysis of the fragmentation is critical in blockchain fragmentation, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Decision tree algorithm is unable to address the phase limit issue in blockchain fragmentation, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a The gain incentive algorithm for edge calculation-based optimization analysis of blockchain sharding is provided, and the optimization analysis of blockchain sharding is assessed. To begin, the evolution strategy theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the optimization analysis of the fragmentation's needs to decrease interference factors in the optimization analysis of the fragmentation. The evolution strategy theory is then used to create a The gain incentive algorithm for edge calculation optimization analysis of the fragmentation scheme, and the outcomes of the optimization analysis of the fragmentation are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the gain incentive algorithm for edge calculation outperforms the standard Decision tree algorithm in terms of optimization analysis of the fragmentation accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Assessment of Commercial Banks using Pelican Optimization Algorithm based Long Short-Term Memory with Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the enhancing tendency of economic globalization, China's pace of sponsoring interest rate marketization is quickening progressively and financial market instability is enhancing every day. The credit is a most important element in bank and financial industries and it is described as unpredicted events that is majorly happens in a form of assets. The Pelican Optimization Algorithm based Long Short-Term Memory with Gated Recurrent Unit (POA-LSTM-GRU) is proposed in this work which is used to assess the credit risk of commercial bank by using collected data. The dataset is preprocessed by Z-score normalization which is used to remove data outliers to enhances the data quality. Then, POA is used for feature selection which selects relevant features and LSTM-GRU is used for classification which learn to capture long-term dependencies. The precision, fl-score, recall and accuracy are taken for evaluating POA-LSTM-GRU performance. The POA-LSTM-GRU attains precision 99.08%, fl-score 96.81 %, recall 97.35% and accuracy 98.76% when compared to existing technique such as Genetic Algorithm Neural Network (GANN), and Self-organizing LSTM.

articleTitle: COCOs Nucifera Tree Disease Prediction Using Faster Region-Convolutional Neural Network with ResNet-50
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Coconut diseases were predicted based on various categories such as color, shape, time frame, and changes in growth. Deep learning (DL) was applied for this purpose. However, the image dataset used was unlabelled, leading to challenges such as overfitting and complexity in computational time for prediction. The proposed method is the Faster Region-Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN) model for detecting and classifying coconut clusters, aiming to minimize overfitting in the identification of coconut nucifera diseases. The coconut disease dataset involved performing image classification, distinguishing between healthy and unhealthy coconuts. Normalization, feature extraction, and classification techniques were utilized for this task. For feature extraction, the VGG-16 model was involved, which includes maximum pooling layers to extract features at different levels of the network enhancing the quality of feature maps and providing better region identification. Classification was performed using the R-CNN with ResNet-50. The dataset contained images of both healthy and unhealthy coconuts, and the regions were predicted to identify and classify the different diseases within the images. ResNet-50 captures high-level features and helps mitigate the vanishing gradient problem during training, making it easier to connect with the R-CNN method. The proposed Faster R-CNN with ResNet-50 achieved a performance accuracy of 98.40%. This performance was compared to existing methods such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Deep-CNN (DCNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in Computer-Aided Interior Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Influenced by traditional interior design concepts, the application effect of computer-aided interior design is not satisfactory and cannot effectively meet people's requirements for interior design. Therefore, in practice, to fully develop the effect of the application of computer-aided interior design, its optimization and improvement must be carried out. To this end, the article combined the advantages of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms in computer-aided interior design, starting from three aspects: graphic rendering technology, 3D modeling technology, and computer-aided interior design based on intelligent algorithms, and conducted a specific analysis and exploration of the utilization of AI algorithms in computer-aided interior design. The results showed that the accuracy of computer-aided interior design based on AI algorithms reached up to 95%, which can better serve customers.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Improvement of Lithium Battery Charging System Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The research on traditional lithium battery charging systems has problems such as model simplification, insufficient data, insufficient accuracy, and poor real-time performance. Simplified electrochemical models cannot accurately reflect the complexity of actual systems, and limited experimental data limits the understanding of system behavior. Neglecting influencing factors leads to low prediction accuracy and a lack of real-time monitoring mechanisms to cope with dynamic changes in the system. These limitations affect the comprehensive analysis and optimization of system performance. This paper designed a Convolutional Neural Network - Gated Recurrent Unit (CNN-GRU) based on convolutional neural networks to extract local and global features from time series data, and combined it with time series prediction to predict charging temperature. In experimental verification, the quadratic mean error of the CNN-GRU algorithm model is 0.011, and the mean absolute deviation is 0.018. The error between the predicted electricity price and the actual value is within 2%.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Optimization-Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The cloud computing is a novel approach to online computing. It offers numerous benefits, but several important problems need to be fixed if the cloud environment is to become more reliable. These are the problems associated with fault tolerance, load management, and other security concerns in cloud environments. The main focus is to solve the issue in the pressure of network and improve the cloud computing efficiently and this paper runs with ant colony algorithm. The real time network loads the situation that provides and calculates the link to smallest load ad provides the dynamic stream of data forwarding strategy. The results showed the technique of load balanced ACO that can improve the response computationally. The Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm got the average response 30% lower compare to other algorithms. The ant colony optimization shows the uses and good result in optimization analysis.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Waste Management System with Level Indicators for Effective Garbage Waste Segregation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The rapid growth in urbanization and population has increased the generation of municipal solid garbage, providing significant challenges to waste management systems. Hence, to solve the issues in waste management, it suggested Internet of Things (IoT) smart-based Smart Waste Management (SWM) with level indications. This system combines IoT technologies to improve the efficiency and sustainability of the garbage disposal process. The suggested SWM system includes sensor-equipped garbage bins that can monitor and transmit accurate information on their fill levels. Sensor-equipped garbage bins optimize waste disposal by providing real-time data, enhancing efficiency and providing timely predictions in trash management. Furthermore, the use of smart garbage bins helps the separation of various types of waste, increasing eco-friendly behaviors and helping recycling activities. The level indicators not only improve efficiency but also help to reduce environmental effects by lowering overflowing bins and eliminating waste. As a result, this research makes use of the architecture, functionality, and potential benefits of the IoT based SWM system, highlighting its role in supporting responsible waste management practices, resource conservation, and the development of urban areas.

articleTitle: English Translation System Assisted by Machine Learning and Cloud Computing Data Aggregation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of machine learning, cloud computing and big data technology, the translation accuracy and fluency of computer-aided English translation system can be greatly improved again. Based on the above reasons, this paper discusses the research of an English translation system assisted by machine learning and cloud computing data aggregation algorithm. By placing data storage and computing resources in the cloud, the English translation system can process massive language data more efficiently and realize real-time update and optimization. At the same time, the cloud computing data aggregation algorithm can also help the English translation system to better cope with the diversity and complexity of data, so as to improve the robustness and reliability of the system. Finally, this paper verifies the efficiency of the technology through experimental analysis (The accuracy rate of the computer-aided translation model based on cloud computing and machine learning is between 0.93 and 1, which is significantly higher than that of the computer-aided translation system based on statistics, memory bank and case.).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Low Power Arithmetic and Logic Unit for MIPS32 Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Today's technology is around designing low power electronic devices. Thus, to address the challenge, this paper introduces a novel clock gating approach targeting the arithmetic and logic unit (ALU) within high-performance processors. Leveraging the MIPS32 (Microprocessor without Interlocked Pipeline stages) architecture, we employ a latch-based clock gating technique implemented on the Xilinx Vivado platform using Verilog HDL, showcasing its practical applicability. Our method effectively reduces total thermal power dissipation, demonstrating a significant reduction of approximately 16%. This research underscores the importance of computational power and energy conservation in microprocessor architecture design. Through systematic experimentation and analysis, our findings highlight the efficiency of latch-based clock gating techniques in addressing power dissipation challenges, offering promising avenues for future advancements in microprocessor design.

articleTitle: Methods and Systems for Sharing Economic Management File Resources Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As the number of economic management documents continues to increase, people's demand for managing shared file resources is also increasing. The huge, diverse and decentralized nature has become a stumbling block to file management. Therefore, the article proposed a big data method to improve the efficiency of file resource sharing. Through the collection and collation of a large number of file resources in the field of economic management, including research reports, papers, and case studies, text mining and natural language processing technology were used to structure and semantically process these files to extract key information. In this way, a file resource management system was designed and implemented, and efficient file resource sharing and access were realized through the establishment of indexing, classification, and retrieval mechanisms. The research results showed that the data sharing speed of the system of this method was 50-60Kpbs, which had significant advantages. The system has not only improved the efficiency of the utilization of file resources, but also promoted knowledge exchange and cooperation in the field of economic management.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Noise in a High-Speed Railway by a Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The noise optimization with numerous objectives is critical in high-speed railway, however it has an issue with erroneous performance positioning. The typical Rotation algorithm is unable to address the the phase limit issue in high-speed railway, and the result is insufficient. As a result, a Mixed algorithm-based multi-objective optimization of noise in high-speed railway is provided, and the multi-objective optimization of noise in high-speed railway is assessed. To begin, the optimization theory is used to discover the influencing elements, and the indicators are split based on the noise optimization with numerous objectives's needs to decrease interference factors in the noise optimization with numerous objectives. The optimization theory is then used to create a Mixed algorithm noise optimization with numerous objectives scheme, and the outcomes of the noise optimization with numerous objectives are thoroughly examined. The MATLAB simulation results reveal that, under particular evaluation conditions, the Mixed algorithm outperforms the standard Rotation algorithm in terms of noise optimization with numerous objectives accuracy and time of influencing variables.

articleTitle: Anomalous Sound Detection using Multi -Feature Representation and Domainmixed GMM
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the real-world manufacturing environment, machine anomalies occur infrequently, and these anomalies are often complex and diverse, making them difficult to detect. Various factors, such as different operational phases, varying machine conditions, and changes in the surrounding environment, can lead to unpredictable variations in machine sound characteristics. As a result, normal sounds can easily be mistaken for abnormal ones. Therefore, there is a need to develop an ASD (Anomaly Sound Detection) system with strong domain generalization capabilities. By enhancing domain generalization ability, the model can demonstrate better adaptability, regardless of how machine sound characteristics may change. In this study, within a single neural network, multiple feature representation methods are employed to learn and extract features from the data, capturing the characteristics of different domains. Multiple subsystems are utilized to process different feature representations, followed by data augmentation to combine data from various domains, ultimately enhancing the system's generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: A Circuit System for High-Speed Multichannel Parallel Sampling of Quasi-Optical Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the advanced alignment measurement and control system of extreme ultraviolet lithography (EUV) equipment, it is necessary to process the optical signal carrying the position information and extract the high-precision marked position information.In order to better collect the modulated optical signal, a high-speed multi-channel parallel sampling circuit system is designed, which can collect the light intensity signal in real time, high speed and effectively. Through the corresponding synchronous control system, it can realize the accurate measurement and high precision synchronous control of the advanced measurement and control system. In this circuit system, FPGA chip is used as the main control chip, and the 16-channel scanning modulated optical signal is independently and parallel processed. The sampling frequency is up to 500kHz.O<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> the basis of VPX bus architecture, the high-speed data transmission interface RapidIO is used for data transmission. The experimental results show that this circuit system can accurately collect the corresponding optical signal in real time and transmit the signal to the upper computer through the signal processing board, and then analyze the optical signal in real time.

articleTitle: Residual Connection Based Deep Neural Network for Evaluation of Athlete Competitive Ability
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The competitive performance capability is on-spot performance of athletes comprehensive utilization of tactical and technical, psychological and physical capabilities. Due to athletes competitive performance included various performance contents and factors of influencing, that is critical for comprehensive and objective utilization of one qualitative or quantitative statistics in measurement and evaluation. The research proposed the Deep Learning (DL) based athlete competitive performance capability method by performing a time series moving pressure measuring information. The method architecture is developed that directly analyzes actual data and generates evaluation outcomes that hugely facilitates practical usage. The multiple scale feature extraction method is assigned through learning features in various scales. The Residual connection Neural Network structure is developed through short-cut connection and Deep Neural Network (DNN) is much effectively trained. The evaluation of real athlete competitive performance capability tests is compared along various related techniques. The proposed method attained testing accuracy of 96.5% in Task 1, 97.5% in Task 2, 98.3% in Task 3 and 98.5% in Task 4 for 1200 testing samples.

articleTitle: Classification of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Improved ResNet-50 Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a disease that affects the vision of individuals with high blood sugar. DR needs to be diagnosed in initial stages, otherwise may lead to permanent blindness. Deep learning (DL) models have demonstrated remarkable results in the DR classification. In this work, improved pre-trained ResNet-50 model is utilized to develop deep model along with Adam optimizer is used to accelerate the convergence process. Also, Adam optimizer enhances training efficiency particularly with large datasets. Through experiments on DR images, performance of proposed model is evaluated on Kaggle APTOS and EyePac datasets. On the Kaggle APTOS dataset, the model achieved an accuracy of 74.18%, sensitivity of 85.08%, specificity of 87.50% and F1-score of 81.35% while for EyePac dataset these values are 82.37%, 91.04%, 88.28% and 87.35%, respectively. Findings of the presented model are also contrasted with those of other existing models which confirms the efficacy of proposed model.

articleTitle: Electric, Amphibious and VTOL Aircraft Design, a Forgotten Art: From Conceptual Design to Powerful Future Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The aviation sector is growing rapidly all over the world. At the same time, it is highly notable that pollution is also increasing day by day. So, numerous studies have been started investigating this aviation industry as well as non-fuel aircraft design to reduce pollution and create a pollution-free environment. The non-fuel aircraft design has been developed in this paper, and the combination of electric-amphibious and VTOL aircraft design has been thoroughly reviewed in this paper for better implications in the future. It is highly notable that electric design is considered as a forgotten art. The amphibious and electric aircraft designs have been thoroughly reviewed in this paper. The aircraft's developmental factors were also examined to clearly define the better aircraft design concept for promising future applications in a very effective manner. By combining conventional fuel-based engines with electric propulsion technology and electric-amphibious and VTOL (non-fuel design) systems, this paper is specially designed to present an effective solution for a pollution free environment. New models have been developed mainly to support the new combination of amphibious, electric, and VTOL aircraft designs for future implementation. The paper also contains some important information about the aircraft materials and important aircraft parts that can be utilized for non-fuel based aircraft design to reduce pollution.

articleTitle: Sports Training Image Blur and Deduplication Algorithms Based on Visual Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network (SRCNN) was employed in this study to enhance the clarity and minimize blur in sports training photographs. High-resolution cameras were utilized to capture sports training images and perform denoising on the images. To improve the nonlinear expression capabilities, the SRCNN model and activation function were introduced after the input image was reduced in size using downsampling techniques. Upsampling was used to transform the feature map back into a high-resolution image. The experimental results showed that the average peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of SRCNN was 93dB, and its average structural similarity (SSIM) index was 0.94. SRCNN can be used to produce clearer, higher-quality sports training photos.

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction Technology of Urban Buildings Based on Computer Vision and Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Under the background of rapid development of geographic information system (GIS) technology, how to effectively describe and process all kinds of three-dimensional information in urban space has become an urgent problem to be solved. This paper focuses on the construction of urban 3D modelling system. The point cloud data obtained by laser scanning or photogrammetry can provide accurate spatial information of urban buildings, including the shape, size, location and structure of buildings, etc. Using these point cloud data, the key technologies such as the fully automated extraction of digital elevation model, the representation of architectural model, and the reconstruction of urban 3D geomorphology are investigated. A large number of experiments are carried out to verify the proposed theory and method. The experimental results show that the average deviation of the models for window 1, billboard, door, floor corner and window 2 is 6.2mm, which is much lower than that of BIM (building information modelling) technology and computer vision and point cloud data.

articleTitle: Task Path Planning System for Autonomous Feeding Robots in Three-Dimensional Farms underYOLOV3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional farm autonomous feeding robot path planning systems have low target detection accuracy, poor planning efficiency, and insufficient adaptability to environmental changes when facing complex farm environments. This article aims to solve the problems existing in traditional systems by introducing the YOLOv3 algorithm, in order to improve the performance and efficiency of robots in autonomous feeding tasks on farms. Firstly, this article utilizes the YOLOv3 algorithm to achieve target detection and localization in the system, and then uses sensor data fusion technology to perceive the environment and construct a map. It then integrates map information for path planning and optimization, achieving system adjustment and obstacle avoidance, and finally selects commonly used path planning algorithms for experimental comparison. The results show that the target detection accuracy of the task path planning system for autonomous feeding robots in three-dimensional farms based on the YOLOv3 algorithm is the highest, exceeding 99%. In addition, the operating efficiency of the system is also the highest, above 95%. In summary, the YOLOv3 algorithm is very suitable for the research of task path planning systems for autonomous feeding robots in three-dimensional farms.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of a Cloud Computing Based Basic Education Information Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Conventional classification method has good performance when applied to small datasets; however, their applicability to unknown data sets is weak. To serve education information services in the cloud computing (CC) environment, this study presented a cross-source education information classification model based on cloud computing technology. This work outlined mode of CC service and its mode of deployment and provided a processing method of multisource information depend on CC centre integrated with the features of information distribution in CC environment. First, function and structure of CC platform were analyzed. Second, this research provided a summary of feature extraction process of educational information utilizing technology of data mining and provided an approach for classifying educational information depend on text features by analyzing different types of educational information resources. Finally, a model for classifying cross-source academic information in a cloud computing setting was developed.
