The comparison of experiments proved that the approach presented in this paper has the ability of efficiently categorizing multisource educational information under CC platform. This approach outperformed other traditional categorization method of Support Vector Machine (SVM) in terms of efficiency and also accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Flash ADC with CMOS Logic Using 45nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a Flash analog-to-digital converter (ADC) with 5-bit resolution using complemen-tary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) logic with 45nm tech-nology. The methodology comprises of resistive ladder network, thermometer code generation, binary encoder, and comparator. A two-stage operational amplifier functions as a comparator, which generates the thermometer code, and the priority encoder translates this code into binary output. The resultant binary output is the digital output of the Flash ADC. The primary issue in the Flash ADCs was frequently stems, hence the area and circuit power consumption increases with the increase in resolution bits. The main goal is to optimize the encoder circuit that enhances the bit count and reduce ADC power consumption. To reduce power consumption, the encoder is built using a 2:1 multiplexer based on several logics such as transmission gate logic, pass transistor logic, and CMOS logic. The results shows improvement in resolution and reduced power consumption.

articleTitle: Mayfly Optimization Algorithm with Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory for Intrusion Detection System in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The rapid development of number of connected devices exchange sensitive and personal significant data through Internet of Things (IoT)-assisted global network, attacks which are targeting security services are also enhancing every day. This paper proposed a Mayfly Optimization Algorithm (MOA) with Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory (BiLSTM) for Intrusion Detection System (IDS) in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{IoT}$</tex>. The MOA is used for feature selection which select relevant features through balancing exploration and exploitation. The BiLSTM is used for classifying network into attack and normal which process the data in both forward and backward directions, allowing them to capture dependencies between events that might be far apart in sequence. The min-max normalization is used to normalize the continuous features from NSL-KDD, ToN-IoT and UNSW-NB15 datasets. The recall, accuracy, f1-score and precision are considered to evaluate MOA-BiLSTM performance. The MOA-BiLSTM realizes accuracy of 99.25%, 89.61% and 99.35% accuracy for NSL-KDD, ToN-IoT and UNSW-NB15 datasets when compared to existing techniques such as LSTM and Deep Neural Network (DNN).

articleTitle: Evaluation Methods of Machine Translation Based on Big Data Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the challenges of machine translation evaluation methods, this study proposes an innovative machine translation evaluation method based on big data algorithms in view of the shortcomings of existing dynamic programming algorithms. This new scheme uses the principle of overlapping sub-problem theory to accurately identify and locate the key influencing factors, and accordingly carries out a wise classification of indicators to reduce possible interference. At the same time, by using the unique mechanism of big data algorithms, this scheme cleverly constructs the design strategy of translation evaluation methods. The empirical results show that the proposed scheme shows a significant improvement over the traditional dynamic programming algorithm in terms of the accuracy of the machine translation evaluation method and the processing efficiency of key factors, showing its obvious strong advantages. Machine translation evaluation methods play a crucial role in translation systems, which can accurately predict and optimize the growth trend and output results of machine translation evaluation methods. However, in the face of complex simulation tasks, traditional dynamic programming algorithms show some inherent shortcomings, especially when dealing with multi-level challenges, their performance is often unsatisfactory. To overcome this, this study introduces a new idea of machine translation evaluation method optimized by big data algorithms, and accurately controls the influencing parameters through the overlapping sub-problem theory, and uses this as a road map for index allocation, and then uses big data algorithms to innovate and construct a system scheme.

articleTitle: Design of Blind Guide System Based on Multi-Frequency Ultrasonic Technology and GWO-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: How to solve the problems of low positioning accuracy and low response speed in the blind guide system is a major challenge that has to be faced at present. In this article, a more efficient and accurate blind guide system based on multi-frequency ultrasonic technology and GWO-BP algorithm is proposed. The research adopts multi-frequency ultrasonic technology as the sensor of the navigation system, which can obtain obstacle information in the environment in real time. At the same time, the GWO-BP algorithm is combined to apply it to the process of navigation decision- making and path planning. The GWO-BP algorithm is combined with the gray wolf optimization algorithm and the BP neural network to improve the performance and accuracy of the navigation system. Experiments have verified that the positioning accuracy of the system in this article is between 0.01-0.05, and significant improvements have been made in navigation and obstacle avoidance.

articleTitle: Infrared Thermography-Based Induction Motor Bearing Fault Detection Using Hybrid Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In Induction Motor (IM), bearing is one of the most important components to support the rotational movement of shafts while minimizing friction. It necessitates frequent analysis in order to ensure dependable performance. Considerably, Infrared Thermography (IRT) is a non-contact, non-destructive technique used to find bearing flaws in rotating machinery. Whereas, the IRT image's string noise and irrelevant information restrict its overall performance. So, in this research, an emergent two-dimensional Discrete Wavelet Transform (2D-DWT) based IRT approach along with an effective feature selection technique namely Independent Component Analysis (ICA) has been presented to solve the aforementioned problem and diagnose the various bearing failures in IM. The best feature set was obtained by ranking the chosen features according to their relevance using the Mahalanobis Distance (MD) approach. In order to classify faults and assess performance, these particular features have been sent to a Complex Decision Tree (CDT). The implemented model outperforms the compared models such as Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Empirical Wavelet Transforms (EWT), and hybrid motor-current data-driven approach by obtaining higher classification accuracy of 99.85%.

articleTitle: Early detection of Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive disease of the nervous system of the brain that weakens the brain functions which leads the patient to bedridden. Overall dementia cases are approximately 75% of elderly people above 65 years of age worldwide. Early detection AD cases constitute nearly 2-5%. Detecting Alzheimer's disease earlier is a difficult and challenging task, which requires human experts and MRI reports. An alternative approach for early detection such as a convolution neural network has been proposed in this paper with more reliable and cost-efficient. From the 3D MRI image report, Alzheimer's Disease and Dementia are detected and also the AD stages are diagnosed using CNN. The CNNs datasheet on sMRI of the brain is loaded in the online database. The image Classification task is analysed and evaluated using the ADNet. This analysis utilizes Magnetic Resonance (MR) brain images and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture with a deep learning pipeline. The challenging task is to classify Magnetic Resonance (MR) brain images based on the AD stage into Mild dementia (MD), Very Mild Dementia (VMD)., Non-dementia (ND), and Moderate Dementia (MoD). The results are outperformed with a high accuracy of 99.94 %.

articleTitle: Construction of Virtual Shared Space and Design of Safety Monitoring System in the Context of Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: How to ensure the construction and safety monitoring of virtual shared space? The purpose of this research is to explore the method of constructing a virtual shared space in the context of the meta-universe and design a corresponding safety monitoring system. In the research, this article adopts comprehensive analysis and empirical research methods to analyze the existing virtual shared space construction methods and technologies, including virtual reality, augmented reality and mixed reality. By analyzing the concept and characteristics of the meta-universe, the importance and challenges of virtual shared space are revealed. At the same time, in-depth research is carried out on the construction and security monitoring of virtual shared spaces, and theories in the fields of information security, data privacy protection, and virtual reality technology are combined in the research methods. The research results show that the response time of this system is the longest 0.6s and the shortest 0.1s, which is of great significance for the development of the meta-universe and the construction of virtual shared space.

articleTitle: Design of a Tennis Training Assistance System based on Sensory Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of traditional tennis training methods heavily relying on manual guidance from coaches (purpose), the author proposes a tennis training assistance system based on somatosensory recognition technology. The author applies somatosensory recognition technology to the design of a tennis training assistance system to achieve intelligent tennis training. The tennis training assistance system uses Kinect V2 as a real-time motion acquisition sensor and uses a separation strategy to separate characters from the background of the sports venue, thereby reducing the computational complexity of the data. Simplify the human body into 18 skeletal joints to reduce the complexity of motion recognition, and use multi-objective tracking algorithms to capture joint position data. Based on VGG convolutional neural network, 2D joint data is transformed into pose mapping, and poses at multiple time points are used as training samples, train it through guided learning methods and optimize its parameters, ultimately obtaining a real-time behavior recognition model suitable for tennis sports. By conducting 100 sets of 4 movements tests on 10 subjects, they were divided into two parts: 10 groups and 28:2. As the number of training sessions increases, the accuracy curve between the test data and training results tends to 0.86. The system design method proposed by the author is robust and practical.

articleTitle: Improved Hierarchical Bayesian Optimization Algorithm with LSTM for Crude Oil Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Accurate oil price forecasting enables economists, entrepreneurs, and policymakers to foresee market trends and make well-informed decisions. The issue statement of current approaches is unable to handle stopping parameter changes, overfitting, underfitting, and the model's learning rate. More data that has been tested and trained upon is present in the West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dataset utilized in the suggested methodology. The suggested technique uses the Long Short-Term Memory Algorithm (LSTM) to forecast the price of crude oil in the future and the Improved Hierarchical Bayesian Optimization Algorithm for hyperparameter tuning. Initially, the raw data is normalized using Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), representative nonlinear feature information is extracted using Phase Space Reconstruction (PSR), and the chaotic character of the data is confirmed using the maximal Lyapunov exponent. This approach's numerical validation yielded a Coefficient of Determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) of 1.79566, a Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.00010, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.00720, and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.01075. The suggested method outperforms all the current methods, as demonstrated by a comparison of LSTM Approach Tuned by Salp Swarm Algorithm (V-LSTM-SSA-DO) and Forecasting Crude Oil Prices with a WT-FNN Model (WT-FNN).

articleTitle: Research on the Application of College English Teaching System Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the growth of language research and teaching, people realize that the grammatical competence is a significant thing of the communicative competence. Presently, there are various Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted educational applications in schools as well as universities. This research utilizes an AI approach integrated with the knowledge recommendation to the system as well as develops an online English teaching system. The system of English teaching is helpful in determining the potential as well as internal connections among the estimation results as well as different factors. In this research, the Machine Learning (ML) approach of Random Forest (RF) is proposed for the College English Teaching System. The proposed approach initially performed the correlation analysis on the developed estimation data. After that, the integration principles were followed to estimate the coordination among indexes in the estimation of the teaching. The proposed RF approach attains the interaction analysis of 98.2 %, 96.3%, 95.2 %, 97.2 % and 96.2 % in the number of students of 20,40, 60, 80 and 1 00 respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Epileptic Seizure Detection Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Epileptic seizures impact a patient's physical function and can cause irreversible damage to the brain. Timely detection of these seizures is crucial for administering appropriate antiepileptic treatment in the medical field. Recently, there has been significant interest in utilizing Deep Learning (DL) algorithms for detecting brain disorders. Deeper algorithms offer enhanced computational efficiency, accuracy, optimization, and reduced loss, thus improving the effectiveness of seizure detection. This study analyzed the various DL algorithms used in recent times for detecting epileptic seizures. The recent feature extraction techniques used in epileptic seizure are Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Deep Neural Network (DNN), and Residual Network Long Short-Term Memory (ResNet LSTM). The recent classification techniques used in epileptic seizure are Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), CNN-Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM), and Deep Convolutional Autoencoder-Bidirectional Long Short Memory (DCAR-BiLSTM). The performance metrics used to evaluate the existing methods are accuracy, specificity, sensitivity, Positive Predictive Value (PPV), False Predictive Value (FPV), and Matthews's Correlation Coefficient (MCC).

articleTitle: Vegetable Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision Based on ARIMA Model and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper aims to analyze and address the automatic pricing and replenishment decision problem for vegetable products. Initially, a comprehensive analysis of the correlation between individual vegetable items and categories is conducted using Spearman and Kendall correlation analyses. The study employs optimization techniques such as the particle swarm algorithm to solve a constructed 0–1 programming model. Additionally, various predictive models, including Copula, Informer, and Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBF), are utilized to obtain detailed data on future sales volume, purchase price, wholesale price, and more. MATLAB, PYTORCH, and other software tools are employed for data visualization, model fitting, and other operations to analyze the correlation between different categories and individual vegetable items from multiple perspectives. Based on the constructed planning model, the paper provides replenishment quantities and pricing strategies for each vegetable category under different constraints, aiming to maximize the benefits for supermarkets.

articleTitle: Based on the Improved Y olov5s Pig Face Detection Research of the Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In view of the large differences in facial features and low recognition accuracy of pigs under different conditions, this paper proposes a pig face target detection algorithm improved by YOLOv5s, which integrates coordinate CBAM dual-channel attention mechanism in the Backbone network of the model to suppress unnecessary features and pay more attention to key areas of the pig face. The Conv2Former structure was introduced to fully perceive the features and background of pig face, and adapt to the recognition and detection of pig face in different environments. The regression loss function of bounding box is improved, GIoU is replaced by EIoU loss function, the prediction of bounding box is optimized, and the adaptability of the algorithm to pig faces with different scales and shapes is enhanced. Experimental results show that the average accuracy rate of the improved YOLOv5s algorithm reaches 88.6%, which is 6.6% higher than that of the original model, the mAP value is increased from 82.3% to 89.8%, and the detection speed is 64 frames/SEC, which basically meets the requirement of pig face recognition.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Sign Language Recognition System Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The gesture classification and recognition field offer ample research opportunities due to the growing deaf and hearing-impaired populations and the advancements in vision-based devices. As recognition of hand gestures is crucial to interpreting sign language, gesture recognition systems should consider the maximum number of signs. An ensemble neural network-based robust hand gesture recognition model is presented in this work. Real-time sign detection will be provided by a suggested system in this system. It will facilitate communication with and interaction with challenged people. An American Sign Language (ASL) recognition model can be trained with a convolution neural network (CNN). The proposed model is also suitable for supervised object segmentation. The proposed methodology also performs very well when tested on publicly available datasets of complex hand gestures, with an accuracy rate of 99.111%.

articleTitle: Brand Logo Image Classification Based on Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Brand logo image examines how a critical dimension of logo design, namely the naturalness of the logo color, influences brand design induced by the logo. However, high complexity is observed, requiring higher quality data and susceptibility to overfitting when there is insufficient training data. The implementation of the proposed system involved the utilization of a Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN) reduce overfitting and efficiently handle noise and distortion in the logo image, which is essential in brand logo image processing. The brand logo image dataset forwarded to the preprocessing stage included pixel values, which may lead to the loss of contrast, shadow, sharpness, noise removal, and structure in some relevant images. The classification involved DCGAN, aiming to achieve high-quality logo image prediction, noise reduction, and handling of overfitting by incorporating synthetic logo images. The proposed DCGAN method achieves promising performance, including a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 52.25, Accuracy of 97.09%, Precision of 97.01 %, Recall of 98.10%, and F1-score of 97.11 %. This performance is compared to existing methods such as YOLOv3 and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) - Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

Author Keywords: Generative Adversarial Network and Long Short-Term Memory

articleTitle: Neural Network Algorithm for Designing Intelligent Psychological Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The emergence of intelligent psychological monitoring system can effectively provide the accuracy and related efficiency of psychological evaluation, explore the optimization and transfer process of psychological counseling, and assist psychological counselors to complete related work, so as to realize psychological evaluation and related intelligence and reference. The purpose of this paper is to automatically identify the key information related to psychological state from a large number of multi-source data through the intelligent psychological monitoring system based on neural network algorithm, and to weight it. Through experimental verification, this model has achieved good performance in the classification and prediction of psychological state, and realized the real-time monitoring and evaluation of individual psychological state, effectively extracted psychological characteristics from multi-source data, and classified and predicted them, which has important theory.

articleTitle: Robotization of Agriculture Using Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The transition from traditional farming techniques to smart agriculture, powered by IoT, marks a significant milestone in the quest for sustainable and efficient farming. Throughout history, agriculture has been at the forefront of human advancement, continuously evolving to enhance productivity and quality to meet the growing needs of the global population. The integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) into agriculture represents a pivotal development, aiming to revolutionize traditional farming practices. By incorporating IoT, the sector addresses both age-old and contemporary challenges, including climate-related disasters and the persistent threats of pests and diseases. IoT technologies facilitate the monitoring of critical agricultural parameters, leading to smarter, more efficient farming practices that reduce labor intensity, cut costs, and diminish the reliance on manual agriculturalist intervention through automation. This study proposes the creation of an autonomous agricultural ecosystem that links physical farming tools and infrastructure with the digital world, thereby optimizing irrigation management and enhancing crop health monitoring. The ultimate objective is to aid farmers in cultivating healthier crops through a system that not only withstands but thrives amidst the challenges of modern agriculture.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Analysis of Cell Voltage Balancing Techniques for Lithium-Ion EV Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The performance of Lithium-ion batteries utilized in Electric Vehicles (EVs) is impacted by a range of factors, including undervoltage, overvoltage, overcharge, over discharge, cell voltage imbalance, & thermal runaway. Among these, cell voltage imbalance is particularly significant as it varies among cells within battery pack. This imbalance, along with extended charging & discharging times, leads to a rapid decrease in battery capacity. To prolong the lifespan of a battery pack, it's essential to regularly equalize the cell voltages to minimize differences between cells. Various techniques for cell voltage balancing exist, broadly categorized as passive & active methods. This study undertakes modeling and simulation analysis using fixed resistor, switched shunt resistor passive cell voltage balancing, & inductive shuttling method for active cell voltage balancing for 4-cell Lithium-ion EV batteries using MATLAB. A comprehensive analysis is carried out for the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Objective Optimization System for Construction Engineering Under BIM and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Previous studies have often focused on optimizing a single objective, such as cost reduction or shortened project timelines. This single objective optimization method may overlook other key factors such as sustain ability, quality, and safety, leading to poor overall project performance. This article utilizes building information modeling (BIM) technology to integrate various aspects of construction project information, and introduces multi-objective optimization techniques such as genetic algorithm (GA). At the same time, this article considers multiple objectives such as cost, duration, and sustainability to balance the relationship between different objectives and optimize overall project performance. It collects information related to construction projects, including data from various stages such as design, construction, and operation. The design optimization goals are: cost optimization, schedule optimization, sustain ability optimization, and quality optimization. This article uses BIM to create a three-dimensional model of a building and combines genetic algorithms for architectural design optimization. The experimental results show that the average cost of BIM-GA is 2365.7 yuan/square meter, and the combination of BIM and genetic algorithm can effectively shorten the construction period.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Visualization Method for Classic and Famous Prescriptions Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Relationships extraction using sMIL algorithm requires a set of classic and famous prescriptions data which is a data source that contains relational objects. The document data in this paper is the literature summary retrieved from the literature database such as PubMed. Therefore, in order to dig out the genetic data of the target syndrome of coronary heart in the literature as much as possible to improve the accuracy of excavation, data mining model where network decomposition and symptom combination are combined is proposed in this paper to mine the NEI gene data of the literature related to target syndrome in coronary heart disease with the help of a large number of previous literature research and previous research of the research group. Then final conclusion will be reached through comprehensively considering the mining results of these two methods. Data source of this paper is a large number of biomedical literatures containing classic and famous prescriptions in some disease.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of MPPT Solar Charge Controller Using Hill Climbing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The output power from a Photovoltaic (PV) module, aimed at charging a battery, relies on both the solar radiation it receives and the surrounding temperature. The voltage generated by the solar panel fluctuates due to variations in the solar light intensity. However, maintaining a constant voltage is important for charging batteries and powering DC loads. To achieve this, charge controllers are utilised. While PWM solar charge controllers suffice for lighter loads, this paper focuses on a Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) solar charge controller designed to charge a 12V lead acid battery efficiently from a solar panel. MPPT controllers are more advanced, offering 30 to 40% greater efficiency and numerous advantages over other controllers. The application of the Hill Climbing algorithm optimises the MPPT charge controller, ensuring maximum power generation by the solar PV panel under varying radiation levels. A hardware board is developed to facilitate the extraction of maximum power by the solar panel, effectively harnessing incident radiation.

Author Keywords: perturb and observe algorithm. hill climbing algorithm

articleTitle: Implementation of Image Caption Generation Using VGG16 and Resnet50
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: One of the biggest problems in computer vision is getting a machine to automatically show an image's content along with a phrase in natural language. Using deep learning models, this research demonstrates two separate methods to generate picture captions. The first method employs VGG16 for feature extraction followed by training a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model. In the second approach, ResNet50 is utilized for feature extraction, and a combined Convolutional Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM) model is trained for caption generation. Both VGG16 and ResNet50 are popular convolutional neural networks for extracting characteristics from images, while LSTM and CNN-LSTM are recurrent neural networks suitable for sequential data processing. By comparing these approaches, we evaluate their effectiveness in generating descriptive captions for images. Experimental results indicate the strengths and weaknesses of each method, providing insights into the interplay between feature extraction and captioning models in image understanding tasks.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Network for Optimization and Arrangement of Sports Events
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The huge scale sports event with large level competition as major content that has high effect on city if economic phase or along social stage. Along enhancement of human civilization, human realizes which hold of huge scale sports events have positive effect on economic and society brought certain negative impacts like resource waste and pollution of environment that has attracted the attention of investors and government. The reasonable arrangement of sports events is very important, and the application of artificial intelligence technology in sports event arrangement can greatly improve efficiency. In this research described a sports event optimization and arrangement technique depending on Deep Neural Network (DNN). Initially, that introduced a determination technique of sports event optimization and arrangement and introduced basic process of DNN and how to utilize for optimization and arrangement of sports events. The performance is evaluated in terms of Satisfaction with event arrangement and arrangement efficiency with before and after optimization. The experimental outcomes represent that method obtained high evaluation accuracy and high effectiveness for guidance and supervision of sport events. The number of matches taken from 100 to 200 matches for before and after optimization.

articleTitle: Exploring Automated Defense Technology of Artificial Intelligence in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: How to address the increasing number of network security threats and attacks? Traditional manual defense methods are no longer able to cope with them. This article provides an overview of the automated defense technology of artificial intelligence (AI) in network security. This article introduces the application fields of AI in network security, including intrusion detection and prevention, malicious code detection, and network traffic analysis. Then, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) model is proposed to achieve automated defense of network security. SVM divides traffic into normal and malicious based on the characteristics of network traffic, thereby achieving intrusion detection and identification of abnormal behavior. After experimental testing, the attack detection rate of the method in this article is between 94% -99%, which can effectively detect malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Tree-Based Recognition of AI-Generated Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper investigates AI writing. By inferring the basic rules of text generation, 12 indicators are constructed, and a decision tree model is established to determine whether the text is written by AI. Through randomly extracting paragraphs from articles and rewriting them with AI, the analysis reveals that AI-generated texts have simpler structures and convey more singular expressions, resulting in the identification of 12 distinct features. For AI-generated articles, a decision tree model is trained and tested using constructed data and indicators based on basic rules, facilitating the assessment of whether an article is AI-generated. In determining the origin of articles, a classification is made between Chinese and English articles, and a trained decision tree model is employed for classification. The results indicate that 8 Chinese articles are human-authored, while 2 English articles are AI-generated. Finally, regarding the issue of plagiarism in mathematical models, images, and formulas, data from both human and AI-generated sources are collected. Relevant indicators are extracted, and a decision tree model is established to classify examples. The research results are expected to deepen our understanding of AI text generation, holding significant implications for the study of AI writing.

articleTitle: Parted Security Method for Secure Data Exchange in Heterogeneous Applications Using Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In tackling the changing security issues in Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) applications, the Parted Secure Data Exchange Method (PSDEM) is a noteworthy development. In order to acknowledge the intrinsic heterogeneity of users and applications in WSNs, segment-based trust is crucial. PSDEM offers a sophisticated and adaptable approach to security by acknowledging that various areas of the network may require varying degrees of protection and customising security measures to those segments. PSDEM's primary novelty is its approach to reducing the erroneous rate of intrusions during data exchange periods. PSDEM presents a revolutionary paradigm where the vulnerability of one segment does not undermine the overall security of the entire data transmission. The proposed method is reliable in reducing the service latency, false rate, and service loss by 9.63%, 11.37%, and 10.68% for the maximum network regions used for data exchange.

articleTitle: Pearson Correlation Coefficient based Improved Least Square - Support Vector Machine for Cyber-Attack Detection in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The wide utilization of smart devices and enormous weakness of security in networks has maximized a count of cyber-attacks in Internet of Things (IoT). The detection and classification of malicious traffic is essential for ensuring a security of system in IoT. For detecting and classifying the vulnerable threats in IoT, proposed a Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC) based Improved Least Square - Support Vector Machine (ILS-SVM). The proposed algorithm provided high classification accuracy and detection rate with NSL-KDD dataset. The data are pre-processed by checking the missing values and normalization of data. Then the features are selected by using PCC and the selected features are classified by ILS-SVM method with high detection rate. The metrics taken for evaluating the proposed algorithm are accuracy, detection rate, precision and f1-score. The proposed PCC algorithm achieved 99.71% accuracy, 99.03% detection rate, 99.26% precision and 99.37% f1-score that is performed well than previous methods like Hybrid Feature Reduced method and Multi-class Support Vector Machine (SVM).

Author Keywords: improved least square - support vector machine

articleTitle: IoT Security Detection and Evaluation for Smart Cyber Infrastructures Using LSTMs with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: A computer network may be impacted by malware, computer viruses, and other hostile attacks. One of the most important elements of network security as an active defence technology is Intrusion Detection System (IDS). Issues with traditional intrusion detection systems include low detection effectiveness, inaccurate results, and an inability to handle new types of intrusions. This paper implemented a deep LSTMs with attention mechanism approach for IDS. The proposed technique is determined on Bot-IoT dataset, and z-score normalization is performed to normalize data. Information Gain (IG) is utilized to choose the features. A deep LSTMs with attention mechanism is used to effectively identify and categorize IDS effectively. The IG-deep LSTMs with attention mechanism achieves better accuracy using of 99.70% and 99.60% in NSL-KDD and CIC-IDS2017 datasets respectively.

articleTitle: Construction of Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Tracking System Under Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In response to the problem of difficulty in accurately tracking the actual path of traditional unmanned vehicles, this paper introduces the deep Q-network algorithm to study it. This article introduces the current research achievements in trajectory tracking of autonomous vehicles, and establishes the state space and action space of vehicles through the analysis of lateral and longitudinal forces, and constructs a vehicle dynamics model. This article optimizes the problems of classical deep Q-network algorithms, such as long training time and complex evaluation. Experimental testing shows that after 50 iterations, the reward of the deep Q-network algorithm model is 7.41, while the reward of the improved deep Q-network algorithm model is increased to 9.92, indicating a significant improvement in training effectiveness and tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Packet Loss Minimization and Enhanced Road Traffic Management using Improved Local Interconnect Network (ILIN) in VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: By using the Improved Local Interconnect Network (ILIN) protocol in place of the Local Interconnect Network (LIN) protocol, the study seeks to reduce the risk of accidents in the road traffic management for VANET. Through the use of an effective cluster head and gateway node selection strategy that takes into account a variety of criteria, including the distance between the node and sink, the distance between novel neighbor nodes, and residual energy, cluster-based routing in VANET is proposed in this research to avoid excessive packet loss in the network. In terms of reduced transmission latency by 7.25%, reduced network congestion by 9.36%, and enhanced information coverage area by 5.7%, throughput by 4.32%, and increased packet delivery ratio by 4.61%, simulation results demonstrate that the ILIN protocol outperformed the LIN protocol. The simulation findings demonstrate that the suggested ILIN protocol outperformed the LIN protocol in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Trajectory Map Matching Methods Based on Stream Computing and Mutual Voting
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In response to the problems of poor trajectory matching accuracy, high matching cost, limited map accuracy, and inability to handle large-scale trajectory data in current traditional map matching methods, this paper conducted research on trajectory map matching based on stream computing and mutual voting. Extracting trajectory data features through stream computing can better explain the characteristics and changes of trajectory data, improving the accuracy of large-scale trajectory data research. Mutual voting was used to study map matching, effectively processing continuously updated trajectory data, and utilizing information between similar trajectories for map matching. The map matching accuracy of the method studied in this article was over 95.9%. After 20 experiments, the average matching accuracy was 97.66%. Research on trajectory map matching methods based on streaming computing and mutual voting has improved the accuracy and real-time performance of map matching.

articleTitle: Malware Detection and Classification for Internet of Things Using Self-Attention Based Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) connects numerous intelligent devices providing security features that interact with default settings accessed through applications. Additionally, Deep Learning (DL)-based mechanisms was involved for malware detection to identify and mitigate attacks. The Adaptive Synthetic Sampling (ADASYN) technique addresses class imbalances, especially when splitter class instances are distributed data in complex patterns. The proposed Self-Attention based Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) classification method facilitates the handling of long-range dependencies in transferred data sequences offering high flexibility and adaptability to varying input lengths. For feature selection Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is utilized iteratively optimizes a solution in a high-dimensional space although it may have a low convergence rate due to its iterative process. The obtained results demonstrate the proposed Self-Attention based LSTM model achieves better accuracy reaching 98.05% on the NSL-KDD dataset and 99.01 % on the UNSW-NB15 dataset. These results ensure accurate classification compared to other existing methods, such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN).

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Algorithm and System of Accounting Entries Based on Unit Budget System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Preparing accounting entries is a tedious task that requires manual entry according to the unit's budget system and financial regulations. This study uses data mining and automation technology, combined with the unit's budget system and financial regulations, to design an algorithm and system for automatic generation of accounting entries. The article establishes corresponding data models and rules by analyzing the unit's budget system and financial regulations, and then uses data mining technology to extract key information from the unit's budget data and financial data to automatically generate accounting entries that comply with the regulations, and finally uses the system to import automatically generated accounting entries into the financial system to realize the automated accounting entry process. Experimental results show that the accuracy of this system ranges from 88% to 96%. This algorithm and system can greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of accounting entries.

articleTitle: Information Management System Platform for Landscape Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional landscape engineering management mainly relies on manual recording, which is prone to problems such as delayed information transmission and accumulation of errors, resulting in delayed project progress. The improved Xception model was adopted to automatically identify garden landscapes, and the garden landscape engineering information management system platform was constructed to digitize engineering information. A large number of garden landscape images were collected, denoised, and enhanced. The Xception model was improved, including changing the activation function to the Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) function and using global maximum pooling to capture features. The results from the test set indicated that the average landscape classification accuracy of the improved Xception model was 98.2%. Building an information management system for landscape engineering through improved Xception can effectively achieve automated landscape classification and improve the accuracy of landscape classification.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Data-Driven Financial Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The design and implementation of financial decision support systems can provide more accurate, comprehensive and real-time decision support through data-driven methods, helping organizations make informed financial decisions in an uncertain economic environment. This study explores the design and implementation of a financial decision support system based on a data-driven approach. By collecting a large amount of financial data, including financial statements, market data and other related data, and using data analysis and modeling techniques to process and mine the data, this article develops a prototype of a financial, decision support system to visualize data analysis results and, provide real-time decision support. Experimental tests show that the financial decision-making accuracy of this article is between 87% and 98%, which can provide comprehensive, accurate and real-time financial information to help decision-makers better understand and analyze financial conditions and trends.

articleTitle: Research on the Recognition of Accounting Information Distortion by Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Distortion of accounting information is a situation where an enterprise's financial reports are untrue or deliberately distorted, which may lead to misleading and losses for investors and stakeholders. In this study, a random forest algorithm is used to identify accounting information distortion. First, a real accounting data set containing normal and distorted samples was collected. Then, according to the principle of feature engineering, a series of features related to the distortion of accounting information are extracted. Next, the data set is divided into training set and test set, and the random forest algorithm is used to train the training set and optimize the model. Finally, the test set is used to evaluate the performance of the model and compare it with traditional methods. The experimental results show that the accuracy rate of the algorithm in this paper is between 90% and 97%, and the random forest algorithm has achieved significant performance advantages in the recognition of accounting information distortion. Compared with traditional methods, random forest algorithms show a higher level of accuracy.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Environment Construction and Teaching Simulation of Vocational Preschool Education Professional Practice Center Based on Cloud Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In response to the problems of false environment construction, poor teaching effectiveness, and low student learning enthusiasm in the current virtual reality environment construction and teaching simulation research of vocational preschool education professional practice centers, this article used cloud computing technology (CCT) to study the existing problems. With the help of cloud computing technology, the virtual real scene environment of the vocational preschool education professional practice center was built to help students and teachers to teach according to a more real environment. The quality and efficacy of instruction can be increased by mimicking preschool instruction using cloud computing technology. The user rating for the virtual reality environment of the vocational preschool education professional practice center constructed based on cloud computing technology was above 4.49, and 15 users were selected with an average score of 4.6 out of 5. This article explored the construction of a virtual reality environment and teaching simulation method for vocational preschool education professional practice centers based on cloud computing technology, providing a good teaching mode and tool for preschool education practice, effectively improving students' learning enthusiasm.

articleTitle: Python- Driven Organ Management System based on DJANGO Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Modern organ donation and transplantation systems have special requirements and challenges in relation to regis-tration, donor-recipient pairing, organ removal, organ delivery, and transplantation. It also present technological, ethical, legal, and clinical constraints. Therefore, to provide a just and effective procedure that improves patient experience and trust, an final result of organ-transplantation & donation system is needed. Numerous Ethereum blockchain-based private solutions are available to facilitate organ donation and transplantation administration; nevertheless, their scalability, accuracy, and authenticity are limited, despite their substantial flexibility. The suggested web platform for managing organ donations, powered by Python, is intended to provide an easy-to-use and safe interface that will expedite and simplify the organ donation procedure. The platform prioritizes user verification and offers unique features for donors, recipients, and administrators. Users can create accounts and manage comprehensive profiles that include personal data, medical histories, and donation preferences. To maximize the likelihood of successful organ transplants, a sophisticated matching system that uses algorithms to match possible donors with recipients based on compatibility parameters including organ type, location, and urgency is essential to its operation. In order to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed organ donation model, the python driven-model performance parameter are overlaid on the Blockchain-driven performance parameter. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model offers better Scalability, Accuracy, Authentication with significant Flexibility. Further, the proposed python-Driven model achieves approximately 8% and 10% improvements in Accuracy and Scalability respectively against the existing model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Intelligence Analysis Algorithm Based on Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, intelligence has become a focus and hotspot in the field of intelligence analysis research. This article studied intelligent intelligence analysis algorithms based on regression analysis methods. Firstly, the definition and characteristics of intelligent intelligence analysis were introduced, as well as the classification of intelligent intelligence analysis algorithms. Then, the basic ideas and principles of regression analysis algorithms were elaborated, and the application of regression analysis algorithms in intelligent intelligence analysis was explored. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm studied in the article was verified through experiments. The research results indicated that the error rate of the intelligent intelligence analysis algorithm based on regression analysis reached a minimum of 12.2%, and the efficiency reached a maximum of 94.5%.

articleTitle: Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm and Optimized Long Short-Term Memory for DDoS Cyber Security Threat
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks is a critical cyber security threat that blocks the services for users and leads to important damage for reputation and effective customers. The existing methods provides low classification accuracy due to irrelevant features in classification performance. The Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm (IWOA) is proposed for the selecting of relevant features which improved the classification performance. The selected features are detected and classified by Optimized Long Short-Term Memory (OLSTM) that provided high detection rate of DDoS attacks. The one-hot encoding and min-max normalization techniques are used in the data pre-processing stage to improve the performance of classification. The CIC-DDoS 2019 dataset are used for evaluating the proposed method. The IWOA-OLSTM method attained highest accuracy 97.12%, precision 96.74%, recall 96.27%. f1-score 96.54% and DR 93.26% on CIC-DDoS 2019 dataset which is effective than Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) - Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) and CNN-LSTM.

Author Keywords: cyber security distributed denial of service

articleTitle: Multi Head Attention Based Confusion Module for English Grammer Error Correction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Grammar Error Correction (GEC) is main task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that is currently attracted high attention among researchers. Referred to satisfactory outcomes of universal language in GEC task and research lack on GEC task in less resource languages. The research proposed a Multi Head Attention based Confusion Module (MHA based CM) method for grammar error correction model. The proposed MHA method has copy mechanism for addressing unknown and particular words which appeared in sentences of sources. Additionally, to over come the data sparsity in sentences here proposed semi supervised confusion module method and that trained the data from monolingual corpus. The dataset used for evaluation in the research are synthesized data. The performance of proposed method is evaluated in terms of precision, recall, fl-score and BELU score. The proposed MHA based CM method attained highest precision 84.32%, recall 85.67%, fl-score 85.51 % and BLEU 66.14% which is superior than other neural networks like Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

Author Keywords: Natural Language Processing and Semi Supervised

articleTitle: Analysis of IPv6 Deployment Scheme Based on SDN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The article takes a certain university as the research object and combines the concept of SDN architecture to propose an IPv6 deployment scheme based on VXLAN. This scheme achieves decoupling and merging of control plane and user plane, automatically distributes IPv6 addresses according to user attributes, and issues corresponding security policies. Users and terminals in the network can access the campus network at anytime and anywhere without location restrictions, and can enjoy dual access capabilities of both IPv4 Internet and IPv6 based next-generation Internet.

articleTitle: Half-Ring End Structure Analysis of a Rotary-Linear SPM Motor for Torque Improving
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In this paper, A half-ring end construction on a rotary-linear SPM motor with a voice coil is examined in this research to enhance output torque. The first is a surface-mounted rotary-linear PM coil motor (RL-SCM) with full-ring flux magnetic end-part bridges. The structure and fundamental operation of the RL-SVCM are examined. Following that, an RL-SVCM with half-ring flux bridges is proposed to improve the motor output rotational torque. The reluctance torque is added to the rotational torque by the installation of half-ring flux bridges. The overall torque is enhanced. Meanwhile, the force of linear motion varies more often than in the full-ring construction.

articleTitle: Reducing Energy Consumption Using Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory-ECG Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper presents a neural network-based processor that enhances computation efficiency for achieving multi-class pulse recognition in wearable devices. Using a combination of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and bi-directional long short-term memory (BLSTM) is recommended for achieving high accuracy with a small network size. Hardware architecture achieves a significant level of compute reuse by using the similarity between consecutive heartbeats to reduce the energy consumption of the categorization process. Neural network compression techniques are used during the inference phase to save hardware resources. Based on the simulation, this processor operates with a 1.1 V power supply and has a frequency of 100 MHz, achieving an average power efficiency of 8147mW. The suggested processor achieves a significant improvement in energy efficiency, with a 61.27% decrease in energy dissipation per categorization. Additionally, it demonstrates a substantial performance enhancement, with a 2.58x increase in performance compared to the architecture without compute reuse. This research is a significant investigation into the use of neural networks for continuous monitoring of abnormal heart rhythms in daily activities.

articleTitle: Automated Cybersecurity Attack Detection Using Prairie Dog Optimization and Multilayer Perceptron in Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technologies have become an inevitable part of our lives with many innovations and conveniences in many fields such as education, healthcare, social life and security. While healthcare network complexity and connectivity are developing in a superior manner at the same time, cyber-attack surfaces and vulnerabilities are also increasing dramatically. Harming people either physically or digitally are some of the threat to the health and life of patients through data breaches across multiple departments of health systems. In this research, the prairie dog optimization (PDO) algorithm and multilayer perceptron (MLP) is proposed cyber-attack detection model. The proposed approach was performed the several IoMT cybersecurity datasets using Intensive Care Unit (ICU Dataset), Washington University in St. Louis enhanced healthcare monitoring system (WUSTL-EHMS) datasets, Edith Cowan University- Internet of Health Things (ECU-IoHT), and TON-IoT. PDO is used for selecting the optimal features from the attained dataset, MLP parameters is performed by hyperparameter optimization as well as 10-fold cross-validation technique for performance assessment. The proposed method has the potential to counter cyber-attacks in healthcare applications, it attained higher precision at 99.54%, accuracy of 99.45%, recall 99.56% and f1-score 99.46% in ECU-IoHT dataset.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection using Auto-encoder Neural Networks and MLP
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the increasing reliance on networked systems across various domains, ensuring the security of these networks has become paramount. Intrusion Detection System plays a crucial role in safeguarding networks by identifying and mitigating malicious activities. Traditional IDS approaches often struggle with the complexity and variability of modern network attacks. In this study, we propose a novel approach leveraging Auto-encoders in conjunction with Multi - Layer perceptron for network intrusion detection. Three distinct algorithms were implemented and evaluated: Auto-encoders, Auto-encoders combined with Multilayer Perceptron, and Convolution Neural Networks. The experiments demonstrated promising results, showcasing the effectiveness of each algorithm in detecting network intrusions. This multi-algorithmic approach not only enhances detection accuracy but also broadens the scope of potential threats identified. The findings underscore the significance of employing a diverse set of machine learning techniques in network security which is effective for anomaly detection with less labeled data, finding hidden patterns in complex network traffic, and potentially working well with imbalanced data.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Network Live Streaming Recommendation System Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the viewing volume of users and the conversion rate of new users, the author proposes a network live streaming recommendation system based on collaborative filtering algorithm. Firstly, based on Spark, Flink, search engines Elasticsearch, Kafka, data warehouse Hbase, etc., build a user oriented big data recommendation system. Experimental results have shown that the Flink algorithm runs much faster than the Flink algorithm, and its runtime increases with user behavior. However, the runtime of Flink remains almost unchanged, and the gap between the two is gradually widening. At the same time as 80000 words, the processing speed of Spark Streaming has reached 2 seconds. If Spark Streaming and other technologies are used to implement an online recommendation engine, combined with the processing time of other modules, the entire online processing time will far exceed 2 seconds, greatly exceeding the requirements of online processing. On this basis, the author proposes a Flink based recommendation method, which can effectively improve the real-time performance of recommendations. The results indicate that the system is feasible.

articleTitle: Sliced Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit with Sparrow Search Optimizer for Detecting the Attacks in IoT Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In an era characterized by pervasive interconnectivity facilitated by the widespread adoption of Internet of Things (IoT) devices across diverse domains, novel cybersecurity challenges have emerged, underscoring the imperative for robust intrusion detection systems. Conventional security frameworks, constrained by their closed-system architecture, struggle to adapt to the dynamic threat landscape marked by the continual emergence of unprecedented attacks. This paper presents a methodology aimed at mitigating the open set recognition (OSR) challenge within IoT-specific Network Intrusion Detection Schemes (NIDS). Leveraging image-based representations of data, our approach focuses on extracting geographical traffic patterns. We observe that the Recurrent Neural Network exhibits suboptimal classification accuracy and lacks parallelizability for attack analysis tasks. Our investigation concludes that the Sparrow Search Optimization Algorithm (SSOA) serves as a foundation for constructing an effective assault classification model. This research contributes significantly to the field of network security by emphasizing the importance and ramifications of meticulous hyperparameter tuning. It represents a critical stride toward developing IDSs capable of effectively navigating the evolving cyber threat landscape. In the experimental analysis of proposed model reached the accuracy and 0.963% respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizing Environmental Sustainability: Analyzing IoT-Enabled Energy Harvesting Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The increasing demand for sustainable energy solutions in loT networks is being addressed by this research, which looks into energy harvesting technologies to fuel loT devices for autonomous environmental monitoring. We implemented loT sensors with solar, vibration, and thermal harvesters in a variety of settings and ran simulations to estimate energy usage and network communication efficiency. The results showed that solar energy harvesters were the most efficient, meeting up to 80% of the energy needs when operating at peak efficiency. With the system sustaining over 95% communication uptime across scenarios, vibration harvesters performed exceptionally well in urban contexts, while heat harvesters showed potential in industrial settings. These findings demonstrate the strong potential for dependable environmental monitoring through the integration of energy harvesting with loT. The study comes to the conclusion that although solar harvesting is the most feasible energy option at the moment, hybrid models and cutting-edge energy storage strategies should be the focus of future research to further improve the sustainability and efficiency of systems.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Personalized News Recommendation Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of information overload caused by users' demand for information in the information age, the author proposes a personalized news recommendation algorithm based on deep learning. Integrate attention mechanism into NCF. Specifically, it is based on the assumption that different cross features have varying degrees of impact on the results, considering the varying degrees of impact of different features on the model, adjusting the weights of features, and optimizing losses. The experimental results show that the attribute based NCF algorithm has achieved good results on both samples, far exceeding several popular algorithms currently. The HR of video websites are 0.747, 0.453, 0.890, and 0.563, respectively. In the same experimental environment and data set, the test results show that compared with NCF, the performance indicators of this algorithm have been improved. The optimization of this algorithm has significantly improved the accuracy of news recommendations, while also enhancing the user experience, enabling users to more quickly find content of interest amidst a vast amount of information.

articleTitle: Using an Extreme Learning Machine and an Extended Kalman Filter, State of Charge Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: When discussing battery management systems (BMSs), one of their most crucial tasks is undoubtedly detecting the state of charge (SoC) of the battery. Background of electrochemical properties of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), accurately estimating the SoC can be challenging. This study proposes an approach that combines the use of a machine learning technique, the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM), with an extended Kalman filter (EKF) to improve the accuracy of SoC estimation. First, we develop an accurate model of LIBs using ELM. EKF approach with the trained ELM model to estimate the SoC. To validate our approach, compare it with a traditional EKF methodology, the Equivalent Circuit Model (ECM)-EKF, using the Federal Urban Driving Schedule (FUDS) movement over three warming cycles. Results achieved show that the ELM can more accurately monitor voltage compared to the ECM, and the ELM-EKF-based SoC estimation provides more precise voltage estimates compared to ECM-EKF.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on HBA-MCKD-MFFR for Hydroelectric Power Units
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Honey Badger Algorithm-Maximum Correlation Kurtosis Deconvolution with Multi-scale Feature Fusion ResNet (HBA-MCKD-MFFR) is proposed in this research as the solution to the problem of improper feature of failure signals in the original hydropower unit due to vibration of the external environment and distortion. First, this research come up with an HBA-MCKD improvement approach where HBA algorithm is utilized to find the optimal parameters of Maximum Correlation Kurtosis Deconvolution (MCKD). Subsequently, a diagnosis model with attentive multi-scale feature fusion ResNet is presented to account for local feature contributions. Multiscale residual blocks can be utilized where the features retrieved at different scales feed into MFFR for training and classification. Experiment results will demonstrate that this method performs well, with the fault type classification accuracy of 99.23% exceeding other top algorithms.

articleTitle: Hybrid Adam Coati Optimization with DLSTM for Biomedical Parameter Prediction Using Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: A real-time patient monitoring system procesfses a wide range of biomedical parameters and can store and safely capture biomedical parameters. It lowers the diagnosis time of the several diseases that are prevalent in healthcare services. Accurate prediction of biomedical parameters can significantly reduce healthcare costs and assist in effective decision-making. This research proposes a deep learning approach with hybrid optimization for biomedical parameter prediction by using sensors. At first, a healthcare centre with many patients having various disorders is considered. Several biomedical sensors are placed on the patients and these sensors include a respiratory Rate (RR) sensor, Heart rate (HR) sensor, Pulse Rate (PR) sensor, Ambulatory Blood Pressure (ABP)-sensor, and Saturation of Peripheral Oxygen (SpO2). Based on these sensed parameters, biomedical parameter prediction by using sensor based Deep Long Short-Term Memory (DLSTM)is executed. The DLSTM is trained using the proposed Hybrid Adam Coati Optimization(HAdCO). Here, the HAdCO is developed by incorporating of Coati Optimization Algorithm (COA) with Adam Optimizer. Furthermore, the HAdCO-DLSTM is evaluated by utilising metrics, like Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), and Mean Squared Error (MSE). The HAdCO-DLSTM had a minimal value of MAE at 0.0063, MSE at 0.0062, and RMSE at 0.0078.

articleTitle: SOC Modeling Simulation of Equivalent Circuit of Lithium-Sulfur Battery
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Battery management system (BMS) includes the main functions of state estimation, safety protection, parameter testing and information management. The most core function of BMS is to estimate state-of-charge (SOC). Prerequisite for BMS to be able to accurately perform SOC estimation is to have a model with high accuracy. In this paper, the impedance spectral characteristics of each SOC point of lithium-sulfur batteries (LiSBs) are tested. First-order resistor-capacitance (RC) equivalent circuit model (ECM) and second-order RC ECM are both established. The experimental data are used to identify the parameters of the model and complete the modeling. MATLAB/Simulink is used to build a simulation platform to complete the simulation verification of LiSBs constant current discharge condition. The simulation results show that the maximum simulation error of the first-order RC ECM is about 3%, and the average value of the errors in the total interval is 19.8 mV. The simulation error of the 2nd-order ECM is 0.9% with an average value of the error in the total interval of 4.3 mV. The 2nd-order ECM fits the actual discharge condition of LiSBs more accurately. The research results of this paper can provide technical support for the development of energy storage systems for green airports.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Ensemble Stacking for Enhanced Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease remains a noteworthy global health concern, warranting accurate prediction methods for early diagnosis and intervention This research investigates the application of fundamental machine learning models for predicting Cardiovascular Disease (CVD) hazards while exploring the effectiveness of ensemble stacking techniques to enhance predictive accuracy. Basic models including Random Forest, Decision Tree, XG Boost,Gaussian Naïve Bayes, and Light GBM were trained and evaluated on a comprehensive dataset containing patient attributes and clinical indicators related to CVD. To solve the issue of class imbalance, the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) was utilized. Subsequently, an ensemble stacking approach was employed to combine predictions from these models, demonstrating its ability to boost predictive performance. Results showcase the superiority of the ensemble stacking method, yielding a remarkable accuracy of 98.4%. This study highlights the comparative performance of basic machine learning models and underscores the potency of ensemble techniques in significantly improving predictive accuracy for CVD risk assessment, emphasizing their potential in proactive healthcare management.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection with XAI: Improving Interpretability and Trust
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Fraud detection is crucial for financial institutions to protect clients' funds and maintain trust in online payment systems. However, traditional machine learning models often lack interpretability due to advanced fraud methods. This study proposes a framework that integrates advanced machine learning algorithms with XAI to improve the interpretability of fraud detection models. The framework explains model predictions clearly, helping stakeholders understand and verify system decisions. The Kaggle dataset is pre-processed, i.e., classes are balanced before implementing the ML techniques. The pre-processed Kaggle dataset is used to implement various ML algorithms, with the Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) method used during the prediction phase. Decision tree and Random Forest outperform other ML techniques, achieving 100% accuracy. This method clarifies the decision- making process, allowing stakeholders like financial analysts, lawmakers, and consumers to trust and confirm system results.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis Using Modified Inception Net and Support Vector Machine for Forecasting Copra Yield in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: One of the major economic sectors in various states is copra agriculture, with a significant portion of its global production coming from countries such as India, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. However, the severity of copra issues can vary depending on factors such as moisture levels, fungal presence, and the quality of the copra, leading to imbalanced data and potential overfitting in copra image analysis. Threshold-based segmentation is involved to identify different segments of copra based on factors like moisture content. Higher moisture content may indicate areas prone to fungal growth or poor drying conditions, while segments with uniform colour and texture may signify high-quality copra. The proposed approach involves using the Modified Inception Net (MIN) for feature extraction and Support Vector Machine (SVM) for hyperparameter tuning. SVM handles the kernel function in nonlinear and high-dimensional spaces, enhancing its capabilities and mitigating overfitting. However, the MIN-SVM combination may require significant computational resources, particularly during training and parameter tuning. The proposed MIN-SVM method achieves promising performance metrics, including a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.071, Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.0125, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of 0.620 and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R^{2}$</tex> value of 0.9410. This performance is compared to existing methods such as Back Propagation Algorithm (BPA), K-means and SVM.

articleTitle: Farming Futures: Machine Learning Models for Crop Yield Prediction
