Traditional methods only identify the lane from a single frame, and they offer performance with difficulties when handling extreme scenarios like lane line erosion, big shadows, significant vehicle occlusion, noisy image inputs, etc. In practical terms, lanes are intended to be continuous line constructions on the road. As a result, information from earlier frames can be used to extrapolate a lane that is not clearly visible in the current frame. The deep neural network architecture is used to analyse highways to provide driving assistance for vehicles. Two more subtasks are included in road analysis. The deep neural network framework is introduced with the goal of using the least amount of hardware and software setup possible to help this driving function, if not completely automate it. The proposed framework's ability to be used in real-time due to its low complexity. The accuracy of the pipeline's classification of road signs, its capacity to collect data about the road, and its time bench-marking performance are the first three metrics used to quantify the pipeline's performance.

articleTitle: Image Compression and Transmission Optimization Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This research aims to explore optimization methods for image compression and transmission based on deep learning. Firstly, we Learn the compact representation of an image by using convolutional autoencoders to achieve lossy compression. Furthermore, we investigated methods for training image compression models using deep neural networks (DNN), exploring how to achieve efficient image compression while maintaining image quality through deep learning techniques. We also focused on the application of Deep Reinforcement Learning (Deep RL) in transmission optimization strategies, aiming to reduce transmission time or bandwidth usage while maintaining image quality. In the experimental section, we will discuss the selection and characteristics of the dataset, experimental design and setup, performance analysis of deep learning models, and the effectiveness evaluation of optimization strategies. In conclusion, we will demonstrate the effectiveness and potential application value of the proposed methods through result visualization and comparison. This research provides new directions and approaches for further research and application in the field of image transmission, aiming to enhance the efficiency and quality of image transmission.

articleTitle: Efficient PCB Fault Detection: A TensorRT-Based Inference Acceleration Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The demand for high-quality printed circuit boards (PCBs) necessitates rigorous fault detection to ensure product reliability, particularly considering the susceptibility of PCBs to connection issues in harsh environmental conditions. This paper presents a real-time fault detection system for PCBs utilizing the YOLOv8 object detection framework. A native YOLOv8 implementation is employed for model training, fine-tuning it on a custom PCB fault dataset to achieve precise detection of various defect types. Additionally, the trained model is optimized using NVIDIA's TensorRT framework, significantly enhancing inference speed. This approach enables the integration of high-performance, deep learning-based fault detection into resource-constrained PCB production environments, demonstrating superior accuracy and efficiency compared to traditional inspection methods. This advancement facilitates cost-effective quality control in PCB manufacturing. By showcasing the effectiveness of employing YOLOv8 and TensorRT for real-time fault detection in PCB manufacturing, the research underscores the importance of timely defect detection in ensuring the reliability and quality of electronic devices PCBs, representing a significant step forward in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Secure Computation of Maximum and Minimum Values in data Aggregation Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Data aggregation is the process of combining multiple data points or data sets into a larger data set. Through calculation, statistics or other means, it can provide higher level data information, which is widely used in different data types and fields such as database query, data analysis, data mining and data processing. In data processing scenarios, data aggregation functions play a key role. They are used to perform aggregate calculations on data, such as finding the maximum, minimum, and maximum difference of multiple data. However, it is important to pay special attention to protecting sensitive information and privacy when performing data aggregation. Aiming at this problem, based on the threshold NTRU encryption algorithm with additive homomorphism, combining the vector encoding method and the ciphertext re-randomization method, this paper proposes a secure calculation protocol for the maximum value, minimum value and maximum difference in multi-party data sets under the semi-honest model. To verify the security of the proposed protocol, we use the simulation paradigm approach for security proof and show that the protocol can resist the attack of the maximum number of colluders. Through theoretical analysis and simulation experiments, we show the high efficiency of the proposed scheme, and prove that the protocol has practical value.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Routing in Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Through Cluster-Dragonfly Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In this paper, develop a power control scheme for underwater wireless sensor networks that takes into account the impact of communication ranges on network performance, including energy utilization and delay overhead. The primary objective of our scheme is to assign a differentiated optimal communication radius for each sensor node, enhancing overall network efficiency. The proposed method utilizes energy-aware Cluster-Dragonfly Optimization (CDFO), but it might face challenges in handling large-scale optimization, and the scalability of the algorithm may be limited when dealing with high-dimensional or complex optimization. Although the proposed CDFO method exhibits high performance compared to existing methods, such as Self-Adaptive Glow Worm Swarm Optimization (SA-GWO), Improved Coyote Optimization Algorithm (ICOA), Hybrid Cat Cheetah Optimization algorithm (HCCOA), and Chaotic Search-and-Rescue Optimization (CSRO), it may still face challenges in terms of handling large-scale optimization. Nevertheless, the proposed CDFO yields impressive results, achieving a Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) of 99%, Packet Loss Ratio (PLR) of 4%, Energy Consumption of 9%, and Alive Node count of 330. These outcomes outperform existing methods in the context of Underwater WSN.

Author Keywords: self-adaptive glow worm swarm optimization and underwater wireless sensor network

articleTitle: Deepfake Face Extraction and Detection Using MTCNN-Vision Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Deepfake detection is a major problem nowadays. The deepfake detection can be done using face extraction and detection. Strong solutions for face extraction and detection are required in light of the growing prevalence of deepfake technology. This paper combines Vision Transformers with Multi-Task Cascaded Convolutional Networks (MTCNN) to propose a novel method. This approach leverages the real-time face identification skills of MTCNN and the long-range dependency capture ability of Vision Transformers to improve the accuracy of detecting manipulated faces in deepfake footage. We carry out extensive experiments on several deepfake datasets, demonstrating the efficacy of the suggested hybrid strategy. The proposed model findings show that this approach performs better than conventional face identification techniques, particularly when dealing with situations where minor facial alterations are involved. This integration strikes a good compromise between computing efficiency and precision, which makes it a viable option for practical uses. The proposed MT-VIT (Multi-Task Vision Transformer) model provides good accuracy as compared to other state-of-the-art like Residual Networks, Mobile Net, CNN, and Meso-Net.

articleTitle: Detection of Damages in Wire Ropes Using Computer Vision Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Wire ropes are one of the most commonly used objects in industries and at construction sites. These are used to lift heavy objects and are part of cranes. Wire ropes are constantly exposed to all forms of nature such as heat from the sun and the humidity from the rain, additionally, wire ropes lift very heavy weights, which makes them prone to damage. If these damages were gone without notice, they may cause severe accidents. Thus, this study was performed to develop a model that can detect the damages in wire ropes using the deep learning algorithm YOLOv8. YOLOv8 is a computer vision-based system that is precisely known for its best object detection skills. The model was trained using a hybrid dataset consisting of 2892 images. The model showed an accuracy of 98.31%. This developed model using YOLOv8 is reliable for real-time detection of wire rope damage.

articleTitle: Sports Event Detection Using a 3D Convolutional Neural Network with Equiangular Basis Vector in Video Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As sports video collections continue to expand at a rapid pace, there is a need for advanced classification methods that can accurately and efficiently categorize and manage the massive amount of content available. These methods must be able to dynamically adapt to changes in the collection, ensuring that the videos are properly organized and easily searchable for users. Traditional classification methods are not able to keep up with the rapid growth and complexity of sports video collections, leading to incomplete classification and impacting search and retrieval processes. This paper addresses this challenge using the UCF sports dataset and proposes a Visual Geometry Group-19 (VGG-19) based CNN classifier and Equiangular Basis Vector (EBV) representation introduced for efficient classification and category representation. Furthermore, a 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) architecture extracts both spatial and temporal features from videos for accurate action classification. The Adam optimizer in the optimization algorithm is employed to optimize the learning process. This paper shows that the proposed 3D-CNN model outperforms existing methods a Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network with a Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network (HCNN-BiRNN) model, Deformable Convolution Networks (DCN), 2D-Convolutional Neural Network (2D-CNN), Convolutional Neural Network - Long Short-Term Frequency (CNN-LSTM) in terms of accuracy (99.45%), precision (98.00%), sensitivity (96.98%), and F1-score (97.05%).

articleTitle: Refraction-Learning Based Whale Optimization Algorithm with Opposition-Learning and Adaptive Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In this paper, the development of an enhanced variant of the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) is proposed which addresses some of the limitations, namely slow convergence speed, a tendency to get stuck in local optima, and loss of population diversity. The proposed variant integrates novel strategies namely Refraction Learning (RL) and Opposition-Based Learning (OBL) along with an adaptive parameter optimization mechanism. Owing to the unique amalgamation of the above-mentioned strategies, the performance of the conventional WOA is augmented by intensifying the search process and smoothing it overall. This leads to superior performance in the case of multi-modal landscapes, escaping local optima, and a more eclectic investigation of the search space. Through comprehensive benchmark testing across 23 functions, demonstration occurs that the algorithm outperforms the original WOA and other modern optimization techniques. The proposed WOA variant shows significant improvements in terms of convergence rate, global search ability, and solution accuracy. The empirical results highlight the strengths of the approach and indicate its potential as an effective optimization tool for solving complex real-world problems.

articleTitle: Construction of Foreign Language Translation Recognition System Model Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the development of economic globalization, many foreign languages have become the most common languages in the world and have been increasingly applied. However, there is a shortage of personnel with high foreign language proficiency in various industries. People should strengthen the cultivation of language skills according to market needs. Translation is the core of language ability, and in order to apply foreign languages to practical communication activities, it is necessary to pay attention to the correction and research of foreign language pronunciation. Previously, foreign language translation systems were conducted according to the instructions of teachers, which not only consumed a lot of manpower but also made it difficult to implement. Therefore, it is very important to research and establish an intelligent translation system. This mode can monitor students' foreign language pronunciation and provide correct suggestions. The traditional intelligent recognition mode and settings for foreign language translations are not accurate enough to accurately recognize foreign language translations, correct foreign language pronunciation correctly, and even produce incorrect pronunciation, thereby affecting foreign language learning. Based on the above issues, this article studied an intelligent foreign language translation recognition model based on CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) algorithm and DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) algorithm, in order to automatically recognize foreign language translations. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model, simulation experiments were conducted in the simulated environment in the article. The experimental results showed that compared to existing systems, the machine synchronous translation system of artificial intelligence technology and speech recognition (in this article) had the highest translation recognition accuracy of 95 00%.

articleTitle: Algae Recognition and Usage Prediction Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Algae species are essential to many environmental processes, such as the sequestration of carbon, the creation of oxygen, and the cycling of nutrients. Precise identification and forecasting of algae species are crucial for comprehending the dynamics of ecosystems, evaluating the quality of water, and creating sustainable solutions like the manufacturing of biofuel. However, conventional techniques for classifying algae are frequently labor-intensive and prone to human mistake. In response, a unique method that uses deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to automate the procedure presented in this study. Through the process of selecting and organizing a wide range of algal picture datasets and the application of data augmentation techniques, an attempt to improve the model's capacity to generalize to other species and environmental circumstances. With the help of the deep CNN architecture, an attempt to accurately identify and forecast species from photographs of algae by extracting complex patterns and traits. Through extensive experimentation, this method performs better than traditional methods, underscoring its potential to transform algae-related research and applications in environmental science and other fields.

articleTitle: Advancing Human Computer Interaction Through a Hybrid EEG-Based Emotion Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: An emotional recognition system helps human-computer interaction systems by using a deep learning approach to find pattern recognition. This research advances the HCI field and lays the foundation for a new era of emotionally intelligent and responsive technology interfaces. The EEG emotion recognition system is consisting of machine learning algorithms for preprocessing, feature extraction, feature selection, and classification. The original raw signal contains noise and irrelevant signals to be removed using ICA (independent component analysis). The next step is feature extraction to extract features such as variance, standard deviation, kurtosis, and entropy from the EEG signal using the discrete wavelet transform (DWT). These features are selected based on the type of emotion using linear discriminant analysis (LDA). The hybrid classification algorithm uses CNN (convolutional neural network) and GRU (gated recurrent unit) to classify the emotion. The results of this hybrid classification model are precision, accuracy, and sensitivity for better outcomes.

articleTitle: Leveraging Natural Language Processing for In-Depth Analysis and Insights from Hospital Patient Feedback Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The patient's feedback is a key component in enhancing healthcare service. This research employed sophisticated NLP tools to analyze the feedback of 500 hospitals in Bangalore, India, aiming at improving healthcare quality. Experimenting with various Python libraries, the research began preprocessing feedback employing tokenization, using LDA for topic modeling and VADER for sentiment analysis. The analysis highlighted core areas of patient concern and satisfaction, with treatment quality, staff/doctor interactions, and general service delivery being the most pronounced. Sentiment analysis detected close to 0.6 positive sentiment scores for treatment quality, staff interaction and other facilities received moderate positive expressions, about 0.4 and 0.35, respectively. This paper demonstrates the success of NLP in extracting valuable data from patient comments and provides patient satisfaction with diverse hospital services. The research presents useful directions for hospital administrators and healthcare providers to perfect service quality, indicating the role of advanced text analysis in patient care.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis for Defector in Banking System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: An essential component of risk management for financial organizations is predictive analysis for defectors in the banking system. The amount of credit transactions is growing, and conventional techniques frequently fail to reliably identify possible defaulters. In this paper, suggesting machine learning algorithms which helps to anticipate defaulters more effectively and accurately. Making use of an extensive dataset that includes credit history, transactional data, and demographic data, we apply ANN, random forests, and K-means among other machine learning methods. By applying feature engineering approaches, the raw data is transformed into relevant insights that improve the models' predictive capacity. On both training and test datasets, the suggested models are assessed using common performance metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The outcomes of the experiments show how well the suggested method works to correctly identify possible defaulters, giving financial institutions the ability to proactively manage risks and streamline decision-making procedures. Detecting Defaulters with machine learning algorithms which produces 83% Accuracy,71% F-Score in Random Forest, 71% F-Score in Random Forest when compared to other Algorithms.

articleTitle: Applying a Structural Model to Assess the Efficiency of E-Government Implementation in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The world's shift to a smart society emphasizes how crucial it is to use information and communication technology (ICT) to provide inclusive and effective e-government services. With an emphasis on Iraq, this study looks at the adoption of electronic government in emerging countries. using structural equation modeling (SEM) with partial least squares (PLS). The results show that the behavioral intention of residents to utilize e-government services is highly influenced by developments in technology, performance expectancy, effort expectancy, social in-fluence, and facilitation. Notably, adoption is positively influenced by technological considerations, performance expectancy, and effort expectancy, and negatively influenced by social factors. As a result, the conjectures (U4), (U5), and (U6) are validated. Furthermore, social influence and facilitating conditions were a positively significant influence on behavioral intention to use e-government <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\beta = 0.125, t = 2.824, p = 0.005)$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\beta = 0.206, t= 3.811, p= 0.000)$</tex>, but social factors had a negative influence on behavioral intention <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\beta = -0.111, t= 2.213, p= 0.027)$</tex>. So, the hypotheses (U3), (U7), and (U8) are supported.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Sub-Optimal Control of SIR Infectious Disease Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered (SIR) disease model is a basic epidemiological framework for analyzing the spread of infectious diseases using various control theories. It plays a vital role in assessing disease control strategies and minimizing the impact of an infectious disease. This paper employs a nonlinear closed-loop infinite-horizon optimal tracking control via state-dependent Riccati equation (IH-SDRE) to the nonlinear SIR model with vaccination, aiming to reduce the number of infected individuals within a desired timeframe. This method, by transforming the nonlinear SIR model into a state-dependent coefficient form, solves the Riccati equation and the vector equation at every time step to determine the control law. The results obtained via MATLAB/Simulink demonstrate that the IH-SDRE minimizes the number of infected populations, reducing it to nearly zero within 30 days of the desired timeframe with an effective vaccination strategy. The findings show the effectiveness of the IH-SDRE as a robust method in the control and mitigation of infectious diseases.

articleTitle: Hybrid Feature Extraction and Deep Learning for Improved Melanoma Diagnosis from Skin Lesion Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The study emphasizes the need for improved melanoma diagnosis by overcoming the limitations of existing techniques. Conventional approaches, which focus on manual feature engineering or standalone deep learning, must precisely capture subtle melanoma patterns. The proposed hybrid System combines traditional image processing with advanced feature extraction and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to solve that. The methodology begins with extensive data preprocessing to ensure standardized input quality. Hybrid feature extraction combines edge recognition, texture analysis, and color histogram computing to capture a wide range of low and high-level features important for melanoma diagnosis. The CNN architecture is intended explicitly for melanoma classification, utilizing the power of convolutional layers for feature learning and fully linked layers for classification. The results show that the proposed System outperforms existing systems, with 99.1% accuracy, 98.3% precision, 96% recall, and 96.5% F1 Score in computational metrics. The System's performance is highlighted in comparison analysis, underlining its potential as an advanced diagnostic tool in dermatology, ultimately contributing to improved clinical results and patient care.

articleTitle: Home Automation Using Wi-Fi: ESP32-Based System for Remote Control and Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This project introduces a comprehensive home automation system leveraging Wi-Fi connectivity and ESP32 micro controllers, aimed at enhancing modern living through seamless automation and user-centric design. The background emphasizes the fusion of IoT technology with home automation, highlighting Wi-Fi's significance in enabling remote monitoring and control of household devices. Methodologically, the project integrates relay modules and DHT11 sensors, orchestrated through a user-friendly smartphone application. Results demonstrate successful implementation and testing, showcasing functionality, reliability, and user-friendliness. Real-time environmental monitoring and remote appliance control fulfill the objectives of enhancing home comfort, convenience, and energy efficiency. The conclusion underscores the project's contribution to advancing smart home technologies, offering users a scalable and customizable solution. Future research opportunities include enhancing system capabilities and addressing security and privacy concerns.

articleTitle: A Novel Chromatic Series Based Light Weight Cryptocipher with Cryptanalysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the realm of cybersecurity, the development of robust encryption algorithms is paramount to safeguard sensitive data against unauthorized access and malicious attacks. Financial institutions are actively seeking ways to safeguard sensitive financial information amidst the evolving digital landscape. By mitigating risks and enhancing their defences, they aim to uphold the trust and confidence of both customers and stakeholders. Unlike conventional encryption techniques that rely solely on numerical values, this system capitalizes on the rich diversity and complexity offered by color representations. The proposed color-based encryption system utilizes a randomly generated 10x10 chromatic key successfully encrypts plain text into complex cipher text. The vast key space offered by the chromatic representation significantly enhances the resistance against brute-force attacks. The introduction of color contributes to the diversification of encryption methodologies, offering a fresh perspective on data protection strategies. With its innovative approach and robust security features, it has the potential to address emerging security challenges and fortify the confidentiality of sensitive information in various domains.

articleTitle: Echo-Safe: A Lifeline For Emergency
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This project aims to develop a comprehensive human safety application harnessing smartphone and cloud technology for rapid assistance during emergencies. The application integrates modules for initial setup and user management, location tracking, voice-based SOS activation, and a police station database. Results demonstrate the application's ability to empower users by providing seamless onboarding, real-time location tracking, discreet voice-based SOS activation methods, and swift dispatch of alerts to nearby police stations. By leveraging these interconnected modules, the application revolutionizes emergency response mechanisms, offering users a reliable means of seeking assistance in critical situations. The seamless integration of smartphone technology, cloud services, and real-time communication sets a new standard for personal safety, ensuring efficient and reliable support in the digital age.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Deep CNN and VGG-16 for Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In video surveillance systems, anomaly detection is a crucial task for which deep learning models present potential answers. This study examines how well a custom deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) performs for anomaly identification in surveillance flicks in comparison to the widely used VGG-16 architecture. There are fourteen classes in the dataset, encompassing both typical activity and unusual oddities. Using common metrics like accuracy and loss, both models are trained and assessed. The custom CNN performs better than the VGG-16 (99.58 %) in terms of accuracy (99.92 %), suggesting that it is more successful in obtaining pertinent features for anomaly identification. Even while VGG-16 is well-known for its ability to classify images, in this particular anomaly detection scenario, its performance is inferior to that of the custom CNN. This conclusion emphasizes how crucial it is to customize model architectures for anomaly detection applications to match the specifics of the dataset and the task at hand in order to get the best possible performance.

articleTitle: An Approach for Optimal Preference of Providers Offering Cloud Services Using Decision Making involving Multiple Criteria
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Cloud computing provides on-demand delivery of various services over the Internet and used by many users now days. Numerous IT organization have engaged themselves in providing Cloud service and choosing the best CSP has become great challenge for users, which could be solved by incorporating ranking system. In ranking, multiple criteria should be analyzed for each CSP, thus it comes under MCDM problem where multiple criteria is analyzed for multiple providers to rank the CSPs accordingly. This paper incorporates two proposed MCDM techniques Aggregative and Accumulative Stacked Ordering Model(ASOM) and Absolute Aggregative Model for Stacked Divergence(AAMSD) and normalization technique Stacked Matrix Normalization(SMN). We have compared the proposed approach with the existing MCDM approaches Weighted Sum Model (WSM), Weighted Product Model (WPM) and Technique for Order of Preferences by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). The results clearly show that the proposed approach outperforms the existing approaches in-terms of computational complexity and consistency.

Author Keywords: Aggregative and Accumulative Stacked Ordering Model(ASOM)
Absolute Aggregative Model for Stacked Divergence(AAMSD)

articleTitle: Glaucoma Detection through Deep Learning: A Transfer Learning Techniques using CDR Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Elevated intraocular pressure is the hallmark of glaucoma, which can cause vision loss and optic nerve damage if initially undiagnosed due to mild symptoms. For vision impairment to be effectively managed and prevented, early detection is essential. Optical coherence tomography and fundus imaging are used in traditional diagnosis; thus, the optic cup-to-disk ratio is a crucial parameter that needs precise segmentation. This work uses the ensemble technique of ResNet101, MobileNet, and a refined VGGNet-19 model for subtle structural learning from RGB fundus images and spatial coordinates. The approach addresses challenges related to glaucoma categorization as well as optic cup/disk segmentation. Overall accuracy on the test set was 94%. VGG19 scored 0.92, 0.95, and 0.93 F1-score, while ResNet101 scored 0.93, 0.94, and 0.935, and MobileNet scored a competitive 0.915 F1-score. This work highlights the clinical potential and significance of reliable early screening for the management of this vision-threatening disorder by demonstrating how segmentation and deep learning approaches can be used to enable effective automated glaucoma diagnosis.

articleTitle: Predicting Stock Price Movements in Volatile Markets: A Multi-Model Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The dynamic financial markets where forecasting stock prices poses a persistent challenge, many recent researches in finance have focused on deep learning-based stock price prediction. Our model proposes an innovative Multi-Model Fusion Deep Learning approach that intricately integrates stock and news data to enhance predictive accuracy. Recognizing the intricate interplay of various variables in stock market dynamics, the method underscores the importance of considering market volatility for precise predictions. Capitalizing on the rapid assimilation of information into stock prices, a ground breaking fusion technique is introduced, seamlessly combining features extracted from both stock price data using a customized architecture inspired by LSTM and textual news data through a specialized NLP. The key to this approach lies in a sophisticated fusion layer, where distinct yet complementary features converge, enabling the model to synthesize a comprehensive understanding of market behavior. This hybrid architecture, finely tuned through joint training, demonstrates its effectiveness through comprehensive experimentation, assessing its performance in predicting stock price movements. The findings of our model are its higher accuracy which is 93.84%, 90.9% precision, 93.02% F1 score, 95.23% Recall and 0.006 Mean squared Error (MSE) which is lower in prediction of stock movements. By seamlessly blending insights from diverse data sources, this innovative approach charts a promising path toward refining stock price predictions in the volatile landscape of financial markets, offering potential improvements in forecasting accuracy and decision making.

articleTitle: An Extensive Examination of Methods for Detecting and Classifying Malignant and Benign Skin Cancers Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Skin cancer is a pressing health concern responsible for numerous fatalities in today's world, often diagnosed in its advanced stages, making treatment planning and patient survival challenging. Medical image interpretation, such as MRI as well as CT scans, is crucial for skin cancer diagnosis, but the manual analysis is costly, time-consuming, and can be influenced by biases. DL (Deep learning), a cutting-edge technology, is gaining attention as it allows for the automatic evaluation and interpretation of medical images, reducing the need for human intervention. Deep learning approaches have demonstrated remarkable outcomes in various domains by automatically extracting intrinsic image features, excluding the need for manual feature extraction. This review delves into the application of DL approaches in the diagnosis & detection of cancer, with a particular focus on skin cancer. Detecting melanoma from samples of dermoscopic skin is a formidable task, but employing a machine vision tool, like a deep learning approach, can address some of these challenges. The study introduces an automated melanoma classifier on the basis of DCNN (Deep Convolutional Neural Network) to accurately differentiate malignant from benign melanoma. It also outlines the various deep learning models and steps involved in utilizing these models for skin cancer detection. Recent advancements in the skin cancer detection Deep Learning (DL) methods are explored and summarized, shedding light on the critical challenges that have been faced in accurately detecting the cancer of skin in its early stages. For this research, dermoscopic images from the International Skin Imaging Collaboration datastores (ISIC 2016, ISIC 2017, and ISIC 2020), containing diverse cancer samples, were obtained and evaluated based on metrics like precision, accuracy, specificity, recall, and F1-score.

articleTitle: Virtual Interface to Identify Alzheimer's Disease Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Intending to revolutionize medical diagnosis, this paper attempts to harness the power of deep learning techniques to create a virtual interface to identify Alzheimer's disease. The major public health issue is Alzheimer's disease, a progressive neurological illness. Although it is still a challenging procedure, early identification is crucial to managing the course of the disease. To fulfill this challenge, this work is crucial. Early detection is essential to manage disease progression but remains a difficult task. A Kaggle dataset was used to design the virtual interface for Alzheimer's disease identification. The dataset consists of MRI scan images. This model is a multi-label classifier and uses four convolution layers with dropout layers to discriminate between Alzheimer's disease stages while preventing overfitting. This model is significant since it achieves an amazing validation accuracy of up to 97%. This level of accuracy highlights deep learning's potential as a tool to aid in the early detection of Alzheimer's.

articleTitle: Optimized Model Identification for Malware Detection in a File Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Malware remains one of the most critical digital threats today due to the rapidly evolving landscape of online activities. Detecting malware has become a pivotal aspect of safeguarding computer system, especially as polymeric malware arises by utilizing dynamic modifications to confound traditional signature-based detection methods. To combat the surging volume of malware, Machine Learning (ML) has emerged as a key strategy. Hence, ML-based detection mechanisms are imperative. This overview underscores the diverse array of machine learning-driven detection techniques. The primary objective is to construct an optimal machine learning representation for malware detection within files. Three distinct machine learning algorithms are employed: random forest, logistic regression, and a basic neural network. From these, the superior model is determined based on rigorous evaluation metrics-accuracy, f1 score, and both normalized and non-normalized confusion matrices on both training and testing data. The selection process hinges on achieving the highest accuracy and f1 score. The random forest algorithm was depicted to be having highest train accuracy with 98.28% and test accuracy with 98.38% and f1 score was found to be 97.3% which was chosen as a final model for malware detection in a file. The chosen model subsequently serves as the foundation for malware detection.

articleTitle: App Based Cardiovascular Disease Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Study investigates machine learning (ML) algorithms for early detection of cardiovascular diseases (CVDs), given their significant global impact. Utilizing demographic data, medical history, and lab results, algorithms like Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbors are examined. An ensemble model, incorporating Random Forest, is developed for improved accuracy, initially achieving 95%. Hyperparameter optimization boosts accuracy to 99%. An Android app interface facilitates easy access to the predictive model, empowering users for CVD risk assessment. These findings underscore ML’ s potential in early CVD detection, offering advancements in predictive healthcare. This contributes to addressing CVD burdens and improving public health outcomes.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Optimizing Translation Systems Supported by ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, the large models represented by ChatGPT have brought opportunities and challenges to the teaching of translation courses. The correct application of these tools can enhance learning effectiveness and cultivate student abilities, achieving “human-machine cooperation”. It can be said that the rise of Chat GPT large-scale language models has led artificial intelligence to a new stage of development, bringing tremendous changes to the field of language teaching. This article focuses on the current situation of modern English education and the specific application strategies of using artificial intelligence technology in optimizing translation systems supported by ChatGPT, proposing exploration suggestions for ChatGPT in the field of translation teaching, which has a certain practical reference significance for the improvement of English teaching theory under the background of the continuous enhancement in the field of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Pediatric oral health detection using Swin transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Oral health exams in children are important for a variety of reasons, including their impact on a child's overall well-being and development. Traditional dental health detection methods still need to be improved, particularly in actual diag-nostic environments. Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to have a substantial impact on pediatric dentistry by providing innovative solutions to numerous difficulties in children's oral healthcare. By analyzing X-rays or intra-oral scans, AI can aid in the early detection of disorders like tooth decay, and developmental anomalies, when correction is most successful. AI can provide additional insight by analyzing X-rays and data, allowing dentists to make more accurate treatment plan decisions. Transformer is an instance of a deep neural network that was first employed for natural language processing. Its main foundation is the self-attention mechanism. In this study, we assess the swin transformer model's effectiveness in pediatric oral health detection. The data classes were enhanced as a pre-processing step using the fuzzy color approach, and the images that were structured with original X-rays were stacked. The proposed system achieved an accuracy of 85.34 percent. The result obtained implies that swin transformer has prospects in medical imaging and pre-training may be a useful strategy for enhancing its model's accuracy on oral health detection tasks.

articleTitle: Ultrasound-Guided Deep Learning for Regional Nerve Block Anesthesia in Scapular Fracture
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This study introduces a novel approach to regional nerve block anesthesia in scapular fractures by integrating ultrasound guidance with deep learning techniques. The proposed method leverages advanced imaging modalities and state-of-the-art deep learning models to achieve precise nerve localization amidst complex fracture patterns. Through extensive experimentation and evaluation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in enhancing surgical planning, intraoperative decision-making, and patient safety. This study represents a significant advancement in the field of orthopedic surgery, offering a promising solution for improving outcomes and quality of life for patients with scapular fractures. The method this study suggests for locating nerves in shoulder fractures advances orthopaedic surgery. We can improve, expedite, and streamline procedures with the use of AI and medical imaging. This will improve the quality of life and outcomes for scapular fractures.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology in Data Prediction Models Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: How to solve the problems faced by traditional statistical models such as large scale, variability and high complexity of data? In this regard, this article proposes a GAN algorithm. The article first defines the data prediction problem, defines the problem goal of this article as the prediction of stock prices, and then applies the adversarial generation network to the stock price prediction problem. Research has found that GAN can generate multiple possible stock price sequences, thereby providing multiple possibilities for future trends. Afterwards, the article establishes a prediction model based on big data, and completes the experimental test of the algorithm of this article through the model. The test results show that the data results of this model in the accuracy test are between 89% and 98%. By making full use of large-scale data samples and distributed computing capabilities, the model can better capture the complex associations and patterns in the data.

articleTitle: Establishment of a Combined Sales Prediction Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Enterprise needs more accurate sales data to make plan for the future as the global economy is falling into a slow growth period because of the blocked logistics caused by worldwide spreading covid-19, but traditional single prediction model such as triple order exponential smoothing prediction model, Grey prediction model and LSTM prediction model is difficult to get accurate prediction output due to their limitation. This paper proposes a BP neural network combined prediction model based on multiple models, which can get accurate output by inputting results of mentioned models above. It has applied to medical sales industry and is recognized for meeting the desired goals.

Author Keywords: triple order exponential smoothing prediction model
BP neural network combined prediction model based on multiple models

articleTitle: Algorithm for Automatic Abstract Generation of Russian Text Under ChatGpt System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In response to the problems of insufficient understanding of language characteristics, inaccurate semantic understanding, and inaccurate automatic summarization generation of Russian texts in current automatic summarization generation algorithms, this article would use the chatGpt system to study the algorithm for automatic summarization generation of Russian texts. The automatic summarization algorithm for Russian texts based on the ChatGPT system can effectively generate summaries for Russian texts. This algorithm utilizes ChatGPT's powerful natural language processing capabilities to deeply understand and analyze Russian texts, thereby generating concise and accurate summaries. The algorithm based on the ChatGPT system has an accuracy of over 97.64% in generating Russian text summaries, and the average accuracy of Russian text summarization generation in 10 experiments is 98.23%. This provides an effective solution for automatic summarization generation of Russian texts, and the effectiveness and reliability of the algorithm are verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Improving LoRa Low-Power Wide-Area Networks with Double Deep-Q Learning-Based Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has the potential to revolutionize the way we work by incorporating essential end devices (ED) into connected all smart devices. Low-power wide-area networks (LPWANs) determine the maximum number of end devices (EDs) supported by the network and distribute data through these EDs. However, the delay and action of space are inefficient. However, implementing and training a Double Deep Q Learning (DDQL) network can be computationally intensive and involve a significant amount of data transmission, posing a risk to network security. While DDQL can optimize resource allocation based on the network, the proposed technique is essential for significantly improving actions and reducing the risk of transmitted data in LoRaWAN. It supports EDs while ensuring lower power consumption, thereby increasing network capacity. Although the proposed DDQL technique exhibits high performance compared to existing methods such as Hybrid Adaptive Data Rate (HADR), Low-Power Multi-Armed Bandit (LP-MAB) and non-destructive adaptive data rate (ND-ADR, it achieves outstanding results. The outcomes include an Energy Consumption of 0.02J, Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) of 0.56 and a Packet Loss Ratio (PLR) of 0.72, surpassing existing methods in the context of IoT.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Analysis Method for E-Commerce Data Based on Improved Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: It is frequently difficult to handle large-scale, high-dimensional data using traditional e-commerce data analysis methodologies, which makes it challenging to effectively capture user behavior and market trends. The capacity to precisely evaluate e-commerce data can be enhanced by the use of improved Bayesian algorithms, enabling more precise predictions of user behavior and market trends. This article gathers a lot of e-commerce data from e-commerce websites using web crawler technology, preprocesses it, and verifies its validity. It integrates normal distributions and dynamic modeling techniques based on Bayesian networks, and it uses a graph model to express the relationships between items like users, products, and transactions. The dataset was divided using 5-fold cross validation, and the experimental findings demonstrated that the enhanced Bayesian algorithm had an average accuracy of 97.9% for predicting user behavior. The enhanced Bayesian algorithm's average user shopping cart conversion rate is 83.2%. The analytical performance of e-commerce data can be efficiently enhanced through the use of enhanced Bayesian algorithms.

articleTitle: Solar Brilliance: Revolutionizing Electric Mobility with the Quasi-Quadratic Converter for Optimal Charging Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This article presents an innovative quasi-quadratic high gain coupled-inductor DC/DC converter (QQHGCI) designed to efficiently charge electric vehicle batteries using solar photovoltaic energy. The converter achieves a notable high voltage conversion ratio while minimizing stress on semiconductor components. Employing a coupled inductors and dual triggering switches with instantaneous operations, the QQHGCI reduces switching losses through pseudo-resonance operation and regenerative clamp capacitors. This design significantly diminishes magnetic and semiconductor losses, making it particularly suitable for electric vehicle applications. The article provides a thorough examination of the converter's operation, steady state, and performance in continuous conduction mode, accompanied by MATLAB simulation results showcasing an impressive 97.8% efficiency with a mere 6 watts of loss for a 250 Watts design.

articleTitle: Reconstruction and Update of 3D Model of Mechanical Products Based on 3D Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the help of high-resolution images, 3D model reconstruction can obtain and extract the original feature information of the object, thereby achieving accurate measurement of product geometric dimensions, materials and other parameters. This technology has broad application prospects in the field of mechanical processing. This article first analyzes the current research status of 3D micro-measurement technology and three-dimensional surface reconstruction methods at home and abroad. Subsequently, this article uses three-dimensional point cloud data for modeling, and performs real-time shooting and data processing of parts. Afterwards, this article uses cloud data processing technology to extract the mechanical products in the sample, and obtains the dimensional parameters of the mechanical products through image fusion. Finally, this article conducts a performance test on the reconstructed three-dimensional model of the mechanical product. The test results show that after optimization, the dynamic response time of the model is reduced from 8-12s to 3-5s. This shows that the model can quickly respond to machine data and achieve high-efficiency operation; after optimization, the durability basically reaches more than 79%. The results of this study can show that the reconstruction effect of this model has been significantly improved, but it still needs improvement.

articleTitle: Prediction of Soil Organic Carbon Content Using Machine Learning Based Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)

The PCA method is solely utilized for the clustering process. articleTitle: Teaching Management Systems in Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) technology is an environment of computer-generated simulation that enables users to interact with artificial 3-dimensional or other environments. It increases the system of teaching management by engaging them in realistic simulations of managerial situations. However, VR technology's adoption rates for teaching cannot be described in higher education institutions. Therefore, the teaching management system in VR laboratory technology is analyzed in higher education institutions. An analysis is established on the design, teaching adaptation rates, and experience of students over 5 teaching periods. In this period, 4934 students are trained in a lab across 8024 student visits. The lab is utilized by 55% of Engineering faculty 55%, 24.9% of Arts & social science faculty, and 25% of science faculty. The study units for Engineering employ the lab indicated by 1.45% of annual subject faculty offered. It confirms that adoption is in the first stage of innovation diffusion. The lab has a 260% enhancement in student numbers in the analysis period and 71.6% of students reported improved learning results.

articleTitle: Visualizing Parts of Speech Tags by Analysing English Language Text
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Part of Speech (POS) tagging is vital in natural language processing (NLP) for various applications. Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) have traditionally been used for this task, yet they struggle with capturing complex dependencies. This study explores Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) and their integration with Spacy for POS tagging. CRFs offer better sequence modelling capabilities, while Spacy provides rich linguistic features. Experimental evaluation demonstrates superiority of CRFs and CRF with Spacy over HMMs. They exhibit improved accuracy, particularly in capturing context and handling ambiguous sequence. The findings underscore the efficiency of advanced techniques like CRFs and their integration with comprehensive NLP libraries like Spacy for accurate POS tagging. Such methods are crucial for advancing NLP applications.

articleTitle: Exploring Multiple Algorithms for Lossless Electrocardiogram Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As a solution to the problem of large amounts of ECG data in resource-constrained settings, this paper discusses effective lossless compression techniques. Through the integration of algorithmic optimizations and predictive coding approaches, it has achieved significant reductions in signal size without sacrificing critical information. Huffman Encoding is the most effective technique among the various techniques examined. It yields compression ratios between 0.26 and 0.45 and Quality Scores between 0.037 and 0.081. These outcomes demonstrate how well our method works to preserve signal integrity while drastically lowering transmission and storage costs. This paper tries to significantly improve healthcare outcomes by tackling these issues, especially in situations when resource optimization is essential.

articleTitle: Physics Informed Neural Network Based Deep Adaptive Sampling Technique for Partial Differential Equations Solving
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent times, the Deep Neural Network (DNN) has attained high attention to solve the engineering issue. In this research, proposed a Physics Informed Neural Network (PINNs) based Deep Adaptive Sampling (DAS) technique is proposed to solve the Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). The DNN is used for approximate solution of PDEs and deep generative methods are used for generation of gathering points for refining training set. Process of DAS method has two phases such as PDEs solving through reducing residual loss in gathering points in training set and producing training set for enhancing an accuracy of present approximation solution. The performance of proposed technique is evaluated in terms of linear and non-linear problems with training time and error. The methods used fsor comparing the proposed technique are Residual-based Adaptive Refinement (RAR) technique for huge dimension issues, DSA-R, DAS-G and uniform sampling technique. The proposed DAS technique showed effective performance in training time and minimization of error than uniform sampling techniques.

Author Keywords: Physics Informed Neural Network and are Residual-based Adaptive Refinement

articleTitle: Developing a Computational Tool for Lung Cancer Prediction with Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Machine learning is commonly used to automate disease classification by extracting features from segmented objects, but automated segmentation can be difficult. Model proposed uses average values to compute features based on the whole image, eliminating the need to perform additional steps. Results obtained by the algorithm were encouraging, but implementing it requires considerable computational expertise. Lung cancer detection is a very important field of medical processing. We have included two processes named feature extraction and feature selection processes and evaluated and compared the performance of feature extraction and feature extracting and selection processes. In addition, some benchmark sets can be used to compare the performance of the proposed work model. PCA, ICA, and SURF were used to develop the friendly disease prediction model. The feature selection process is applied after the feature extraction process to select the relative features and will compare with the feature extraction criteria. The feature selection is done using the HPSO-CSO Algorithm. The proposed method in which the work has been done using canny edge operator and feature selection has shown good result values in comparison to feature extraction. The proposed techniques aim to minimise classification errors and maximise accuracy. From the results, it has been concluded that accuracy was achieved at 97.94%.

articleTitle: Transductive – Long Short-Term Memory Network for the Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Recently, fake news and rumors are distributing majorly and rapidly in all over world. That circumstance causes the production and propagation of incorrect news articles. As well as mis data and fake news are maximized through user without correct verification. In this manuscript, proposed a Transductive - Long Short-Term Memory (T-LSTM) method for detecting fake news. The Buzzfeed and ISOT datasets are used in this manuscript for fake news detection and it is pre-processed by tokenization, removal of stop word and stemming. Then, the reduction of feature is performed by using Probability Principal Component Analysis (PPCA) and it is classified by using T-LSTM method. The proposed T-LSTM method attained accuracy 96.51 %, precision 94.64 %, recall 92.33 % and f1-score 93.57% on Buzzfeed dataset. The proposed T-LSTM method attained accuracy 98.43%, precision 97.76%, recall 97.02% and f1-score 97.35% on ISOT dataset. The proposed T-LSTM method performed well than other existing methods like LSTM -Levy Flight (LSTM-LF) and OptNet.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of AMBA-APB Protocol for System-on-Chip (SoC) Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The demand for compact and efficient communication interfaces within integrated circuits has increased with the integration of high-performance and low-power components in System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. This study addresses this challenge by focusing on the design and implementation of an AMBA-APB protocol bridge. Leveraging inventive techniques to optimize resource utilization and enhance data transfer efficiency between master and slave components, the successful implementation and validation of the novel bridge demonstrate its potential to improve SoC performance across diverse application domains. By seamlessly connecting high-performance and low-power components, the bridge facilitates efficient data exchange, thus addressing the growing demand for compact and efficient communication interfaces within integrated circuits. The developed AMBA-APB protocol bridge offers a promising solution to the challenges associated with integrating disparate components in SoC designs, contributing to enhanced overall performance and scalability, and positioning it as a valuable addition to SoC development methodologies.

articleTitle: Motion Process Electrocardiogram Detection Algorithm under Self Supervised Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Electrocardiogram is a non-invasive detection technology that detects, predicts, and monitors cardiovascular diseases by reflecting the relationship between the electrical activity of the heart system and time. It does not cause any harm to patients and has a simple detection method and reliable diagnostic results. It plays an important role in the analysis and diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases. The electrocardiogram can automatically record the biological signals generated by myocardial contraction during the activity of the heart system, which is also known as the electrocardiogram signal. This article explores the motion process electrocardiogram detection algorithm based on convolutional neural networks algorithm based on the above issues. It has been experimentally proven that the detection rate of electrocardiogram detection during motion based on CNN algorithm is higher than 87%, with an average detection rate of 93.46%. The false alarm rate of electrocardiogram detection is less than 1%, with an average false alarm rate of 0.54%.

articleTitle: Building Extraction Algorithm for Informatized Remote Sensing Images Based on Group Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This paper enhances the accuracy of building extraction by integrating the refined Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method with remote sensing image (RSI) processing, particularly in intricate scenarios and surroundings undergoing substantial alterations. By adding an adaptive parameter adjustment mechanism and a local search strategy to carry out a more thorough search for the global optimal solution, this research enhances the PSO method. It preprocesses the RSIs to guarantee their quality and uses Landsat data as the remote sensing dataset. The experimental results show that the improved PSO achieves an average accuracy of 97.2% in extracting buildings from RSIs. By improving PSO and combining it with RSIs, the effectiveness of building extraction can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: Anomaly-Based Intrusion Detection System Using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The developing use of Internet of Things (IoT) applications in several aspects created a large number of data which is need the occurrence of existing techniques like fog and cloud computing. The Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is recognized several cybersecurity problems and its resources. In this paper, the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) is proposed for anomaly-based IDS in IoT network. The BoT-IoT and ToN-IoT datasets are used for identifying IDS in IoT networks. The normalization is used as preprocessing and Gain Ratio is used for selecting optimal features and the BiLSTM is used for classification of IDS in network which enables the model to scale large dataset and enhance the accuracy. The performance of BiLSTM is estimated by accuracy, f1 score, recall and precision. The BiLSTM achieves better accuracy of 98.76% and 96.84% for BoT-IoT and ToN-IoT dataset respectively which is better when compared to existing techniques like Group Theory Binary Spring Search-Hybrid Deep Neural Network (GTBSS-HDNN) and DNN.

articleTitle: Detection of Black Hole Attacks in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Using Optimization-Based Routing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Mobile Ad hoc NETworks (MANETs) are a new type of wireless communications that are operating in a highly dynamic and unpredictable environment. However, security is a major issue in routing, because of moving nodes, mainly because it suffers from a black hole attack. This research focuses on the detection of Black Hole attacks using advanced optimization algorithms, namely Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). This survey aims to enhance the performance of MANETs by effectively identifying and mitigating the impact of malicious nodes. In the suggested approach, the GWO algorithm optimizes the routing paths, improving throughput and packet delivery ratio while reducing end-to-end delay. The ACO utilized a structured mechanism for routing decisions, utilizing pheromone updates and heuristic values to enhance the efficiency of Black Hole attack detection. The GA framework integrates Crossover and Mutation operators, offering a more structured generation of nodes and improving adaptability to dynamic network conditions. Additionally, the PSO algorithm introduces a multidimensional approach, incorporating diversity optimization and energy-aware routing for Black Hole detection. Hence, the suggested technique enhances the packet transmission in MANET and secures the routing layer effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Model of Portfolio Risk Measurement Based on Likelihood Ratio
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In this paper, a real-time monitoring method of portfolio risk measurement based on likelihood ratio is proposed through the research paradigm of intelligent simulation analysis. The value of simulation data is mined with the idea of green simulation, and a theoretical model is built to realize a real-time monitoring method of portfolio risk measurement with a fixed length of time, that is, the portfolio risk measurement can always be obtained after a certain period of time when the market state is given at the current moment. Using large loss probability as a measure of investment risk, the simulation path and the corresponding portfolio loss of each path are obtained according to nested Monte Carlo simulation and likelihood ratio method, and the logistic regression equation is established to calculate the equation coefficient using the maximum likelihood estimation method. The convergence and convergence rate of logistic regression model are proved. When the sample path of the inner and outer layers tends to infinity at the same time, the estimated coefficient of logistic regression equation will converge to the true value, and the convergence rate of the outer layer path is the square times of the inner layer. Numerical experiments are carried out on the theoretical model, and the experimental results show that the model has a good effect on the whole, and can effectively predict the risk of the investment portfolio in the initial period of time. Further, this paper uses the method of updating parameters to rebuild the simulation model to solve the problem that the effect of the model becomes worse and worse with the increase of time. In addition, the robustness of the proposed method is proved by multiple test sets and sensitivity estimation. Finally, empirical research was carried out using actual data to collect the option data of Yahoo Finance to build a portfolio, and the corresponding stock data of each option was monitored. The experimental results showed that even if the underlying assets changed slightly, the risk of the portfolio still changed greatly. Therefore, this method can guide managers to monitor portfolio risks in real time, which is of great significance for actual financial risk management.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Optimization of Machine Learning Algorithms in Personalized Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the development of society and the continuous updating of economic models, the importance of marketing for business operations is becoming increasingly high. However, due to the traditional marketing model adopting a popular strategy, personalized recommendations are insufficient. In recent years, machine learning algorithms have been widely applied and developed rapidly in various industries. Therefore, this article studied the effectiveness evaluation and optimization of machine learning algorithms in personalized marketing, and discussed the business recommendation marketing of banks as the research point. The study was conducted using the dataset provided by the Kaggle data competition website. Firstly, customer information was analyzed and divided into 12 explanatory variables and 1 response variable. Next, the Apache Nifi tool was used to collect information, ensuring the security of customer information. Then, the Informatica Data Quality tool was used to clean the information data and organize it into features that can be utilized by the algorithm. The chi square test was used to test the correlation of features, determine the value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> as 0.05, and select the appropriate feature component to input into the model. Finally, the GBDT (Gradient Boosting Decision Trees) algorithm was used to analyze features, determine the actual needs of customers, and provide personalized recommendations to customers. The research results showed that the model had a 94% precision in judging the personal wishes of customers, and had strong anti-interference ability and good robustness. This study can accurately infer customers' intentions based on customer information, providing a new approach for exploring personalized marketing.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Detection and Classification Using Feature Extraction Based Self-Attention Convolutional Neural Network with Time Series Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The transmission lines continuously experience the number of shunt faults and its effective in practical system increases the instability, load damages and line restoration cost. This work implements an advanced self-attention convolutional neural network (SAT-CNN) method for fault detection and classification (FDC) of high voltage transmission lines experiencing a constant number of shunt faults. Faults cause load damage in real-time applications, increase instability, and increase the cost of line restoration. Therefore, a precise model is needs to identify and categorize the flaws to quickly restore he problematic phases. In this research, implemented SAT-CNN feature extraction model with imaging-based on time series that can accurately detect and classify faults. By employing a number of input signals, including, current, voltage, and combined current and voltage signals, at different sampling frequencies, the efficacy of implemented SAT-CNN model is evaluated. Implemented SAT-CNN method obtains high performance when compared to existing methods including weight-sharing network (WSCN), Truncated singular value decomposition and Human urbanization algorithm based Recurrent Perceptron Neural Network (TSVD-HUARPNN), and Graph convolutional neural network (GCN), and result achieved 99.90% accuracy value.

articleTitle: Immersive Dramatic Space 3D Layout Using Panoramic Image Reconstruction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The relevance of 3D techniques in a wide range of applications, such as augmented Reality (AR), architecture, and other commercial fields, has made rapid 3D reconstruction of the environment an important research issue. In this research, speeded up robust features (SURF) a unique technology that can generate an estimated 3D model of the environment on a mobile smartphone in a matter of seconds. Large field-of-view images necessary for dependable and strong reconstruction are generated from a set of panoramic images captured by a very quick and adaptable algorithm. Dense, polygonal, textured representations are obtained by using a low-cost online space carving technique depend on Delaunay triangulation. Through the experimental result, this implemented method is compared with existing method of Panorama luminance attentive network (panoLANet) method. This implemented method's outcomes achieved better values of 30.50 of Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), 0.955 of structural similarity index measure (SSIM), 44.71 of Vendor Development Program (VDP), and 1.10 of Mean Squared Error (MSE).

articleTitle: Feature Selection and Classification of Email Spam Using Orthogonal Linear Jellyfish Swarm Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Spam emails are the cyber annoyances which causes the significant security attacks involves both financial as well as personal data. Detecting the new strains of the spam messages is challenging and it needs the efficient and reliable intelligent spam detection approach. This research proposes the Orthogonal Linear Design based Jellyfish Swarm Optimizer (OLJSO)-based feature selection approach for the email spam. Initially, UCI ML Repository dataset is collected and it is pre-processed by using tokenization, stop word removal, stemming and lemmatization. After pre-processing, the feature extraction is done by using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and the extracted features are selected by the utilization of OLJSO. After the feature selection process, the selected spam features are classified into two types such as spam and non-spam by the utilization of Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The effectiveness of the OLJSO is estimated by using various performance metrices and it achieves the accuracy of 99.09% and precision of 0.975 when compared to the existing methods such as Genetic Decision Tree Processing with Natural Language Processing (GDTPNLP).

Author Keywords: orthogonal linear design based jellyfish swarm optimizer

articleTitle: Abstraction of Design Information from Legacy C++ Program
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: During the last three decades, the importance of the application software is tremendously increased. Every organization has automated all their day-to-day activities. For automation purpose they used the procedural or object-oriented programming languages. During the 1990‘s to 2010 many organizations used C++ programming language for the development of application software. Today because of the changes in Hardware and Software technology the C++ programming is not much widely used. But these applications require trained experts to maintain the system otherwise it becomes legacy system. These Legacy systems are at the heart of many outstanding companies.
