Although they are still essential to the general operation of the business, their solutions are out-of-date and, in certain circumstances, no longer even supported by the original software developer or vendor. Abstracting any reusable components from these systems is difficult. These systems can be modernized as to stay competitive by adding current sustainable features. In this paper, a methodology is proposed to abstract the design information which is a reusable component from the given input legacy C++ program in form of Control Flow and Data Flow Tables.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Diagnosis Using Deep Boltzmann Machine and Multiclass Relevance Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Transformers are crucial to electric power systems, yet it can be challenging to accurately diagnose their problems. The research presents a novel method for transformer defect diagnostics that combines ensemble machine learning (EML) with an Internet of Things (IoT) based monitoring model. First, the data measurement subsystem measures the transformer vibration signals, and data reception transmits those signals to remote server. At that time, an EML made up of Multiclass Relevance Vector Machines (MRVMs) and Deep Boltzmann Machines (DBM) functions are suggested. A unique combination strategy and conventional monitoring techniques like vibro-acoustic frequency and short-circuit impedance are used to guarantee the EML's efficiency. The suggested EML readily addresses the insufficient feature extraction information from separate deep learning methods, and the multiclass RVM classification technique clearly outperforms other widely used classifiers. The less power, long-distance watching, and high reliable utilization based on IoT is advantageous for long-term collection and transmission of signals. The study of the results makes it evident that the suggested DBM-MRVM outperformed other models, achieving a greater accuracy of 99.38%.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Based Decision-Making of Energy Management for Regional Energy Systems with Renewable Generation and Installed Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The electricity system with penetration of a massive number of renewable generation sources needs to consider various demands, such as power generation efficiency, the service life of energy storage devices, and its impact on the main grid. Therefore, the control of various distributed units in microgrids is a comprehensive multi-objective problem. Taking into account the natural indirectness of new energy, the randomness of predicted loads, and the time-varying nature of electricity prices, this paper proposes an optimized fuzzy control (OFC) system to achieve power flow optimization of microgrids and maximize comprehensive benefits. Simulation experiments show that the proposed optimized fuzzy control strategy can better achieve microgrid power flow control and meet the requirements of multi-objective optimization.

articleTitle: Realization of High-Speed Integrated PON-VLC System Employing FBG Sensors for IoT-eHealth
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid increase in demand for higher data traffic exponentially enhances the growth of optical networks offering seamless coverage, energy efficiency as well as cost effectiveness. In this work, passive optical network (PON) is integrated visible light communication (VLC) using fiber Bragg grading (FBG) sensors. FBG basics sensors are used to monitoring the health conditions of patients in hospitals, clinics, laboratories and smart homes. The results show that the proposed system utilizing FBG offers faithful 50km fiber and 9m VLC distance at 10/10Gbps per channel transmission rate. In addition, patient's current healthcare condition in terms of blood pressure and temperature can be monitored using FBG sensors with satisfactory performance at 625nm wavelength and 250C temperature. In addition, from the performance comparison of an integrated PON-VLC, system it is realized that w.r.t. other systems, the better performance of former than existing ones is obtained with longer transmission range and throughput.

articleTitle: Cancer Cell Detection Biosensor Utilizing Dual-Core PCF-Based Surface Plasmon Resonance
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Early detection of cancer cells, crucial for improving patient outcomes, is facilitated through internal and external sensing techniques, leveraging photonics technology for precise and reliable detection. These methods offer remarkable sensitivity, selectivity and durability, enhancing the effectiveness of treatment approaches in healthcare. Utilizing a dual-core photonic crystal fiber (PCF) and exploiting the surface plasmon resonance (SPR) effect, the sensor boasts the potential to detect diverse cancer types, including Jurkat, Basal and Hela. Simulated using the Finite Element Method, the sensor leverages gold, coated with protective titanium dioxide, to detect variations in the surrounding medium's refractive index, operating effectively between 1.360 and 1.392. Remarkably, it exhibits the maximum reported sensitivity for wavelength of 10714.29 nm/RIU, showcases a linear sensing response, solidifying its real-world applicability across various cancers. This holistic approach represents a significant advancement in cancer detection technology, holding immense promise for enhanced diagnosis and treatment outcomes. This innovative study unveils a novel optical sensor designed to locate cancerous cells present in the human body.

articleTitle: Classification of Multi-Class Skin Cancer using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, skin cancer is a frequent and dangerous disease that requires rapid and accurate analysis to secure effective treatment. Accurate detection and diagnosis of skin lesions is challenging due to the similarities between various skin lesions such as nevi and melanoma, especially when analyzing color images of the skin. In this survey, various deep learning (DL) techniques are analyzed for multi-class skin cancer classification. This survey discussed the significant assumptions, limitations, and advantages analyzed in existing DL approaches. DL-based techniques such as feature extraction, segmentation, and classification are used for multi-class skin cancer classification. The performance of the existing methods was analyzed using various performance metrics such as Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), recall, precision, fl-score, dice, precision, sensitivity, Jaccard, and time. This survey concludes that multivariate skin cancer classification over DL overcomes the drawbacks of poor data quality reduces time complexity and improves efficiency.

articleTitle: The Module Composition of New Artificial Intelligence System Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The upgrade and iteration of the artificial intelligence system has been enough to support it to cope with various complex tasks, such as intelligent analysis and intelligent tracking of images, which all require visual modules within the artificial intelligence system, and this article uses a method based on visual communication to build the visual module in the new artificial intelligence system to meet these work needs. Moreover, this article also verified the effectiveness of this method through comparative experiments to evaluate recognition efficiency and recognition accuracy. In a comparative experiment to evaluate recognition efficiency, the average recognition efficiency of the experimental group based on the method in this article was 97.55%, while the average recognition efficiency of the control group with only conventional artificial intelligence systems was 90.78%. The larger experimental results fully demonstrate that the method in this paper can indeed build the visual module of artificial intelligence very well.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Fog Nodes Involves in Dynamic Resource Allocation Method Utilizing the Bat Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Efficient load balancing in fog nodes is essential for optimal resource utilization in fog computing environments. Despite advancements, existing methods lack efficiency, prompting the introduction of an optimization-based dynamic allocation approach in this paper. This paper introduces an approach, Task Classification and Buffering (TCB), designed for effective task management by categorizing tasks and optimizing buffer utilization. Simultaneously, Task Offloading and Optimal Resources Allocation (TOORA), empowered by the Bat Optimization Algorithm (BOA), ensures optimal resource allocation for offloaded tasks, thereby boosting overall system performance. The proposed methodology is evaluated using performance metrics, including Energy Consumption (6.00 W), Cost ($14.53), Make-span (0.32 ms), and Latency(1000s), demonstrating its efficacy. Comparative analysis with existing methods like Dynamic Energy Efficient Resource Allocation (DEER), accelerated Particle Swarm Optimization (APSO) algorithm, and Cat Swarm Optimization (CSO) with Support Vector Machines (SVM) underscores the proposed TCB and TOORA approach in achieving optimal load balancing in fog computing environments.

articleTitle: Classification Algorithm for Motor Imagery EEG Signals Based on Multi-Domain Information CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low recognition rate of single feature and poor adaptability of motor imagination EEG signals, a multi-input time-frequency-spatial hybrid convolution neural network algorithm is proposed in this paper. Classify and identify the motor imagery EEG signals. Firstly, the time domain signal matrix is obtained by pre-processing and data amplification of EEG signals, and then the time-frequency transform and spatial filtering of EEG signals are carried out by continuous wavelet transform and common space mode, respectively, and the time-frequency matrix and space-time matrix are obtained. finally, three types of characteristic matrices are input into the parallel hybrid convolution neural network training model, and the final classification results are obtained. The proposed method is verified by using the 2008 BCI competition Datasets2a data set, and the average classification accuracy is 94.81%. The results show that this method can effectively enhance the recognition rate of motor imagination, offering a novel idea and approach for the research on brain-computer interfaces related to motor imagination.

articleTitle: Data-driven and Fault Prediction Methods for Power Metering Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of technology, the level of informatization of power systems based on cloud computing has also been continuously improving. More and more data has been accumulated in various power grid systems, forming power big data. In previous smart grids, grid load forecasting was a crucial step, and the design of its prediction algorithm was also a crucial issue. The accuracy of power grid load forecasting results not only affects the normal operation of the entire smart grid, but also affects the macroeconomic regulation of the power grid. Therefore, analyzing and mining big data on electricity plays an important role in the construction of smart grids and the efficient, safe, and stable operation of the power grid. Abnormal detection and prediction of power load is an important research topic in power big data mining. This article studies the method of detecting and predicting abnormal power loads and implements it in a cloud computing environment. After optimization, the average error of neural network prediction is basically controlled within 3%, which is sufficient to meet the requirements of power system prediction and create higher benefits for society. It has certain practical value.

articleTitle: A Study of Innovation and Expression of Data Visualization Techniques in Art and Design
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the advent of the information age, it is a key in many technical fields such as computer technology, multimedia technology, software technology, intelligent technology, etc. It is the technical foundation of the information society, so its development and application are very rapid, especially to the visual communication design industry has brought a great impact. The rapid development of digital technology, especially its wide application in visual communication design, makes the visual communication design under digital technology have rich and varied means and diverse styles, and shows a strong visual impact in the dissemination of visual information, which fully demonstrates the potential of the application and development of digital technology in visual communication design. This paper discusses the innovation and expression of data visualization technology in art design. Firstly, it introduces the concepts of digital technology and visual communication art, and then unfolds the narrative of the innovation of art form. The article proves through a questionnaire that the reason for 40% of the audience's preference for digital artwork is the dynamic view of digital artwork.

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Product Recommendation Algorithms Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In response to the poor performance of traditional e-commerce systems in image recognition and product recommendation, this paper uses deep learning as the basis and convolutional neural network algorithms to study the image recognition and product recommendation algorithms in e-commerce systems. Firstly, the basic knowledge and citation principles of convolutional neural network algorithms were introduced. Then a detailed description of the model construction process based on convolutional neural networks was provided, and the model was trained. Finally, through experimental comparison, the performance of the model designed in this article was explored. The experimental results showed that the accuracy and recall of the model in image recognition in e-commerce systems are between 95.2%-96.5% and 91%-85%, respectively. At the same time, users show a very satisfactory attitude towards product recomme <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> d\\\\\\\\datio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> results. Therefore, the model designed in this article has the effect of improving the performance of image recognition and product recommendation algorithms.

Author Keywords: image recognition and product recommendation algorithms

articleTitle: Feature Extraction to Evaluate the Quality of Data Using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Data quality analysis is a crucial step in ensuring the reliability and accuracy of data used in machine learning models. The proposed approach utilized with machine learning algorithms to identify outliers in the data. Outliers can indicate errors are anomalies that might affect the quality of the dataset. Data Profiling is used to identify patterns and distributions. Missing Data Imputation predict the missing values. Data Validation and Cleansing, Data Duplication Detection, Inconsistency Detection are considered as the primary analysis to be done. The feature extraction process read the sample test dataset, pre-process the dataset by cleaning the data for data duplication, inconsistency through dynamic algorithms principal component analysis (PCA), Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) and independent component analysis (ICA) is considered here. The proposed feature extraction data is further opted for pattern validation through isolated forest algorithm. The performance of the system is evaluated using accuracy, precision, and Recall. The LDA model outperforms with accuracy of 99% for the given testset.

articleTitle: Innovative Framework for Precise Peripheral Arterial Disease Diagnostics Through Multi-Modal Digital Signal Processing on Xilinx FPGA Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The mortality rate due to the Arterial disease is increasing every day. Because of this need for the accurate and early detection of the Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) increases day to day to avoid the consequences due to the health issues. This is addressed in this research work by a introducing an innovative framework centered on multi-modal Digital Signal Processing (DSP) filtering. Specifically targeting Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals, our methodology intricately weaves together various DSP filters, such as low-pass, high-pass, and adaptive filters. Integrating AI with the medical signal processing paves the way for accurate detection of PAD in its early stages. The unique contribution of this research lies in its implementation using Xilinx FPGA. The proposed approach not only advances the accuracy of PAD diagnostics but also showcases the adaptability and scalability of the hardware implementation. The inherent configurability of Xilinx FPGA provides a foundation for potential enhancements and adjustments to the multi-modal DSP filtering paradigm, ensuring a sustainable and evolving solution for cardiovascular healthcare. This tool chain, seamlessly integrating Xilinx and Verilog, stands as a formidable technological advancement poised to revolutionize the landscape of cardiovascular diagnostics.

articleTitle: Web-Based Network Assisted Teaching System in Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: A web-based teaching system in Vocational Education (VE) increases learning by combining online resources, collaborative platforms, and interactive tools to provide efficient development of skills and knowledge acquisition between students. To control and prevent the COVID-19 outbreak, the worldwide education system introduced an online course to establish an educational goal of class suspension without suspending school. However, it is questionable whether or not students are willing to participate in online courses as the ease of gradual epidermic. By comparing with other associated educational research, the system of VE is limited. Therefore, a web-based network-assisted teaching system is analyzed in VE using seven variables. Initially, a snowball sample is employed and students from vocational colleges are invited to fill out a questionnaire to assist in the perception of understanding which affects students' expectations, perceived effects, attitudes, and persistence and satisfaction with online learning (OL). Overall, 820 valid questionnaires are reclaimed by an efficient 81.10% questionnaire response rate. The outcomes show that Expectancy Belief (EB) and Online Learning Attitude (OLE) have a negative impact on Perceived Ease of Use (PEU), PEU has negative impact on Practical Class Satisfaction (PCS) but positive impact on Theoretical Class Satisfaction (TCS), Perceived Usefulness (PU) has negative impact on PCS but positive impact on TCS, and both PCS and TCS has positive impact on Continuous Learning Intention (CLI) respectively.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Water Quality Prediction Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Water quality monitoring and prediction plays an energetic role in the preservation of water resources, decision-making, and environmental management. The freshwater resources have been severely impacted by water contamination due to rising industrialization and rapid economic growth. The Water Quality Index (WQI) is a rapid approach which is utilized to determine the water quality status of ground and surface water systems from physicochemical and bacteriological information. In recent years, various researchers have discovered achievable ways for accurate prediction by using the latest machine learning and deep learning techniques. This survey represents various methodologies like Random Forest (RF), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Naïve Bayes, Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM), and so on are used for water quality prediction analysis. The RNN and LSTM give more accurate results compared to other techniques. This survey, concludes that the prediction of water quality is a difficult task and various factors are involved in the prediction.

articleTitle: Task Allocation of Financial Robots Based on RPA and Big Data Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of technology, more and more enterprises are adopting automation technology to replace traditional financial work models. The use of financial robots can improve the accuracy and efficiency of task allocation, and improving the overall work efficiency of enterprises is still an urgent problem to be solved. This article combined Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and big data algorithms to optimize the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm model by adjusting the membership function. The model was integrated into the RPA framework based on the characteristics of financial tasks and combined with big data algorithms to achieve task allocation. The experimental results showed that the highest accuracy of task allocation for financial robots based on RPA and big data algorithms was 98.63%. When assigning tasks of the same type, the accuracy was better than that of financial robots based on manually formulated rules, up to 14.51 %. This indicates that task allocation for financial robots based on RPA and big data algorithms can be applied in practice.

articleTitle: Design of Dynamic Programming Algorithm in UAV Aviation Emergency Surveying and Mapping Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development and widespread application of UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) technology, UAV aviation emergency mapping information systems are playing an increasingly important role in many fields such as disaster monitoring, real-time mapping, and emergency rescue. This article proposes a solution based on a dynamic programming algorithm to address issues such as path planning, energy consumption, and mapping accuracy in the UAV aviation emergency surveying and mapping information system. This article establishes a UAV aviation dynamic planning model and designs an efficient solution by analyzing factors such as the UAV's flight environment and mapping accuracy. In the experiments of performance test and mapping accuracy test, when the number of obstacles is 50, the UAV under this algorithm takes 370s to reach the destination, while the ant colony algorithm and genetic algorithm take 600s and 700s. Compared with the ant colony algorithm and genetic algorithm, the algorithm in this article saves 230s and 330s. The algorithm in this article improves the optimization path and real-time performance of the UAV aviation emergency surveying and mapping information system, improves the UAV's aviation emergency mapping and danger avoidance capabilities, and provides strong technical support for some rescue work and other applications. In addition, the algorithm in this article can also improve the real-time aspect of the UAV aviation emergency mapping information system, allowing UAV to quickly and accurately reach designated locations in complex and unknown environments.

articleTitle: Security and Privacy Protection using Rivest Shamir Adleman with Bit Insertion Technique Based on Big Data in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Big data analysis is one of the primary significant research topics in recent decades. The security of big data provides cloud application security and manages to host extremely sensitive data to support the platform of a cloud. However, the security and privacy of big data have become a arising problem that limits organizations from employing cloud services. To overcome this problem, the Rivest Shamir Adleman with Bit Insertion Technique (RSA-BIT) is proposed for security and privacy protection based on big data in cloud. Initially, range of file size 100 MB to 700 MB is obtained to evaluate the proposed technique. The Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) federation and HDFS high-availability approaches are combined to disperse NameNode (NN) service from single to various servers and Zookeeper distributed coordination technique is employed to arrange every node to attain a dual-storage channel. The RSA is utilized for encryption with BIT to enhance security and privacy of RSA against various attacks. The RSA-BIT achieves a better encryption time of 150 ms in 100 MB file size compared to existing techniques like Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), Data Encryption Standard (DES), and RSA respectively.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Risk Prediction System for Electricity Bill Recovery
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The utilization of predictive models in conventional research has often faced challenges in adequately capturing the intricate factors influencing Electricity Bill Recovery (EBR) risks, leading to a diminished accuracy in prediction outcomes. To address this limitation, a cutting-edge approach involving advanced artificial intelligence algorithms has been introduced to formulate a more precise risk prediction model tailored specifically for EBR. In this innovative framework, a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model has been meticulously constructed. This model is designed to incorporate temporal data, allowing for the comprehensive consideration of both past and future information in predicting the risk status of EBR. The bidirectional LSTM model demonstrates a remarkable average accuracy of 98.0% in classifying EBR risks, signifying a significant enhancement in predictive performance. By adopting the bidirectional LSTM model, the overall efficacy of risk classification for EBR is substantially improved. This advancement not only ensures a higher level of accuracy but also enables timely and effective management of EBR. The integration of artificial intelligence in this context showcases the potential for transformative improvements in predicting and mitigating risks associated with electricity bill recovery.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized High Gain Monopole Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to effectively utilize the radio frequency (RF) signals present in this ambient environment, efficient RF front-ends are significant. The front-ends must possess design-feasibility, robust circular polarization (CP) characteristics, & consistent antenna efficiency in the sub-6 GHz band, with high CP antenna gain. Therefore, CP-printed monopole inspired by metasurface (MS) is investigated in this article. Broadband CP is achieved with the fractional bandwidth <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$> 15\%$</tex>, CP gain <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$> 7.5$</tex> dBic, directional radiation pattern exceeding <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$100^{\circ}-120^{\circ}$</tex> with 3-dB angular beamwidth in the bands, & enhanced front-to-back ratio (FBR) is within an acceptable parameters. Then, achieved results were then compared to the performance compromises derived from the latest advancements. Hence, a comprehensive design was shown to address prevalent limitation encountered by monopole antennas in the expansive regions of 5G-enabled urban transformation, by utilizing RF application, particularly in the lower 5G band.

articleTitle: Digital Automatic Modeling Algorithms for Building BIM Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The complexity and diversity of building structures make traditional modeling methods difficult to adapt to various architectural forms and design styles. By introducing Inception models, the accuracy of BIM (Building Information Modeling) digital automatic modeling algorithms can be improved to ensure that the generated building models meet the requirements of actual design. A large amount of BIM data containing various building structures and design styles was collected, and the collected BIM data was preprocessed. The Inception model was constructed, including 1×1, 3×3, 5×5 convolution and global max pooling operations, and the cross entropy loss function was used to measure the performance of the model. The findings of the experiment demonstrated that the Inception model's average recognition accuracy for architectural features was 98.1%. Building element identification accuracy can be effectively increased with the use of Inception models, leading to more precise and effective digital automatic modeling of buildings.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Dual Band Antenna for 5G and Wimax Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: For 5th Generation (5G) communications, a dual-band microstrip patch antenna system design is presented in this paper. It operates at two different frequencies: S-band (5.2 GHz) for Worldwide Inter-operability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) and sub-6 (3.5 GHz) for 5G communication. The antenna is meticulously designed to meet the exacting requirements of modern wireless communication systems, providing enhanced performance and versatility. Using a FR-4 substrate with a dielectric constant of 4.3 and a thickness of 2.4 mm, the antenna was developed. The VSWR value obtained is 1.38 dB and 1.75 dB which is acceptable. This study enhances connections for satellite navigation systems and 5G networks by combining sub-6 and S-band frequencies into a single antenna design, providing a small and affordable solution for a variety of communication needs. The suggested antenna design has excellent performance characteristics, which makes it a useful component for next-generation wireless communication technologies.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent System for Puzzle Games Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In terms of data processing in puzzle games, this research paper studies and implements a set of data table workflows, with the aim of improving the flexibility of data configuration and increasing the convenience of data export, runtime loading, and data usage. This article implements a puzzle game framework that encapsulates the underlying modules and provides support for the upper logic modules. The three most important and commonly used modules in game frameworks are: state machine module, resource management module, and log module. The research results indicate that based on the puzzle game framework, the development efficiency of logical functions has been greatly improved, and the portability of the code has been greatly enhanced. Through overall testing, it can be seen from the overall performance that the game client is running well, and all parts meet the expected requirements. It also meets the requirements in non-functional aspects such as performance.

articleTitle: Student Management Information Platform based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In today's world, the rapid progress of knowledge economy makes education the key asset that determines the level of economic and social development of a country. This situation has received a lot of attention from all the people concerned with student management. Research on the self-management style of college and university students can improve students' ability to self-direct their learning and self-consciously conduct and serve their own education. Nevertheless, the flaw in the building of this model of college administration needs to be analyzed. To overcome these issues, the platform of student management information is proposed by utilizing clustering based data mining. Experimentation in the student growth rate is plotted, which shows an increase from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> to 33% in the year 2019 and 21% in the year 2020 through 35% in the year 2021. The rise of the economy is the indication itself of the number of people that have access to higher education has increased in a few years.

articleTitle: Integration and Intelligent Decision Making and Big Data Analysis in Management Accounting
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, data mining technology has received widespread attention in the development of enterprises and society. It has the function of deeply mining valuable data information from massive data, effectively saving the time and cost consumed by enterprises in data analysis, and transforming massive data information into knowledge and information that enterprises can apply in a more efficient way, thereby promoting the development of enterprises. This article applies data mining technology to the analysis of enterprise management accounting, which can provide certain optimization and development ideas for improving the level of enterprise management accounting. After 24 rounds of experimental analysis, it was found that the data lines representing the predicted results and the actual results in the sales volume prediction model of the BP algorithm were mostly fitted, indicating that the difference between the two was not significant. The error is much lower than the long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithm model.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Current Steering DAC Using 45nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Digital to analog converters (DACs) enable the smooth integration of digital technology with analog systems by precisely converting digital signals into analog outputs. This conversion guarantees accurate reproduction of music, video, and other analog signals. A current-steering operates by varying the currents through different branches of a resistor network to produce the desired analog output voltage. The current steering DAC offers energy-efficient applications since it offers a notable reduction in power usage while maintaining accuracy. This work uses a current steering mechanism and Sigma-Delta modulation for 10-bit resolution. The DAC has been designed in 0.45 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> CMOS technology. The precision and stability provided by the integrated Band Gap Reference circuit reduce errors and improve overall dependability. The design includes a segmented structure with 5 bits for binary and 5 bits for unary architecture. In simulation, it is found that the power consumption of the DAC is 2.9147mW. The DAC is designed using 1164 transistors. The DAC is observed to obtain accurate results with a supply voltage of 1.SV. The DAC can be used in modern electronic devices for things like audio processing, communication systems, and signal synthesis.

articleTitle: Novel Energy Efficient Routing Protocol Using Improved Fuzzy Logic Based Effective Clustering (IFLEC)
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: To improve the energy efficiency of the routing protocol in Wireless Sensor Networks using Improved Fuzzy Logic based Effective Clustering protocol (IFLEC) and performance comparison with Fuzzy Logic based Effective Clustering protocol (FLEC). Using novel cluster-head (CH) selection parameters fuzzy based angle between the sensor nodes and the sink, average threshold energy, and probability based average energy in WSN, an improved fuzzy based clustering approach is used to choose the CH to enhance the efficiency of the routing protocol. To measure how well the IFLEC protocol performs, its packet delivery ratio (PDR), energy consumption, lifetime, latency, and throughput characteristics are computed. The simulation output demonstrated that IFLEC protocol outperforms than FLEC protocols in terms of 6.2 % lower energy consumption, 11 % higher lifetime of the network, 2.8% higher PDR, 23% lower delay and 28% higher throughput.

articleTitle: Language Learning Machine Design based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In view of the limitations of the traditional D-P algorithm in the design of language learning machine, a design scheme of language learning based on artificial intelligence was proposed. Firstly, the influencing factors is accurately located through the constitutional neuron theory, and the indicators is reasonably divided to reduce interference, and the language learning machine design scheme is constructed by artificial intelligence. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the proposed scheme is superior to the traditional D-P algorithm in terms of language learning machine design accuracy and processing time of influencing factors, and has obvious advantages. In this paper, this paper proposes an AI-based language learning design scheme to better solve this problem. The scheme accurately locates the influencing factors through the constitutional neuron theory, so as to determine the division of indicators, and uses artificial intelligence to construct the scheme. Experimental results show that under certain evaluation criteria, the accuracy and speed of the scheme is significantly improved for different problems, and it has better performance. Therefore, the use of artificial intelligence-based simulation scheme in the design of language learning can better solve the limitations of traditional D-P algorithms and improve the simulation accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of an Indoor Illumination Automatic Adjustment System based on Fuzzy PID Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Timely adjusting the brightness of indoor lighting equipment as the outdoor light intensity changes can not only improve the efficiency of equipment use and enhance user comfort, but also avoid causing energy waste. However, traditional lighting adjustment methods do not fully consider the impact of outdoor light intensity changes on indoor lighting, which leads to unsatisfactory lighting effects and a significant waste of resources. This paper proposes a method of indoor illumination adjustment based on fuzzy PID control algorithm, which can significantly solve the above problems. n the hardware part of the system, a high-performance Arduino microcontroller is used as the core controller. The indoor light intensity is detected in real time by the light sensor, and the brightness of the lighting equipment is adjusted by sending a PWM pulse width modulation signal through the microcontroller. Users can remotely control the turning on or off of lighting devices from the mobile phone client. The MATLAB/Simulink simulation of the lighting system shows that compared to traditional PID control, fuzzy PID control has significant improvements in response time and overshoot, which proves that using fuzzy PID controller to adjust indoor lighting brightness can achieve satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Network Threat Awareness Model with Smart Grid for Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The smart grid benefits greatly from advanced data processing and communications technology. But security threats continue to interfere with information systems and they also affect smart grids. The smart grid's existing security efforts concentrate on conventional detection and prevention techniques. On the other hand, many attacks happen rapidly and are not detected by outdated security measures. These threats generally interrupt the regular operation of the smart grid and have significant effects on it. Furthermore, it may be difficult to reverse the damage and it is too late to take measures against threats once they are identified. To address this problem, the research implements a security situation awareness system that is based on big data analysis within the smart grid. The security situational analysis for the smart grid is performed by efficiently integrating reinforcement learning, game theory, and fuzzy cluster based analytical approach. When compared to existing method of True Data Integrity by Agent-Based Model (TDI-ABM), implemented mechanism achieved high normal and attack behavior identification, and attained low - false rate of normal and attack behavior.

articleTitle: Application and Optimization of Computer Vision and Deep Learning in Road and Bridge Structure Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional methods often rely on manual inspection and evaluation, which is time-consuming and laborious, not only inefficient, but also prone to subjective errors. Computer vision technology was utilized to improve the accuracy and precision of road and bridge structure monitoring, reduce human errors and achieve more reliable monitoring results. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was used to train and optimize large-scale data, achieving real-time monitoring and diagnosis of road and bridge structural states. Computer vision technology was applied to detect and identify road and bridge structural problems, such as automatically identifying cracks, damage, or deformation. The average time for monitoring road surface settlement of 5 road and bridge structures using computer vision and deep learning was 63.6% less than that of manually monitoring 5 road and bridge structures, indicating that the efficiency of monitoring road and bridge structures using computer vision and deep learning was higher.

articleTitle: Automated Facial Expression Detection using Genetic Algorithm optimization with Fuzzy C-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is a critical area of computer vision research in the current era. In order to improve the performance of the existing system, many researchers have used handcrafted features and machine learning (ML) classification methods. However, machine learning performs well on large data sets, whereas the handcrafted system performs well on datasets captured under predefined conditions. The ML method will not perform well on small datasets like CK+ and JAFFE due to overfitting. We propose a genetic algorithm (GA) optimization architecture based on fuzzy C-means clustering (GAO-FCM) to address these problems. To identify and recognize facial expressions quickly, accurately, and reliably, the proposed GAO-FCM organizes several characteristics of individual facial expressions. In the Japanese Female Facial Expression (JAFFE) dataset as well as in the Extended Cohn-Kanade (CK+) dataset, face detection and pre-processing techniques are explored in order to achieve the best accuracy of 99.23% for CK+ and 96.31 % for JAFFE datasets.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence in Public Network Information Security Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology and the diversification of network attack methods, traditional network security protection methods have been difficult to cope with the emerging complex threats. The combination of big data and artificial intelligence technology in public network information security management can not only process and analyze a huge amount of network data, but also provide the ability to automatically identify and predict potential threats. This paper focuses on the application of big data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology in threat intelligence collection, network traffic analysis, and network security automation. Finally, two sets of simulation results are as follows: In the public network information system, the system intrusion detection accuracy rate of the improved algorithm is improved by 7.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> on average compared with the traditional method, and the response time of network traffic monitoring is shortened by 2.7s on average. The improved algorithm model proposed in this paper can effectively help the government and enterprises to build a more secure network environment and protect the data security of individuals and organizations.

articleTitle: Construction of Data Flow Classification Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithm in the Context of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Traditional data categorization methods, such as decision trees and ANN (Artificial Neural Network), are hard to apply when dealing with data streams, and even fail because they focus only on static data extraction. With the advent of the big data era, IoT technology poses new challenges to traditional data mining techniques. Data streams are characterized by three features: real-time, large data volumes, and dynamic changes over time. For the characteristics of real-time and large data volume, there are some relatively mature algorithms that can process a large amount of data in real time, thus affecting the classification model by improving the speed of the classification model. This paper is based on the above problems, discusses the construction of data flow classification model based on ma-chine learning algorithms in the context of information technol-ogy, and takes the text data classification algorithm based on HMM (Hidden Markov Model) algorithm as an example, and finally experimentally verifies the classification time of the HMM algorithm is faster than that of the Hidden Markov Model (HMM) algorithm when the number of dataset instances is less than in the4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> the classification time of HMM algorithm is less than that of Bagging algorithm.

articleTitle: Wearable Health Monitoring System Based on One-Dimensional Block Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Health monitoring systems generally analyze a series of physiological conditions of the target. These physiological conditions can fully reflect the health status of the target, which is very suitable for monitoring the patient's physical condition. In order to accurately obtain physiological information, the users can try to use wearable devices for assistance. At the same time, this article also proposes to use a one-dimensional block matching algorithm to assist wearable devices in transmitting imaged physiological information to the remote monitoring system. In the comparison between the wearable health monitoring system based on the method in this article and the conventional wearable health monitoring system, the average recognition accuracy of the former is 90.03%, and the average recognition accuracy of the latter is 84.82%. Therefore, this study finds that the one-dimensional block matching algorithm is very suitable for designing wearable health monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Analysis and Optimization of Belt Conveyor Based on Intelligent Algorithm and Big Data Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: At present, there are some problems in the control of belt conveyor, such as the equipment works at a constant speed, and the conveying speed cannot be adjusted according to the actual traffic volume, which leads to a serious waste of electricity under small traffic volume. In this paper, the dynamic performance of belt conveyor is optimized. This paper uses a two-layer structure dynamic optimization control method based on the combination of genetic algorithm and big data algorithm. Part of it is applied to the acceleration prediction of belt conveyor system, and the other part is to control the speed of belt conveyor in real time to ensure that the actual speed of belt is consistent with the expected speed. In the comparison of energy-saving rates under different traffic volumes, relatively speaking, when the traffic volume is 3000t/h, the maximum energy-saving rate is 0.533, which is helpful for the stable operation of belt conveyor.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Multimodal Analysis for Detecting Pulmonary Infiltrates in Chest X-Ray Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This research paper delves into the critical task of detecting pulmonary infiltrates indicative of pneumonia in Chest X-ray images through a comprehensive multimodal analysis. This study focuses on evaluating the performance of a diverse set of models on Chest X-ray datasets, offering a comparative analysis and contribute meaningfully to pneumonia detection advancement through leveraging cutting-edge models, it's essential to scrutinize the strengths and limitations of each model. By employing rigorous evaluation criteria, we can discern which models offer the most promise in terms of accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and interpretability. The dataset used for experimentation encompasses a broad spectrum of chest X-ray images, ensuring a representative sample that captures the nuances of real-world clinical scenarios. The proposed multimodal analysis considers not only the visual features present in the X-ray images but also incorporates textual and contextual information. This holistic approach aims to enhance the overall diagnostic accuracy by leveraging complementary modalities. The results obtained from the experiments shed light on the strengths and weaknesses of the selected models, paving the way for informed decisions in deploying pneumonia detection systems. This research contributes to the evolving landscape of medical image analysis by presenting a comprehensive multimodal approach for detecting pulmonary infiltrates in Chest X-ray images. The comparative study not only aids in identifying optimal models for pneumonia detection but also highlights the potential for improved diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Photovoltaic Solar Panel Monitoring System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a contemporary technology that enhances user experience and adds intelligence to objects. Numerous applications have already embraced the Internet of Things. The Internet of Things (IoT) has greatly simplified and increased the accessibility of our lives. Society will be better equipped to safeguard future generations by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and ozone depletion as long as everyone uses renewable energy. These PV technologies are growing in popularity because they are so widely available, reasonably priced, and easy to install and maintain. Monitoring is required to determine the current condition of each solar photovoltaic cell in a solar panel. This monitoring is necessary to detect any defects in the solar cell and implement repair actions in addition to guaranteeing that the solar panel continues to function properly. In this study, an Internet of Things-based solar panel monitoring system is implemented, and the MPPT algorithm is used to track maximum power.

articleTitle: Research on Power Line Loss Degree Prediction Model Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of power line loss degree, this paper analyzes the structure of the artificial neural network model and proposes the quality checking method of line loss data, which lays the foundation for the model to predict the line loss degree. Secondly, we use the equivalent resistance method to calculate the historical grid line loss rate, normalize the data in the input layer of the neural network, so as to improve the accuracy of line loss prediction, and complete the design of the prediction mode of the degree of power line loss based on artificial neural network. The results show that the accuracy, misjudgement rate and omission rate of the line loss prediction model in this paper are 99.32%, 0.45% and 0.23%, respectively, which are better than the other two line loss prediction models, and have strong application advantages.

articleTitle: Enhancing Kidney Stone Diagnosis: A Fusion Approach of FCM and CNN for Precise Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Kidney stones, characterized by the accumulation of mineral and organic substances within the renal system, pose a significant health concern globally. Timely and accurate diagnosis is paramount for effective treatment and prevention of complications. Medical imaging, particularly computed tomography (CT) scans, plays a crucial role in identifying and characterizing kidney stones. However, the inherent variability in stone appearance, shape, and size, coupled with the potential presence of artifacts in imaging data, poses challenges to traditional diagnostic methods. Hence, this work focuses on addressing these challenges and dedicated to optimizing the detection of kidney stones by employing a synergistic approach that integrates image processing and deep learning techniques. The proposed work involves initial pre-processing steps, utilizing median filtering to eliminate noise and adaptive histogram equalization (AHE) for enhancing the quality of CT images of kidneys. Subsequently, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are employed as a deep learning algorithm for classification, with a primary focus on accurately distinguishing between normal and abnormal images. In the event of an abnormal classification indicating the presence of a kidney stone, a secondary step is implemented. This step involves the application of fuzzy C-means (FCM) and level set segmentation techniques to achieve precise detection and localization of the kidney stone within the image. The proposed approach achieves an accuracy of 99.45%, which is 13% improvised when compared to the existing approaches.

articleTitle: Application of Back Propagation Neural Network Method in Digital Economy Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Evaluation Index System (EIS) in present phase of Chine FinTech enterprises is determined through taking effect of digital economy on growth of FinTech. Particularly, Back Propagation (BP) neural network is developed for prediction method depending on functional information. The 6 China State-Owned Enterprises (SOEs) are chosen for stock price prediction by empirical evaluation. The 6 SOEs are Petro China, SINOPEC group, Huadian Energy, National Power, China Shenhua and Chinese Architecture. The Back Propagation (BP) Neural Network (NN) is used for Predicting the stock market price in digital economy. The grey relation analysis for screening feature variables, integrated with BPNN for improve the prediction results. The BPNN method was evaluated with performance indicators of Mean Absolute Prediction Error (MAPE), Mean Square Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MSE) and Correlation Coefficient (R). The BPNN method attained less error rate of 3.45 MAPE, 0.52 MSE, 0.43 MAE and 0.31 R that is effective than other exiting methods like Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Decision Tree (DT).

articleTitle: Data Mining Technology in the International Student Evaluation Using Artificial Neural Network with Latent Dirichlet Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Recently, Educational Data Mining (EDM) has increased remarkable consideration. The significant aim of educational institutions is to offer efficient education for students to improve academic performance. When data mining approaches are used in the context of education, they can discover hidden knowledge and patterns that can aid in decision-making processes focused at improving an educational system. Forecasting the student's achievements is a significant problem for higher education administrators. To address this challenge, this research proposes the Machine Learning (ML) method of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) with the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) approach for the prediction of the performance of the international student's academics. The presented approach considered the last semester for the international student's performance as well as their personal features were examined. The pre-processing techniques like cleaning, integration, transformation, feature scaling as well as reduction were utilized for the prevention of anomalies as well as high dimensionality reduction in the collected data and to acquire the most correlated features. The experimental results shows that the proposed ANN-LDA approach achieves the accuracy of 95.7% when compared to the previous works like K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM).

Author Keywords: Machine Learning and International Students performance evaluation

articleTitle: A Particle Swarm Optimization Model for Automatic Pricing and Replenishment of Vegetables using K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Fresh produce supermarkets face complex challenges when dealing with the supply of vegetable items. to meet these challenges, supermarkets need scientific methods to guide pricing and replenishment decisions, considering multiple factors and supporting adjustments to adapt to the needs of the market. First, a heat map of Spearman's correlation coefficient between each vegetable category is plotted to analyse the correlation between the categories. Then, a K-means clustering analysis is performed for each vegetable item, and the vegetable items are divided into four categories to analyse the relationship between the same categories sold in bundles. Next, a dynamic mixed-integer programming model is established for the daily replenishment quantity and pricing strategy to maximise profit, and the model is solved by particle swarm algorithm to derive the daily replenishment quantity and pricing strategy of each vegetable category in the coming week (1–7 July 2023). Finally, an optimisation model in terms of individual items is developed and the replenishment quantity and pricing strategy for individual items on 1 July are derived.

articleTitle: A Gait Analysis Technique based on Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Patients with paraplegia need crutches to keep balance during othosis ambulation, so it is necessary to establish a dynamic model reflecting the effect of supporting crutches. In the present study, we investigated two gait patterns of PAGO users, and constructed a mathematical model including parameters of the trunk, thighs, shins, feet, and crutches. Moreover, the Newton-Euler method was adopted for dynamic analysis. Because both crutches held the body up, a statically indeterminate problem existed during the analysis. An additional equation of trunk deformation was made to solve all unknown and obtain the driving moments of lower-limb joints. ADAMS simulation was performed to verify the feasibility of calculation. This study provides a basis for the development of lower-limb powered othoses. The results indicate that the motion rules of lower-limb joints are similar to the joint motion rules when a person walks slowly. It verified the correctness of the calculation.

articleTitle: Effective Machine Leaning Based Malware detection and Classification Using Improved Voting Method based Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Malware poses a significant threat to individuals, organizations, and even nations. Developing effective detection and classification models helps in mitigating these threats by identifying and neutralizing malicious software before it can cause harm. In this paper, proposed the Machine learning (ML) based improved Voting method based decision tree is used to classify and detecting the malware poses, the model training is conducting on CICI-Melmem2020 dataset. The dataset has unwanted noise, Null values, infinite values they are normalized in the preprocessing stage. Continuously build a smaller set of features from a larger set is utilized for extract the features subsequently the ranking technique is used to select the features. Finally, the proposed VM- DT classifier is used to classify and detecting the malware poses. this approach's numerical validation yielded an Accuracy of 99.98% and Precision of 99.98% and Recall of 99.97%. the suggested method outperforms all the current methods, as demonstrated by a comparison of Logistic Regression-Feature Ranking Technique (LR-FRT), Massive algorithm of Support Vector Machine (MA-SVM), and Android Malware Detection Naive Bayes (AMD-NB).

articleTitle: A High-speed Wireless Dump Method for Locomotives Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of insufficient bandwidth, high manual labor, and low reliability, it is necessary to provide customers with a safe and reliable, high-speed, large bandwidth, intelligent, and automated solution to solve the problem of transmission between vehicles and ground. It can complete data transmission of several gigabytes and tens of gigabytes in a short time (3–5 minutes), and achieve automation of all transmission and storage operations without human involvement throughout the entire transmission process, This article first analyzes the problems existing in the high-speed wireless dumping scheme for locomotives. Secondly, it elaborates on the design principles of high-speed wireless dumping schemes for locomotives based on 5G technology. Then, a high-speed wireless dumping scheme for locomotives based on 5G technology is designed. Finally, the designed scheme is tested and the test results meet the requirements of high-speed wireless dumping for locomotives.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Conventional Meters and Electricity Consumption Using Optimized Extreme Gradient Boosting
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the progress of innovative information technologies, smart energy meters have designed a substantial quantity of real-time electricity consumption. Energy consumption is based on the various factors such as humidity, building area, temperature, habitation and so on and these factors are cooperatively describing the energy meter background. The smart meter supports to capable to identify data abnormalities for efficient monitoring as well as investigation. The anomaly detection supports for better decision making for minimizing the energy consumption. In this research, Machine Learning (ML) approach of Optimized Extreme Gradient Boosting (OXGBoosting) for the detection and classification of anomaly for energy consumption in conventional meters. This research collects the large-scale anomaly dataset for estimating the effectiveness. The proposed method is estimated by various performance metrices and it achieves an accuracy of 0.95, precision of 0.92, recall of 0.92, F1-score of 0.91 and AUC of 0.95 respectively when compared to the previous studies such as Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), Two-Class Boosted Decision Tree and NGBoost.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Using LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Emotion recognition from speech is a crucial task in many applications, such as affective computing, psychological research, and human-computer interaction. LSTM networks shows promise in modeling sequential data, such as voice signals, because of its capacity to capture long-term dependencies. The main objective of this research work is to assign emotions to one of the four categories: fear, rage, sadness, and happiness. The samples are used to determine energy, pitch, MFCC and LPCC coefficients, speaker rate, and other important characteristics. Speech is a widely utilized signal for human-to-human communication, which implies that speech is also used for communication between people and the machines. This interactive system's aim is to improve the speech emotion recognition (SER) technology by using LSTM Model. Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is critically important for applications that assess spoken emotions in real-time. Dataset used in this Research work are taken from kaggle which is named as Toronto emotional speech set (TESS). The dataset is arranged according to the emotion expressed by the two female actors, which is organized within a separate folder, And the audio clips are arranged with 200 targeted words. The audio file is saved in WAV format. Additionally, a system utilizing an LSTM algorithm and an MFCC features are presented in this paper's preliminary results.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Accounting Computerized Information System based on Data Mining and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The security issue of accounting by electronic data processing information systems is a complex system engineering. How to extract useful data from the massive amount of accounting by electronic data processing information and provide decision-making basis for enterprise decision-makers is a key issue. The article is based on data mining and neural network technology, and studies a security analysis method for accounting by electronic data processing information systems based on data mining and neural networks. This method extracts useful information from data and establishes corresponding models through neural networks to identify key factors that affect the security of accounting by electronic data processing information systems. The results show that the average reliability of the accounting computerization information system based on data mining is 84.38%. The average security of the accounting computerization information system based on neural networks is 94.86%. This article combines the two to create a better accounting by electronic data processing information system.

articleTitle: Energy-Centric Clustering and Routing Using Seagull Optimization Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), the imperative for energy-efficient clustering and routing protocols is indisputable. This protocol, designed to meet this critical demand, integrates advanced optimization techniques, aiming to augment network performance and extend system lifespan. Existing methods, while attempting to strike a balance between energy consumption and network lifetime, often encounter challenges, a refined solution. The proposed energy-centric clustering and routing protocol in WSN leverages the Seagull Optimization Algorithm (SOA). This innovative approach optimizes cluster formation and routing dynamics by giving precedence to nodes with higher residual energy, thereby enhancing overall network efficiency. By systematically addressing existing limitations, the SOA-based protocol attains commendable performance metrics, including energy consumption at 0.1435J, End-to-End Delay of 10.4566 sec, Throughput of 0.97498 Mbps, and Network Lifetime of 19,857 rounds. In a comparative analysis with MFA-SSO, HPSO-CSSO, DECR-GOA, and FMCB-ER, the proposed method emerges as superior, effectively overcoming challenges and optimizing operations in WSN.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Selecting Shared Logistics Delivery Nodes in E-commerce Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The concept of sharing economy has been widely recognized, but the immaturity of sharing platforms, the insecurity of data, and the opacity of information have led to many problems in the process of shared logistics. Shared logistics is based on the concept of platform resource integration and service sharing, with services provided by third parties. Users can integrate and share goods, funds, information and other resources through online platforms according to their needs. In this mode, the logistics distribution center undertakes functions such as goods distribution and information collection. Therefore, this article focused on the problem of selecting logistics distribution nodes under the shared logistics model. A multi-objective optimization model was designed, with different weight values set for each parameter in each objective function. A logistics distribution node location algorithm based on blockchain technology was explored using blockchain technology. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm in solving the model was verified through experiments. The experimental study found that the algorithm based on blockchain technology had a high number of Pareto frontier solutions within the selected range, up to 27, which was 12 times higher than traditional site selection.

articleTitle: Marketing Strategy Matching Algorithm Under Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, people's ways of obtaining information have undergone earth shaking changes, with a large amount of data, massive information, and various forms of advertising filling lives. Consumers are no longer satisfied with passively accepting advertisements, but actively seek out information that they are interested in or useful in order to find the products they want to purchase or need. This is due to the increasing demand for information and personalization from consumers. The article studies a marketing strategy matching algorithm based on artificial intelligence technology, aiming to effectively solve these problems. The results show that the accuracy and efficiency of the marketing strategy matching algorithm based on artificial intelligence can reach up to 95.5% and 90% respectively.

articleTitle: Application of Network Image Enhancement Integrating Artificial Intelligence in Chronic Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Chronic diseases are a global health problem that and more scholars have conducted research on image enhancement behavior recognition technology, mainly including image feature extraction, image modeling, feature selection, etc. The feature extraction technology of images is one of the important techniques for image denoising. The grayscale and grayscale values of each pixel in the image are represented through the gray domain. In current clinical treatments, pharmacists face many complex problems when performing image fusion. For example, when a pharmacist enhances a pharmacological imaging, the image becomes disorganized, making it difficult to accurately obtain the clarity and contrast of the image, and it is difficult for pharmacists to use imaging to determine whether a specific drug is effective for a patient's disease. Due to the above problems, image recognition algorithms came into being. In this paper, image based methods have been proposed. This article first provides a detailed introduction to the basic framework of artificial intelligence, then applies artificial intelligence to network image enhancement behavior recognition in clinical treatment, tests the overall efficiency and accuracy of data, and finally uses a survey questionnaire for medical staff to demonstrate that artificial intelligence is very helpful in improving the application research of image enhancement behavior recognition in clinical treatment of chronic disease management. Therefore, Making good use of artificial intelligence for network image enhancement behavior recognition is a highly worthy research topic in clinical treatment of chronic disease management.

articleTitle: Optimized Convolution Neural Network Based Fake News Detection Using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the era of social media, the social media and smartphone popularity has enhanced exponentially. By the electronic media, fake news has rising quick with new information which are hugely untrustworthy. The search engine like google are incapable for fraudulent of news because its limitation with restricted keywords. The Optimized Convolution Neural Network (OPCNN) is proposed for classifying fake news into actual and fraudulent news based on sentiment analysis. which accommodate varying complexity levels by adjusting its architecture in Fake News Detection (FND). The Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to extract features from preprocessed images which reduces the data dimension comprising numerous related variables and recalls the high change in real data. The ISOT dataset is preprocessed through four various techniques. The recall, accuracy, f1 score and precision with ISOT dataset are considered to evaluate OPCNN performance. The OPCNN realizes 99.58% recall, 99.67% accuracy, 99.61% f1score and 99.64% precision for ISOT dataset when matched to previous techniques like Random Forest (RF) and Sea Turtle Foraging Optimization-based Fake News Detection and Classification (STODL-FNDC).

articleTitle: Face Recognition and Expression Analysis Technology of Image Signal Processing in Digital Media
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of digital media technology, image analysis plays a vital role in the fields of digitalization and informatization. This article will provide an in-depth explanation of face recognition and classification, morphological modeling principles, and processing methods. Through the analysis and research on feature extraction of graphic signals, this article designs corresponding algorithms and uses MATLAB toolbox diagram software to verify the experimental results. Research shows that the recognition rate of angry and happy expressions is 100% within a distance of 300m. Then, like the recognition rate of the other three expressions, as the recognition distance increases, the overall trend decreases, but the overall recognition rate is above 90%. This shows that the recognition accuracy of this system is relatively high. At the same time, the lowest error and omission rate of this system is 0%, and the highest error and omission rate is 10%.

articleTitle: Semiconductor Material Performance Prediction Method Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of nanotechnology and its widespread application in industrial production have made the functional prediction of nanomaterials a current research hotspot. This article trained and predicted Genetic Algorithm (GA). To improve the accuracy of experimental prediction, BP (Back Propagation) was introduced to establish a GA-BP neural network model.
