The GA-BP neural network was trained on the same training set to obtain an accurate GA-BP neural network model. The established GA-BP neural network was used to predict semiconductor material samples for comparison with actual values. In the comparison of conductivity type errors, material 1 had a conductivity type error of 3.48%, and material 2 had a conductivity type error of 3.76%. The results indicated that the predicted results of this method were very consistent with the actual values of semiconductor material properties.

articleTitle: Flood Disaster Early Warning Model for Power Facilities Based on Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Flood disasters have a serious impact on the operation and safety of power facilities, but there is currently no good way to accurately predict flood disasters. If we can establish a flood disaster early warning model for power facilities based on time series analysis, we can reduce a lot of resource losses and better protect power facilities. This study compares two models, ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) and LSTM (Long Short Term Memory networks), to compare the prediction performance of traditional models and this model for predicting flood disasters in power facilities. Through experiments and comparative analysis, the accuracy of the LSTM method is up to 98%. We found that the LSTM model performed better in predicting flood disasters in power facilities, had a higher accuracy, and could more accurately predict the occurrence and trend of flood disasters.

articleTitle: FPGA Design and Implementation of Approximate Radix-8 Booth Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In digital systems, multiplication operations are crucial, particularly in applications like image processing. This paper proposes an approximate radix-8 Booth multiplier designed to enhance performance and reduce complexity compared to traditional counterparts. Specifically tailored for signed-unsigned numbers, the proposed multiplier undergoes evaluation via simulation using Xilinx Vivado software with Artix-7 FPGA Board. Leveraging techniques such as modified Booth encoding and parallel partial product generation, it aims to achieve reduced delay and power consumption. The application of this multiplier is demonstrated through integration into Sobel edge detection. Quantitative metrics, including speedup factor and area reduction, are provided to assess performance improvements over existing systems. Furthermore, the proposed design is highly accurate, detecting 98.87% of edges, demonstrating its practicality and usefulness in digital image processing applications.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Technology in Equipment Control Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In many fields, equipment control management systems are often used. The main purpose is to monitor and manage various types of equipment and software systems required for work, aiming to improve the efficiency and maintainability of equipment, thereby achieving effective management of equipment. Therefore, this article further proposes to use artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things to design an equipment control management system to achieve more efficient equipment management. Finally, this article completed the verification of the effectiveness of the method in this article through comparative experiments. In a comparative experiment on work efficiency improvement between the equipment control management system based on the method in this article and the conventional system, the average work efficiency of the former was improved to 83.30%, while the work efficiency of the latter was improved to 60.29%. It can be seen from the experimental results that artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things are indeed very suitable for establishing equipment control management systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Chinese Language Teaching System based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This study builds a Chinese Language and literature majors teaching system, by combining artificial intelligence (AI) technology and performance, with improving the teaching effect. This paper implements a classifier-based fast calculation method for successive breaking of active power flow depend on existing coordination algorithms. This method provides high-quality active power information for the static safety check and control of successive breaking. Furthermore, to improve the reliability of the power flow results, this work accelerates computation, increases the operation effect of the teaching system, and utilizes the NR method for algorithm-sensitive errors. To assess the efficiency of the implemented teaching system, a simulated classroom setting was used for testing. The implemented method was compared with Random Forest (RF) and Gradient Boosting (GB) methods with time of 15 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> in AI-based vocabulary check, and 35 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> in AI-based grammar check, power of 0.25 W in AI-based vocabulary check, and 0.59 W in AI-based on grammar check.

articleTitle: Online Training Data System Under Cache and Information Components
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The traditional online training data system is often limited by the performance when dealing with a large number of users, which makes the response of the system become slow, thus reducing the user experience. To solve this problem, this research aims to solve the application problem of traditional online training data system based on the innovative design of cache and information components, so as to improve the operating efficiency of the system and user experience. Firstly, the system architecture based on cache and information components is designed. Secondly, least recently used algorithm is used to optimize cache strategy, then B+ tree and hash table are used to optimize data architecture, R tree and k-dimensional tree are used to optimize indexes, and then asynchronous loading is optimized. Finally, experiments are carried out to analyze the system performance before and after optimization. The results show that the online training data system based on cache and information components has the shortest response time and the highest operating efficiency. The response time is 79% faster than the traditional system, and the operating efficiency is 20.99% faster than the traditional system. In conclusion, it is feasible to apply the cache and information components in the online training data system, which can optimize the performance of the system.

articleTitle: Software Technology Development Technology in Computer Application Software
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the production, daily management and operation of enterprises, the application of computer application technology has brought unlimited opportunities and competitive advantages to enterprises. With the wide application of computer technology in enterprises, enterprises have stronger competitiveness and stronger adaptability, which has laid a good foundation for their sustainable development. This paper introduces the development technology of computer application software and gives the development trend, advantages and disadvantages of software development technology. The development mode of computer application system is given. The system error rate in this paper is always low, with the lowest error rate of 0.42% in this paper and 1.33% in the traditional system. The highest error rate of this system is 2.65%, and the highest error rate of traditional system is 9.88%. Through the research of software technology development technology in computer application software, developers can focus on business logic and user experience, thus effectively improving the efficiency and quality of software development and promoting the rapid progress of digital transformation.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Benefit Analysis on the Means of Energy Storage Access Aiming at Grid Security and RES Penetration
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: As the renewable energy penetration rising at recording high globally, side effects of renewable energy sources (RES) are also increasingly significant, one of which is the uncertain power generation that could not be scheduled on time. To consume the uncertainty brought by RES, energy storage has been put on the top of list. There are several modes for energy storage equipment involvement, including thermal units & energy storage, RES units & energy storage, individual energy storage and so on, while the comprehensive benefits of the various means of cooperation modes remains unclear. This paper thus establishes a benefit analysis framework for energy storage aiming at grid security and RES generation. The benefits of energy sources, grid and energy storage are modeled, while the benefit of demand side is considered stationary. The optimization model is then linearized so that it could be efficiently solved.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Enterprise Safety Precontrol System and Dynamic Quantitative Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Based on a comprehensive analysis of different work and management indicators, as well as the quantitative assessment outcomes of the implemented personal safety responsibility system, this study proposes the utilization of computer intelligent warning technology within the power supply enterprise responsibility system. This technology enables the automatic analysis of the entire operational process of the power supply enterprise responsibility system, facilitating the examination of the responsibility system at various hierarchical levels within the organization. This paper aims to propose the establishment of evaluation indicators derived from the components of power supply enterprise safety responsibility system construction, and subsequently develop a multi-level responsibility evaluation index system. The dynamic evaluation method is employed for the computation of the evaluation value and the establishment of the pre-control algorithm. The evaluation data of the full staff safety responsibility system is monitored in real-time, and any abnormal detection is promptly addressed. Upon the detection of abnormalities, the determination of warning execution conditions and warning levels is conducted by considering the warning indicators associated with the abnormal data. Based on this criterion, a determination is made regarding the issuance of a warning. When a warning is issued, it triggers the generation of corresponding warning information based on the warning level. This real-time warning information is then stored in the database.

articleTitle: Optimization of Indoor Space Layout Using Chameleon Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: An indoor space layout is one of the significances in Geographic Information Science (GIS) application, due it develops the efficient indoor spatial patterns which enhance the efficiency as well as behavior of the human. However, some research examining the indoor room optimal allocation has been reported. To address this problem, this research proposes the integrative approach of the Chameleon Swarm Algorithm (CSA) for the indoor space layout. This approach involves the two approaches like indoor room allocation optimization as well as indoor connective map design. The objective of an optimization process according to the parametric performance simulation utilized in this research can efficiently assists the building designers in making energy-saving design decisions in the primary stage, permitting the designers to have the condition to pursue in an original design operation process. The experimental results shows that the proposed method attains better results and it is validated through various error metrices like Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Mean Squared Eror (MSE), and R-Squared (R2) and it achieves the values of about 0.453, 0.045 and 0.756 in cooling demand.

Author Keywords: Indoor Space layout and Optimal indoor allocation

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Gated Recurrent Unit Approach for Detecting and Classifying High Impedance Fault in Power Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In the recent days, detecting the High Impedance Faults (HIF) is an extremely difficult task because it is unpredictable, asymmetric, and nonlinear. Due to the size of the fault current is typically much lower than the normal load current, these faults are typically undetectable and impossible to isolate using traditional over-current approaches. Therefore, this research introduced a novel technique name called Bi-directional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) for power distribution-related HIF detection and isolation. The devised technique makes use of voltage as well as data from current sensors. In order to clarify the procedure, many types of algorithms were utilized during the detecting phase. For classification purposes, the algorithm Bi-GRU is applied on IEEE 13- distribution of node networks to test this method's ability to recognize and detect HIF with both damaged and unbroken wires. The suggested Bi-GRU provides fast and flawless output when troubleshooting high impedance issues. Bi-GRU considerably increases input processing and enhances classification accuracy. From the overall analysis, suggested Bi-GRU combines the forward and reverse GRUs in reverse order, which allows it to complete the operation more quickly and accurately than existing Morphological Fault Detector by achieving 95.63 % accuracy rate.

articleTitle: A Secure Multi-Factor Authentication System Using ElGamal Bakers Map Function in Virtual Private Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Virtual Private Network (VPN) is the emerging technology facilitates the secure cloud connectivity and remote access, motivates the migration of physical resource of IT applications to the virtual resource. Despite of tremendous applications of virtual private network, the security remains as a major concern, and is highly prune to the varieties of attacks. The existing works attempts to address the security concern, resulting in unchanged status of the security in terms of enhancement. To overcome this concern, this manuscript introduces a Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) using the low entropy password along with the graphical password authentication system. The security of the graphical password is enhanced using the novel ElGamal bakers map function to and a cipher graphical is generated to communicate over the insecure network. The proposed work is treated under various attack analysis using black box testing process and the robustness is measured.

articleTitle: Collaborative English Translation (CET) Tools Based on Cloud Translation Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: How to coordinate the task allocation and process arrangement between the translator and the computer to reduce the labor intensity of the translator and improve the efficiency of translation is still a difficult problem and requires more in-depth research. Based on the CET tool of the cloud translation platform, this paper studies and discusses the function and translation process of CET; proposes a collaborative translation quality scoring algorithm, and uses the collaborative translation quality scoring algorithm to test the accuracy of cet and the English translation of different classifiers in the economic field, as well as the experimental results of the combination of oversampling and undersampling in the network neighborhood. The results show that the recall rate and accuracy rate of collaborative translation ensemble learning are higher than ordinary translation in the network and economic fields. The recall rate data is as high as 97%, with an accuracy rate of 79%.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection and Classification Using MobileNetV3 and Wavelet Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Detection of plant disease is the most important aspect in agriculture, aimed at identifying and diagnosing disease that affect plants. If the plant disease detected earlier, that helps to avoid risk from damaging plants and the soil. However, there is a difficulty to differentiate the diseased and healthy leaves due to similarity of disease symptoms. To solve this problem, an effective Wavelet Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (WKELM) classifier is proposed for distinguishing diseased and healthy plants. Images from the PlantVillage dataset are preprocessed using Bilateral filter and then segmented by Adaptive Gaussian Threshold (AGT) to separate the diseased portion from leaf. MobileNetV3 a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) used for effective feature extraction with the hyper parameters which are tuned using effective Emperor Penguin Optimizer (EPO) and classification is done by the WKELM for accurate results of plant disease. The experimental results of the proposed model performed by the evaluation metrics achieved accuracy of 99.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, recall of 99.6%, precision of 99.6%, F1-score of 99.7% which is greater than other existing deep learning models like CNN, Transfer learning with Deep CNN models, CNN - Visual Geometry Group (VGG).

articleTitle: Development of a Predictive VM Provisioning in a Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: In contemporary virtualized data center environments, efficient resource allocation in virtualized data center environments is crucial for preventing server downtimes. This paper introduces a method to mitigate resource exhaustion on ESXi servers using predictive analytics. Leveraging historical workload data, the proposed approach forecasts potential resource saturation events by analyzing past usage patterns. A proactive provisioning mechanism is outlined to deploy virtual machines (VMs) onto new ESXi servers during predicted high-load intervals. This preemptive strategy strategically distributes workloads, averting server downtime and ensuring optimal resource utilization. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving the dependability and security of ESXi servers in virtualized environments and out performs better than other state-of-arts. The proposed method is implemented using ESXi host client and the result shows effective performance and improved stability of the overall system.

articleTitle: LSTM-MI: Revolutionizing Intrusion Detection Through Adaptive Learning and Mutual Information Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This study introduces two innovative approaches to augment intrusion detection capabilities. The first method employs Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction, streamlining the dataset's complexity while retaining crucial features. The second method delves into feature selection using Mutual Information (MI), identifying and preserving the most informative attributes crucial for intrusion detection. These selected features are then incorporated into LSTM-based models and it evaluates the efficacy of both PCA and MI alongside LSTM, providing a comparative analysis of their impact on intrusion detection performance. Notably, the LSTM-PCA model exhibits an accuracy of 97.73%, while the LSTM-MI model achieves a higher accuracy of 98.21 %. These results underscore the significance of integrating PCA and MI in conjunction with LSTM, offering nuanced insights into their individual contributions to accurate intrusion detection. Through extensive experimentation on benchmark datasets, the proposed methodologies aim to advance the development of robust intrusion detection systems (IDS).

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling for Energy-Efficient Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: The surge in demand for energy-efficient computing has spurred the exploration of cutting-edge techniques to optimize power consumption in modern computing systems. Though the traditional implementation of Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) has proven effective, their traditional implementations lack adaptability, limiting their ability to fully exploit dynamic workload variations. This research presents an innovative solution by integrating proposed Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms into DVFS, addressing the limitations of conventional methods. The proposed RL algorithm employs Q-Iearning, a model-free RL technique, to iteratively learn the optimal policy for adjusting CPU voltage and frequency. Our customized algorithm enables autonomous real-time adjustments of voltage and frequency levels, showcasing a remarkable 20% power saving compared to conventional DVFS. The model's adaptability is evident in its capacity to achieve optimal configurations across diverse workloads, emphasizing RL's potential for enhancing energy efficiency in computing systems. As energy efficiency gains paramount importance, this research underscores the pivotal role of RL, in achieving sustainable and optimal performance in computing systems.

articleTitle: Clinical Insight: Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models for Disease Prediction across Multifaceted Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: This research introduces an advanced model architecture for chronic disease detection, leveraging highly developed artificial intelligence algorithms. The prototype combines the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) procedure, showcasing significant advancements in predictive capabilities. The proposed hybrid approach, integrating CNN and LSTM with forwarding selection, is adopted for disease presence prediction. Employing a tenfold cross-validation strategy and optimizing with 200 training cycles, the model demonstrates a meticulous training process. Learning rate control plays a pivotal role, and a rate of 0.01 is chosen for optimal learning. The model is applied to datasets related to cancer, heart, kidney, and liver diseases, among other diseases, with feature selection based on information gain. Seven cutting-edge classification algorithms-RF, SVM, KNN, CNN, and CNN_LSTM-are used in a thorough examination. The outcome showcases the superiority of the proposed CNN_LSTM model with notable accuracy rates-98% and 99%, respectively, for chronic kidney disease prediction.

articleTitle: Analysing the Quality and Management of Data in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: Big data analytics delves into these immense datasets to reveal hidden patterns and correlations, yet its pervasive use raises substantial security and privacy concerns. This article centers on the specific issues concerning privacy and security within the realm of big data, distinguishing between these concerns and outlining their distinct requirements. The focus is on various privacy strategies, including L-diversity, k-anonymity, HyBrEx, and T-closeness, examining their practical applications in diverse business contexts. Privacy protection methods have surfaced throughout various stages of the big data life cycle, aiming to ensure privacy during data creation, retention, and handling. This paper provides an extensive review of these privacy mechanisms while addressing the challenges encountered by current approaches. As the extended comprehensive study is experimented with features extraction techniques such as Principle component analysis (PCA), Independent component analysis (ICA), Linear discriminant analysis(LDA) the evaluated performance in terms of accuracy achieved with 98%, 99% and 95% respectively.

articleTitle: Simulink Design of Optimized Turbo Code for Next-Generation Wireless Networks: A 5G and Beyond Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Distributed Computing and Electrical Circuits and Electronics (ICDCECE)
abstract: With the rapid evolution of wireless communication technologies, the demand for reliable and efficient error correction techniques has become increasingly paramount, especially in the context of next-generation networks such as 5G and beyond. This paper presents a Simulink-based approach for the design and optimization of Turbo codes tailored specifically for next-generation wireless networks, with a particular focus on the evolving requirements of 5G and beyond. Turbo codes have emerged as a promising error correction technique due to their excellent performance characteristics, making them well-suited for the demands of modern wireless communication systems. This work proposes a systematic methodology for designing and fine-tuning Turbo codes to meet the stringent reliability and efficiency criteria of future wireless networks. By integrating insights from 5G and beyond perspectives, our approach aims to address the unique challenges posed by emerging wireless communication paradigms, Bit Error Rate. Extensive simulations demonstrate that our optimized Turbo codes outperform conventional decoders across varied code rates, showcasing superior Bit Error Rate (BER) performance. Systematic evaluation identifies the optimal code rate, enhancing error correction efficiency in next-gen wireless networks. Leveraging optimized Turbo codes is pivotal in advancing error correction techniques, bolstering the robustness of future wireless communication systems.
